<html lang="en">
<head>
<script data-src="fusion-bundle/svg-shim">(function () {
  if (location.protocol !== "about:") return;
  var proto = window.History && window.History.prototype;
  if (!proto) return;
  ["pushState", "replaceState"].forEach(function (name) {
    var orig = proto[name];
    proto[name] = function (state, title, url) {
      if (typeof url === "string" && url.charAt(0) === "#") {
        var hash = url;
        try { orig.call(this, state, title, "about:srcdoc" + hash); }
        catch (err) { location.hash = hash; }
        try { window.parent.history.replaceState(null, "", hash); } catch (err) {}
        return;
      }
      return orig.apply(this, arguments);
    };
  });
  try {
    var wanted = window.parent.location.hash;
    if (wanted && !location.hash) history.replaceState(null, "", wanted);
  } catch (err) {}
})();</script>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>FUSION</title>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

  <link
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap"
    rel="stylesheet"
  >

  <style data-src="assets/style.css">
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  }

html,
body {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
margin: 0;
overflow: hidden;
font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
font-weight: 700;
}

body {
background: #090909;
color: #ffffff;
}

/* =========================
BACKGROUND
========================= */

#dark-veil {
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
pointer-events: none;
z-index: 0;
}

.scrim {
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
pointer-events: none;
z-index: 1;
}

/* =========================
MAIN UI
========================= */

.ui {
position: relative;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
display: flex;
z-index: 2;
}

/* =========================
SIDEBAR
========================= */

.rail {
width: 68px;
height: 100%;
flex-shrink: 0;

display: flex;
flex-direction: column;

padding: 12px 9px;

background: rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.88);
border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);

transition:
width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
background 0.28s ease;
}

.rail.expanded {
width: 210px;
}

/* =========================
RAIL GROUPS
========================= */

.rail-group {
width: 100%;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 4px;
}

.rail-top {
width: 100%;
}

.rail-bottom {
width: 100%;
}

/* =========================
FUSION MARK / TOGGLE
========================= */

.rail-mark {
width: 100%;
height: 44px;

display: flex;
align-items: center;

padding: 0 9px;
gap: 10px;

margin: 0;

border: 0;
border-radius: 7px;

background: transparent;
color: #ffffff;

cursor: pointer;

font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 700;
letter-spacing: 0.2px;

transition:
background 0.18s ease,
transform 0.18s ease,
gap 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
margin 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
padding-left 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
padding-right 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.rail-mark:hover {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.rail-mark:active {
transform: scale(0.97);
}

.rail-mark svg {
width: 23px;
height: 23px;

flex-shrink: 0;

fill: none;
stroke: currentColor;
stroke-width: 1.7;
stroke-linecap: round;
stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.rail-mark-icon {
width: 23px;
height: 23px;

flex-shrink: 0;

object-fit: contain;
}

.rail-mark span {
opacity: 0;
max-width: 0;

overflow: hidden;
white-space: nowrap;

/* Collapsing: fade out fast, with no delay, so the label
   never pokes out of the narrowing rail. */
transition:
opacity 0.15s ease,
max-width 0.18s ease;
}

.rail.expanded .rail-mark span {
opacity: 1;
max-width: 160px;

/* Expanding: widen first, then fade the label in once
   there's room for it — keeps the two effects in sync
   instead of the label popping in before the rail grows. */
transition:
opacity 0.2s ease 0.12s,
max-width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* =========================
SIDEBAR BUTTONS
========================= */

.rail-btn {
width: 100%;
height: 40px;

display: flex;
align-items: center;

padding: 0 10px 0 8px;
gap: 10px;
margin: 0;

border: 0;
border-left: 2px solid transparent;
border-radius: 6px;

background: transparent;
color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);

cursor: pointer;

font-size: 13px;
font-weight: 700;

text-align: left;

transition:
background 0.16s ease,
color 0.16s ease,
border-color 0.16s ease,
transform 0.12s ease,
gap 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
margin 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
padding-left 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
padding-right 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.rail-btn:hover {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075);
color: #ffffff;
}

.rail-btn:active {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
transform: scale(0.97);
}

/* Active state: background highlight only, no side accent bar. */
.rail-btn.active {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
color: #ffffff;
}

.rail-btn svg {
width: 20px;
height: 20px;

flex-shrink: 0;

fill: none;
stroke: currentColor;
stroke-width: 1.7;
stroke-linecap: round;
stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.rail-btn span {
opacity: 0;
max-width: 0;

overflow: hidden;
white-space: nowrap;

transition:
opacity 0.15s ease,
max-width 0.18s ease;
}

.rail.expanded .rail-btn span {
opacity: 1;
max-width: 160px;

transition:
opacity 0.2s ease 0.12s,
max-width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* Settings icon uses the same fixed SVG box as every sidebar icon. */
#settings-btn svg {
width: 20px;
height: 20px;
flex: 0 0 20px;
display: block;
}

/* =========================
DIVIDERS
========================= */

.rail-divider {
width: 100%;
height: 1px;

margin: 6px 0;

background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

/* =========================
SPACER
========================= */

.rail-spacer {
flex: 1;
}

/* =========================
TABS
========================= */

.tabs {
width: 100%;

display: flex;
flex-direction: column;

gap: 3px;

margin-top: 3px;

max-height: 42vh;
overflow-y: auto;
overflow-x: hidden;

scrollbar-width: none;
}

.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
display: none;
}

/* Individual tab */

.tab {
width: 100%;
min-height: 38px;

display: flex;
align-items: center;

padding: 0 10px 0 8px;
gap: 10px;
margin: 0;

border: 0;
border-left: 2px solid transparent;
border-radius: 6px;

background: transparent;
color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);

cursor: pointer;

font-size: 13px;
font-weight: 700;

text-align: left;

transition:
background 0.16s ease,
color 0.16s ease,
border-color 0.16s ease,
transform 0.12s ease,
gap 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
margin 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
padding-left 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
padding-right 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.tab:hover {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
color: #ffffff;
}

.tab:active {
transform: scale(0.97);
}

.tab.active {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
color: #ffffff;
}

.tab-icon {
width: 20px;
height: 20px;

flex-shrink: 0;

display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
}

.tab-icon svg {
width: 18px;
height: 18px;

fill: none;
stroke: currentColor;
stroke-width: 1.7;
stroke-linecap: round;
stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.tab-title {
min-width: 0;

flex: 1;
opacity: 1;
max-width: 160px;

overflow: hidden;
text-overflow: ellipsis;
white-space: nowrap;

transition:
opacity 0.15s ease,
max-width 0.18s ease;
}

.rail.expanded .tab-title {
transition:
opacity 0.2s ease 0.12s,
max-width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.tab-close {
width: 20px;
height: 20px;
max-width: 20px;

display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;

flex-shrink: 0;
overflow: hidden;

border: 0;
border-radius: 6px;

background: transparent;
color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);

cursor: pointer;

opacity: 0;

transition:
opacity 0.15s ease,
background 0.15s ease,
color 0.15s ease,
max-width 0.18s ease;
}

.rail.expanded .tab-close {
transition:
opacity 0.15s ease,
background 0.15s ease,
color 0.15s ease,
max-width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.tab:hover .tab-close,
.tab.active .tab-close {
opacity: 1;
}

.tab-close:hover {
background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
color: #ffffff;
}

/* Only ever show the × when the sidebar is expanded — in the
   collapsed rail there's no room for it, and it shouldn't pop
   up on hover/active either. */
.rail:not(.expanded) .tab-close {
opacity: 0 !important;
max-width: 0;
pointer-events: none;
}

.tab-close svg {
width: 14px;
height: 14px;
}

/* =========================
MAIN CONTENT
========================= */

.center {
flex: 1;

min-width: 0;
height: 100%;
min-height: 0;

display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;

padding: 0;

transition:
padding-left 0.25s ease;
}

/* Frosted panel behind EVERY page (same look as Chat / Profile).
   It's a layer on the main area rather than a background on each page,
   so pages stay free to scroll on top of it and fixed overlays inside a
   page (like the game player) still cover the whole window. Pages
   themselves stay transparent — don't add another full-page background. */
.center {
position: relative;
}

.center::before {
content: "";
position: absolute;
inset: 0;
z-index: 0;
pointer-events: none;

background: rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.72);
backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
}

.center > .page {
z-index: 1;
}

/* This keeps the logo and search
centered as one group */

.home-content {
width: min(760px, 92%);

display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
align-items: center;

transform: translateY(-20px);
}

/* =========================
PAGE ROUTER

Only one .page is shown at a time. .page-home is left
content-sized so .center's centering still applies to it;
every other page fills the available space and left-aligns
its own content instead.
========================= */

.page {
width: 100%;
min-width: 0;
min-height: 0;
display: none;
}

.page.active {
display: flex;
animation: page-in 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

@keyframes page-in {
from {
opacity: 0;
transform: translateY(10px);
}
to {
opacity: 1;
transform: translateY(0);
}
}

.page-placeholder {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
min-height: 0;

flex-direction: column;
align-items: flex-start;
justify-content: flex-start;

gap: 6px;

overflow-y: auto;
}

.page-header {
margin: 0;

font-size: 26px;
font-weight: 700;
letter-spacing: -0.5px;

color: #ffffff;
}

.page-subtext {
margin: 0;

font-size: 14px;
color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

/* =========================
WORDMARK
========================= */

.wordmark {
font-size: clamp(52px, 7vw, 82px);

line-height: 1;

font-weight: 700;
letter-spacing: -5px;

color: #ffffff;

text-align: center;

user-select: none;
}

.wordmark-line {
width: 62px;
height: 2px;

margin-top: 14px;
margin-bottom: 25px;

border-radius: 999px;

background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
}

/* =========================
SEARCH
========================= */

.search {
width: 720px;
height: 60px;

display: flex;
align-items: center;

padding: 0 24px;
gap: 15px;

border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
border-radius: 19px;

background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);

box-shadow:
0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);

backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);

transition:
border-color 0.18s ease,
background 0.18s ease,
box-shadow 0.18s ease,
transform 0.18s ease;
}

.search:focus-within {
border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);

background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075);

box-shadow:
0 15px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);

transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.search svg {
width: 23px;
height: 23px;

flex-shrink: 0;

fill: none;
stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
stroke-width: 1.8;
stroke-linecap: round;
stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.search input {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;

padding: 0;

border: 0;
outline: 0;

background: transparent;

color: #ffffff;

font-size: 16px;
font-family: inherit;
}

.search input::placeholder {
color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
}

/* =========================
COLLAPSED SIDEBAR
========================= */

/* Padding is asymmetric on purpose here: .rail-btn/.tab carry a
   2px transparent border-left that eats into the box on the left
   side only, so left/right padding must differ by that 2px for
   the icon (and the hover highlight drawn behind it) to actually
   sit centered. padding is animated above in lockstep with
   width/gap/margin, so the icon glides to center instead of
   snapping there. */
.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-btn,
.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-mark,
.rail:not(.expanded) .tab {
gap: 0;
}

.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-btn,
.rail:not(.expanded) .tab {
padding-left: 7px;
padding-right: 9px;
}

.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-mark {
padding-left: 10.5px;
padding-right: 10.5px;
}

/* Collapsed buttons/tabs were stretching to the full inner rail
   width around a single small icon, which read as an oversized
   hit area. Inset them with a small even margin instead, sized
   so the remaining box sits snugly around the icon. */
.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-btn,
.rail:not(.expanded) .tab {
width: calc(100% - 12px);
margin: 0 6px;
}

.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-mark {
width: calc(100% - 6px);
margin: 0 3px;
}

/* =========================
RESPONSIVE
========================= */

@media (max-width: 700px) {

.rail {
width: 60px;
padding-left: 7px;
padding-right: 7px;
}

.rail.expanded {
width: 190px;
}

.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-btn,
.rail:not(.expanded) .tab {
padding-left: 5px;
padding-right: 7px;
}

.rail:not(.expanded) .rail-mark {
padding-left: 8.5px;
padding-right: 8.5px;
}

.center {
padding: 0;
}

.home-content {
width: 100%;
}

.search {
height: 54px;
}

.wordmark {
font-size: 55px;
}
}

/* =========================================================
   FUSION AI
   ========================================================= */

.ai-page {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    overflow: hidden;

    /* Let the existing Fusion background show through */
    background: transparent;
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   WELCOME
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

.ai-welcome {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    top: 43%;

    width: min(660px, calc(100% - 40px));

    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

    text-align: center;

    transition:
        opacity .25s ease,
        transform .25s ease;
}

.ai-welcome.hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;

    transform:
        translate(-50%, calc(-50% + 15px));
}

.ai-welcome h1 {
    margin: 0 0 30px;

    font-size: clamp(32px, 3vw, 43px);
    font-weight: 650;

    letter-spacing: -.045em;
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   SUGGESTIONS
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

.ai-suggestions {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

    gap: 11px;

    width: 100%;
}

.ai-suggestion {
    min-height: 54px;

    padding: 0 16px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    text-align: left;

    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    border-radius: 5px;

    background: rgba(0,0,0,.08);

    color: rgba(255,255,255,.68);

    font: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        background .2s ease,
        border-color .2s ease,
        color .2s ease,
        transform .2s ease;
}

.ai-suggestion:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.055);

    border-color:
        rgba(255,255,255,.30);

    color: #fff;

    transform: translateY(-1px);
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   MESSAGES
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

.ai-messages {
    flex: 1;

    width: min(820px, calc(100% - 50px));

    margin: 0 auto;

    padding:
        40px 0
        170px;

    overflow-y: auto;
}

.ai-message {
    margin-bottom: 25px;

    animation:
        aiMessageIn .22s ease;
}

.ai-message-inner {
    display: flex;

    align-items: flex-start;

    gap: 11px;
}

.ai-message-user {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
}

.ai-message-user .ai-message-inner {
    max-width: 75%;
}

.ai-message-text {
    padding: 11px 15px;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.ai-message-user .ai-message-text {
    border-radius:
        15px
        15px
        4px
        15px;

    background:
        rgba(255,255,255,.085);
}

.ai-message-assistant .ai-message-text {
    padding-top: 6px;
}

.ai-message-avatar {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;

    flex-shrink: 0;

    display: grid;
    place-items: center;

    border-radius: 9px;

    background:
        rgba(255,255,255,.06);

    border:
        1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}

.ai-message-avatar span {
    width: 9px;
    height: 9px;

    transform: rotate(45deg);

    background: #a477ff;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 10px rgba(164,119,255,.5);
}

@keyframes aiMessageIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(5px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   THINKING
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

.ai-thinking-dots {
    display: flex;

    gap: 4px;

    padding: 12px 5px;
}

.ai-thinking-dots i {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: currentColor;

    opacity: .3;

    animation:
        aiDot 1.1s infinite ease-in-out;
}

.ai-thinking-dots i:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: .15s;
}

.ai-thinking-dots i:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: .3s;
}

@keyframes aiDot {
    0%, 60%, 100% {
        opacity: .25;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }

    30% {
        opacity: .8;
        transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   COMPOSER
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

.ai-composer-area {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    bottom: 18px;

    width: min(890px, calc(100% - 50px));

    transform: translateX(-50%);

    z-index: 5;
}

.ai-composer {
    padding: 12px 10px 9px 14px;

    border-radius: 7px;

    background:
        rgba(20,20,23,.72);

    border:
        1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);

    box-shadow:
        0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.20);

    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
}

.ai-composer textarea {
    display: block;

    width: 100%;

    min-height: 24px;
    max-height: 150px;

    resize: none;

    padding: 0 0 10px;

    border: 0;
    outline: 0;

    background: transparent;

    color: inherit;

    font: inherit;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 22px;
}

.ai-composer textarea::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.38);
}

.ai-composer-bottom {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;
}

.ai-composer-tools {
    display: flex;

    gap: 3px;
}

.ai-tool {
    width: 29px;
    height: 29px;

    display: grid;
    place-items: center;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 6px;

    background: transparent;

    color:
        rgba(255,255,255,.48);

    cursor: pointer;
}

.ai-tool:hover {
    background:
        rgba(255,255,255,.07);

    color: #fff;
}

.ai-tool svg {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;

    fill: none;

    stroke: currentColor;

    stroke-width: 1.6;

    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.ai-send {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;

    display: grid;
    place-items: center;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 4px;

    background:
        rgba(255,255,255,.72);

    color: #111;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition: .2s ease;
}

.ai-send:hover {
    background: #fff;
}

.ai-send svg {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;

    fill: none;

    stroke: currentColor;

    stroke-width: 1.8;

    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.ai-disclaimer {
    margin-top: 7px;

    text-align: center;

    font-size: 10px;

    color:
        rgba(255,255,255,.27);
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   MOBILE
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 700px) {

    .ai-welcome {
        width: calc(100% - 30px);
    }

    .ai-welcome h1 {
        font-size: 30px;
    }

    .ai-suggestions {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .ai-messages {
        width: calc(100% - 30px);
    }

    .ai-composer-area {
        width: calc(100% - 30px);
        bottom: 10px;
    }
}

/* =========================================================
   FUSION NOTIFICATIONS
   ========================================================= */

#fusion-notification-container {
    position: fixed;
    right: 20px;
    bottom: 20px;

    width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 40px));

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 10px;

    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 999999;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTIFICATION
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification {
    --notification-opacity: 0.9;
    --notification-blur: 18px;
    --notification-radius: 15px;

    --notification-enter-duration: 280ms;
    --notification-exit-duration: 180ms;

    --notification-color: #695cfe;
    --notification-color-soft: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.16);
    --notification-duration: 5000ms;

    position: relative;

    /* Fixed notification size */
    width: 380px;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 40px);

    pointer-events: auto;

    overflow: hidden;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035),
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.012)
        ),
        rgba(18, 18, 21, var(--notification-opacity));

    backdrop-filter: blur(var(--notification-blur));
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--notification-blur));

    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--notification-color);
    border-radius: var(--notification-radius);

    box-shadow:
        0 12px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28),
        0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18),
        0 0 30px -12px var(--notification-color-soft);

    color: #fff;

    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

    animation:
        fusionNotificationIn
        var(--notification-enter-duration)
        cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)
        both;
}


/* =========================================================
   ENTER ANIMATION
   ========================================================= */

@keyframes fusionNotificationIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translate3d(45px, 0, 0);
    }

    100% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   EXIT ANIMATION
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification.is-removing {
    pointer-events: none;

    animation:
        fusionNotificationOut
        var(--notification-exit-duration)
        cubic-bezier(.4, 0, 1, 1)
        forwards;
}

@keyframes fusionNotificationOut {
    0% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    }

    100% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translate3d(500px, 0, 0);
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   DISABLE OLD ACCENT STRIP
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-accent {
    display: none !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTIFICATION INNER
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;

    padding: 14px 16px;

    gap: 12px;
}


/* =========================================================
   ICON
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-icon {
    flex: 0 0 auto;

    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    margin-top: 1px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 9px;

    background: var(--notification-color-soft);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--notification-color) 32%, transparent);
}

.fusion-notification-icon svg {
    width: 17px;
    height: 17px;

    stroke: var(--notification-color);
    stroke-width: 2.25;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.fusion-notification-spin {
    transform-origin: 12px 12px;
    animation: fusionNotificationSpin 0.85s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes fusionNotificationSpin {
    to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   CONTENT
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-content {
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1;

    padding-top: 2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   TITLE
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-title {
    margin-bottom: 3px;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.3;
    font-weight: 650;

    color: #fff;
}


/* =========================================================
   MESSAGE
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-message {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.45;

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);

    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}


/*
   Notifications without titles get slightly larger
   message text.
*/

.fusion-notification-no-title
.fusion-notification-message {
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    font-weight: 500;

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
}


/* =========================================================
   CLOSE BUTTON
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-close {
    position: relative;

    flex: 0 0 auto;

    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;

    margin: -2px -3px 0 0;

    padding: 0;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 7px;

    background: transparent;

    cursor: pointer;

    opacity: 0.55;

    transition:
        opacity 140ms ease,
        background 140ms ease;
}


/* X */

.fusion-notification-close::before,
.fusion-notification-close::after {
    content: "";

    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;

    width: 11px;
    height: 1.5px;

    background: #fff;

    border-radius: 999px;
}

.fusion-notification-close::before {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg);
}

.fusion-notification-close::after {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-45deg);
}


/* Hover */

.fusion-notification-close:hover {
    opacity: 0.95;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}


/* Active */

.fusion-notification-close:active {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}


/* Keyboard focus */

.fusion-notification-close:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.55);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTIFICATION TYPES
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-success {
    --notification-color: #22c55e;
    --notification-color-soft: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.16);
}

.fusion-notification-error {
    --notification-color: #ef4444;
    --notification-color-soft: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.16);
}

.fusion-notification-warning {
    --notification-color: #f59e0b;
    --notification-color-soft: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.16);
}

.fusion-notification-info {
    /* Brand purple — matches the rest of FUSION's accent color. */
    --notification-color: #695cfe;
    --notification-color-soft: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.16);
}

.fusion-notification-neutral {
    --notification-color: #a1a1aa;
    --notification-color-soft: rgba(161, 161, 170, 0.14);
}

.fusion-notification-loading {
    --notification-color: #695cfe;
    --notification-color-soft: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.16);
}


/* =========================================================
   PROGRESS BAR
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-progress {
    position: absolute;

    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;

    height: 2px;

    background: var(--notification-color);

    transform-origin: left center;

    animation:
        fusionNotificationProgress
        var(--notification-duration)
        linear
        forwards;
}


@keyframes fusionNotificationProgress {
    0% {
        transform: scaleX(1);
    }

    100% {
        transform: scaleX(0);
    }
}


/* Loading notifications don't use progress */

.fusion-notification-loading
.fusion-notification-progress {
    display: none;
}


/* =========================================================
   LOADING ANIMATION
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notification-loading::after {
    content: "";

    position: absolute;

    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;

    width: 35%;
    height: 2px;

    background: var(--notification-color);

    animation:
        fusionNotificationLoading
        1.1s ease-in-out
        infinite;
}


@keyframes fusionNotificationLoading {
    0% {
        transform: translateX(-100%);
    }

    50% {
        transform: translateX(185%);
    }

    100% {
        transform: translateX(300%);
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE / MODAL CONTAINER
   ========================================================= */

#fusion-notice-container {
    position: fixed;

    inset: 0;

    z-index: 1000000;

    pointer-events: none;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE OVERLAY
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-overlay {
    position: fixed;

    inset: 0;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    padding: 24px;

    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.62);

    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);

    pointer-events: auto;

    animation:
        fusionNoticeOverlayIn
        180ms
        ease
        both;
}


@keyframes fusionNoticeOverlayIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE OVERLAY EXIT
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-overlay-removing {
    animation:
        fusionNoticeOverlayOut
        180ms
        ease
        forwards;
}


@keyframes fusionNoticeOverlayOut {
    from {
        opacity: 1;
    }

    to {
        opacity: 0;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice {
    --notice-width: 560px;

    position: relative;

    width: var(--notice-width);
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 48px);

    overflow-y: auto;

    padding: 34px;

    background: rgba(20, 20, 22, 0.88);

    backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);

    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

    border-radius: 22px;

    box-shadow:
        0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42),
        0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22),
        0 0 60px -22px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.35);

    color: #fff;

    animation:
        fusionNoticeIn
        220ms
        cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)
        both;
}


@keyframes fusionNoticeIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;

        transform:
            translateY(14px)
            scale(0.985);
    }

    100% {
        opacity: 1;

        transform:
            translateY(0)
            scale(1);
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE SIZES
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-small {
    --notice-width: 430px;
}

.fusion-notice-medium {
    --notice-width: 560px;
}

.fusion-notice-large {
    --notice-width: 720px;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE LOGO
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-logo {
    display: block;

    width: auto;
    height: 32px;

    max-width: 180px;

    margin-bottom: 20px;

    object-fit: contain;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.32));
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE TITLE
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-title {
    margin: 0;

    font-size: 27px;
    line-height: 1.15;

    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: -0.025em;

    color: #fff;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE SUBTITLE
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-subtitle {
    margin-top: 7px;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.4;

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE MESSAGE
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-message {
    margin-top: 20px;

    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.65;

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE SECTIONS
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-sections {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 20px;

    margin-top: 24px;
}


.fusion-notice-section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 8px;
}


.fusion-notice-section-title {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.3;

    font-weight: 650;

    color: #fff;
}


.fusion-notice-section-message {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.55;

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66);
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE LIST
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 8px;

    margin: 4px 0 0;
    padding: 0;

    list-style: none;
}


.fusion-notice-list li {
    position: relative;

    padding-left: 17px;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.55;

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
}


.fusion-notice-list li::before {
    content: "";

    position: absolute;

    left: 2px;
    top: 0.7em;

    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;

    transform: translateY(-50%);

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE ACTIONS
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-actions {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;

    gap: 10px;

    margin-top: 30px;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE BUTTONS
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice-button {
    min-height: 42px;

    padding: 0 18px;

    border-radius: 11px;

    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

    font-family: inherit;

    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        transform 140ms ease,
        background 140ms ease,
        opacity 140ms ease;
}


/* Primary */

.fusion-notice-button-primary {
    background: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.86);
    border-color: rgba(135, 125, 255, 0.65);

    color: #fff;

    box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(69, 56, 190, 0.28);
}


.fusion-notice-button-primary:hover {
    background: rgba(118, 105, 255, 0.94);

    transform: translateY(-1px);
}


.fusion-notice-button-primary:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
}


/* Secondary */

.fusion-notice-button-secondary {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}


.fusion-notice-button-secondary:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);

    transform: translateY(-1px);
}


.fusion-notice-button-secondary:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
}


/* Focus */

.fusion-notice-button:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.55);

    outline-offset: 2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOTICE SCROLLBAR
   ========================================================= */

.fusion-notice::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 6px;
}

.fusion-notice::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
}

.fusion-notice::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);

    border-radius: 999px;
}

.fusion-notice::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}


/* =========================================================
   PAGE LOCK WHEN NOTICE IS OPEN
   ========================================================= */

html.fusion-notice-open,
body.fusion-notice-open {
    overflow: hidden;
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 600px) {

    #fusion-notification-container {
        right: 12px;
        bottom: 12px;

        width: calc(100vw - 24px);
    }


    .fusion-notification {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
    }


    .fusion-notice-overlay {
        padding: 12px;
    }


    .fusion-notice {
        width: 100%;
        max-height: calc(100vh - 24px);

        padding: 25px;

        border-radius: 18px;
    }


    .fusion-notice-title {
        font-size: 24px;
    }


    .fusion-notice-actions {
        flex-direction: column-reverse;

        align-items: stretch;
    }


    .fusion-notice-button {
        width: 100%;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   REDUCED MOTION
   ========================================================= */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

    .fusion-notification,
    .fusion-notification.is-removing,
    .fusion-notification-progress,
    .fusion-notification-loading::after,
    .fusion-notice-overlay,
    .fusion-notice-overlay-removing,
    .fusion-notice {
        animation-duration: 1ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    }

    .fusion-notification-close,
    .fusion-notice-button {
        transition: none;
    }
}
/* =========================================================
   FUSION UI REFINEMENT
   ========================================================= */

html,
body,
button,
input,
textarea,
select {
    font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

body {
    font-weight: 500;
}

.rail-btn,
.rail-mark {
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.1px;
}

.rail-btn svg,
.rail-mark svg {
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.rail-btn.active {
    background: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.16);
    color: #ffffff;
}

.rail-btn.active svg {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.35));
}

.page-placeholder {
    padding: 0;
}

.simple-page {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 18px 12px;
}

.simple-page .page-header {
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.8px;
}

/* Dedicated Home */
.page-home {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.fusion-home {
    position: relative;
    width: min(900px, 100%);
    min-height: 520px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 28px;
}

.fusion-home-glow {
    position: absolute;
    width: 440px;
    height: 440px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(105,92,254,.18) 0%, rgba(105,92,254,0) 68%);
    filter: blur(10px);
    pointer-events: none;
}

.fusion-home-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: min(680px, 92%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
}

.fusion-home-logo {
    width: 92px;
    height: 92px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(105,92,254,.28));
}

.fusion-home-kicker {
    margin: 0 0 9px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.46);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: .22em;
}

.fusion-home h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 58px);
    line-height: 1.05;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -2.5px;
}

.fusion-home-subtext {
    max-width: 570px;
    margin: 18px 0 28px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.56);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.fusion-home-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
}

.home-action {
    height: 46px;
    padding: 0 18px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 9px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
    border-radius: 13px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.055);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.84);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform .16s ease, background .16s ease, border-color .16s ease;
}

.home-action:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.09);
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    color: #fff;
}

.home-action.primary {
    background: rgba(105,92,254,.86);
    border-color: rgba(135,125,255,.65);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(69,56,190,.24);
}

.home-action.primary:hover {
    background: rgba(118,105,255,.94);
}

.home-action svg {
    width: 17px;
    height: 17px;
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
    .fusion-home {
        min-height: 420px;
    }

    .fusion-home-actions {
        width: 100%;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .home-action {
        width: min(280px, 100%);
    }
}

/* =========================
   FULLSCREEN GAME VIEWER
========================= */

body.fusion-game-open {
    overflow: hidden !important;
}

// assets/pages/404.js
//
// FUSION 404 / "page not found" view.
//
// Rendered by the router (assets/router.js) whenever a hash doesn't
// match any real page container — instead of silently bouncing the
// visitor back to Home, they land here and can choose where to go.

function render(container) {
    container.style.height = "100%";
    container.style.minHeight = "0";
    container.style.overflowY = "auto";
    container.style.overflowX = "hidden";

    const attempted = window.location.hash.replace(/^#/, "").trim();

    container.innerHTML = `
        <style>
            .fusion-404-page {
                position: relative;

                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;
                min-height: 100%;

                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                overflow: hidden;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding: 40px 20px;
            }

            .fusion-404-ambient {
                position: absolute;
                inset: 0;
                z-index: 0;
                pointer-events: none;
                overflow: hidden;
            }

            .fusion-404-blob {
                position: absolute;

                border-radius: 50%;
                filter: blur(90px);
                opacity: .5;

                animation: fusion-404-drift 17s ease-in-out infinite;
            }

            .fusion-404-blob-a {
                top: -140px;
                left: 12%;

                width: 380px;
                height: 380px;

                background: rgba(105, 92, 254, .32);
            }

            .fusion-404-blob-b {
                bottom: -160px;
                right: 10%;

                width: 340px;
                height: 340px;

                background: rgba(255, 92, 180, .12);

                animation-delay: -9s;
                animation-duration: 21s;
            }

            @keyframes fusion-404-drift {
                0%, 100% {
                    transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
                }
                50% {
                    transform: translate(24px, -18px) scale(1.06);
                }
            }

            .fusion-404-content {
                position: relative;
                z-index: 1;

                width: min(520px, 100%);

                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: center;
                text-align: center;

                animation: fusion-404-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
            }

            @keyframes fusion-404-in {
                from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
                to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
            }

            .fusion-404-logo {
                display: block;

                height: 26px;
                width: auto;
                max-width: 100%;

                object-fit: contain;

                margin-bottom: 28px;
                opacity: .9;

                filter: drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.28));
            }

            .fusion-404-code {
                margin: 0;

                font-size: clamp(64px, 12vw, 96px);
                font-weight: 800;
                line-height: 1;
                letter-spacing: -3px;

                background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.5) 100%);
                -webkit-background-clip: text;
                background-clip: text;
                color: transparent;
            }

            .fusion-404-heading {
                margin: 14px 0 0;

                color: #fff;
                font-size: clamp(20px, 3vw, 24px);
                font-weight: 700;
                letter-spacing: -0.4px;
            }

            .fusion-404-subtext {
                margin: 10px 0 0;
                max-width: 400px;

                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
                font-size: 14px;
                line-height: 1.6;
            }

            .fusion-404-subtext code {
                padding: 1px 6px;

                border-radius: 6px;
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
                font-size: 13px;
            }

            .fusion-404-actions {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                gap: 10px;

                margin-top: 30px;
            }

            .fusion-404-btn {
                position: relative;

                display: inline-flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                gap: 9px;

                min-height: 45px;
                padding: 0 24px;

                border-radius: 10px;

                font: inherit;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 650;

                cursor: pointer;

                overflow: hidden;

                transition:
                    transform .18s ease,
                    background .18s ease,
                    border-color .18s ease,
                    box-shadow .18s ease;
            }

            .fusion-404-btn svg {
                width: 16px;
                height: 16px;

                fill: none;
                stroke: currentColor;
                stroke-width: 1.9;
                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            .fusion-404-btn-primary {
                border: 1px solid rgba(105, 92, 254, .6);
                background: rgba(105, 92, 254, .92);
                color: #fff;

                box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(105, 92, 254, .2);
            }

            .fusion-404-btn-primary:hover {
                transform: translateY(-2px);
                background: #7569ff;
                border-color: #8278ff;
                box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(105, 92, 254, .28);
            }

            .fusion-404-btn-primary:active {
                transform: translateY(0);
            }

            .fusion-404-btn-secondary {
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .045);
                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
            }

            .fusion-404-btn-secondary:hover {
                transform: translateY(-2px);
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
                border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
                color: #fff;
            }

            .fusion-404-btn-secondary:active {
                transform: translateY(0);
            }

            @media (max-width: 480px) {
                .fusion-404-actions {
                    flex-direction: column;
                    width: 100%;
                }

                .fusion-404-btn {
                    width: 100%;
                }
            }
        </style>

        <div class="fusion-404-page">

            <div class="fusion-404-ambient" aria-hidden="true">
                <span class="fusion-404-blob fusion-404-blob-a"></span>
                <span class="fusion-404-blob fusion-404-blob-b"></span>
            </div>

            <div class="fusion-404-content">

                <img
                    src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"
                    alt="FUSION"
                    class="fusion-404-logo"
                >

                <p class="fusion-404-code">404</p>

                <h1 class="fusion-404-heading">This page doesn't exist</h1>

                <p class="fusion-404-subtext">
                    ${
                        attempted
                            ? `We couldn't find <code>#${escapeHTML(attempted)}</code>. It may have been moved or never existed.`
                            : `We couldn't find the page you were looking for.`
                    }
                </p>

                <div class="fusion-404-actions">

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="fusion-404-btn fusion-404-btn-primary"
                        data-404-action="home"
                    >
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M15 21v-8a1 1 0 0 0-1-1h-4a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v8"></path>
                            <path d="M3 10a2 2 0 0 1 .709-1.528l7-6a2 2 0 0 1 2.582 0l7 6A2 2 0 0 1 21 10v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        Back to Home
                    </button>

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="fusion-404-btn fusion-404-btn-secondary"
                        data-404-action="games"
                    >
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                            <line x1="6" x2="10" y1="11" y2="11"></line>
                            <line x1="8" x2="8" y1="9" y2="13"></line>
                            <line x1="15" x2="15.01" y1="12" y2="12"></line>
                            <line x1="18" x2="18.01" y1="10" y2="10"></line>
                            <path d="M17.32 5H6.68a4 4 0 0 0-3.978 3.59c-.006.052-.01.101-.017.152C2.604 9.416 2 14.456 2 16a3 3 0 0 0 3 3c1 0 1.5-.5 2-1l1.414-1.414A2 2 0 0 1 9.828 16h4.344a2 2 0 0 1 1.414.586L17 18c.5.5 1 1 2 1a3 3 0 0 0 3-3c0-1.545-.604-6.584-.685-7.258-.007-.05-.011-.1-.017-.151A4 4 0 0 0 17.32 5z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        Browse Games
                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>
    `;

    function escapeHTML(value) {
        return String(value)
            .replace(/&/g, "&")
            .replace(/</g, "<")
            .replace(/>/g, ">")
            .replace(/"/g, """);
    }

    container.querySelectorAll("[data-404-action]").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
            window.FusionNavigate?.(button.dataset["404Action"]);
        });
    });
}
;return { render };

});

</script>

                        <button class="fusion-account-link-btn" id="account-show-signup" type="button">Create one</button>
                    </div>

                </section>

                <\!-- SIGN UP -->
                <section class="fusion-account-view hidden" id="account-signup-view">

                    <div class="fusion-account-heading">
                        <h1>Create your account</h1>
                        <p>Join FUSION and get started.</p>
                    </div>

                    <form id="account-signup-form">

                        <div class="fusion-account-field">
                            <label for="account-signup-username">Username</label>
                            <input
                                id="account-signup-username"
                                type="text"
                                autocomplete="username"
                                placeholder="Choose a username"
                                required
                            >
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-account-field">
                            <label for="account-signup-email">Email</label>
                            <input
                                id="account-signup-email"
                                type="email"
                                autocomplete="email"
                                placeholder="you@example.com"
                                required
                            >
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-account-field">
                            <label for="account-signup-password">Password</label>
                            <input
                                id="account-signup-password"
                                type="password"
                                autocomplete="new-password"
                                placeholder="Create a password"
                                required
                            >
                        </div>


                        <div class="fusion-account-error" id="account-signup-error"></div>

                        <button class="fusion-account-primary-btn" id="account-signup-button" type="submit">
                            Create account
                        </button>

                    </form>

                    <div class="fusion-account-switch">
                        Already have an account?
                        <button class="fusion-account-link-btn" id="account-show-signin" type="button">Sign in</button>
                    </div>

                </section>

                <\!-- VERIFICATION -->
                <section class="fusion-account-view hidden" id="account-verification-view">

                    <div class="fusion-account-icon">✉</div>

                    <div class="fusion-account-heading">
                        <h1>Check your email</h1>
                        <p>We sent a verification code to <strong id="account-verification-email">your email</strong>.</p>
                    </div>

                    <form id="account-verification-form">

                        <div class="fusion-account-field">
                            <label for="account-verification-code">Verification code</label>
                            <input
                                id="account-verification-code"
                                type="text"
                                inputmode="numeric"
                                autocomplete="one-time-code"
                                placeholder="Enter your code"
                                maxlength="6"
                                required
                            >
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-account-error" id="account-verification-error"></div>

                        <button class="fusion-account-primary-btn" id="account-verification-button" type="submit">
                            Verify email
                        </button>

                    </form>

                    <button class="fusion-account-secondary-btn" id="account-back-to-signup" type="button">Back</button>

                </section>

            </div>

            <div class="fusion-account-loading" id="account-loading">
                <div class="fusion-account-loader"></div>
            </div>

        </div>
    `;

    initAccountPage(container);
}

/* ======================================================
   PAGE LOGIC
====================================================== */

function initAccountPage(container) {
    const signinView = container.querySelector("#account-signin-view");
    const signupView = container.querySelector("#account-signup-view");
    const verificationView = container.querySelector("#account-verification-view");
    const loadingScreen = container.querySelector("#account-loading");

    function showOnly(view) {
        [signinView, signupView, verificationView].forEach(element => element?.classList.add("hidden"));
        view?.classList.remove("hidden");
    }

    function showError(element, message) {
        if (element) element.textContent = message || "";
    }

    function setButtonLoading(button, loading, loadingText, defaultText) {
        if (!button) return;
        if (loading) {
            button.disabled = true;
            button.dataset.defaultText = defaultText || button.textContent;
            button.textContent = loadingText || "Please wait...";
        } else {
            button.disabled = false;
            button.textContent = button.dataset.defaultText || defaultText || "Continue";
        }
    }

    function goToSignedInDestination() {
        window.FusionNavigate?.(window.FusionAuth?.consumeRedirectTarget("profile") || "profile");
    }

    container.querySelector("#account-show-signup")?.addEventListener("click", () => showOnly(signupView));
    container.querySelector("#account-show-signin")?.addEventListener("click", () => showOnly(signinView));
    container.querySelector("#account-back-to-signup")?.addEventListener("click", () => showOnly(signupView));

    container.querySelector("#account-signin-form")?.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#account-signin-error");
        const button = container.querySelector("#account-signin-button");
        showError(errorElement, "");
        setButtonLoading(button, true, "Signing in...", "Sign in");
        try {
            await window.FusionAuth.signIn({
                email: container.querySelector("#account-signin-email")?.value,
                password: container.querySelector("#account-signin-password")?.value
            });
            goToSignedInDestination();
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't sign in.");
        } finally {
            setButtonLoading(button, false, "Signing in...", "Sign in");
        }
    });

    container.querySelector("#account-signup-form")?.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#account-signup-error");
        const button = container.querySelector("#account-signup-button");
        showError(errorElement, "");
        setButtonLoading(button, true, "Creating...", "Create account");
        try {
            await window.FusionAuth.signUp({
                username: container.querySelector("#account-signup-username")?.value,
                email: container.querySelector("#account-signup-email")?.value,
                password: container.querySelector("#account-signup-password")?.value
            });
            window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Account created.");
            goToSignedInDestination();
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't create your account.");
        } finally {
            setButtonLoading(button, false, "Creating...", "Create account");
        }
    });

    container.querySelector("#account-verification-form")?.addEventListener("submit", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        goToSignedInDestination();
    });

    (async () => {
        if (window.FusionAuth?.isSignedIn()) {
            goToSignedInDestination();
            return;
        }
        showOnly(signinView);
        loadingScreen?.classList.add("hidden");
    })();
}


;return { render };

});

</script>

// assets/pages/chat.js
// FUSION Chat: direct messages and groups, live through Convex.
//
// Function-call budget (the server half is convex/chat.ts):
//   - ONE live subscription (`chat:sync`) carries the conversation list and the open chat together,
//     so a new message refreshes a single query per person. A DM costs 3 calls in total:
//     the send, plus one refresh for each of the two people watching.
//   - It exists only while this page is showing AND the tab is visible; a few seconds after you
//     leave, the connection closes, so nothing runs in the background.
//   - Nothing is polled. "Read" state lives in this browser (zero calls).
//   - The conversation list is cached locally so re-opening the page paints instantly.

function render(container) {
    container.innerHTML = `
        <style>
            .fchat {
                --fc-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
                --fc-line-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
                --fc-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
                --fc-surface-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075);
                --fc-text: #f4f4f7;
                --fc-muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
                --fc-faint: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.36);
                --fc-accent: #695cfe;
                --fc-accent-hover: #7b70ff;
                --fc-accent-soft: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.14);
                --fc-r: 8px;      /* the main corner radius */
                --fc-r-sm: 5px;
                --fc-r-lg: 12px;  /* composer and dialogs */

                position: relative;
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;
                min-height: 0;
                display: flex;
                overflow: hidden;
                color: var(--fc-text);
                font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
                -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            }

            .fchat *, .fchat *::before, .fchat *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
            .fchat button, .fchat input, .fchat textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
            .fchat button { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
            .fchat [hidden] { display: none !important; }
            .fchat :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fc-accent-hover); outline-offset: 2px; }
            .fchat input:focus-visible, .fchat textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; }
            .fchat ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
            .fchat ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 4px; }
            .fchat ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); }
            .fchat ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }

            /* ---------- Buttons ---------- */

            .fchat-icon-btn {
                width: 34px; height: 34px;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                display: grid; place-items: center;
                border-radius: var(--fc-r);
                color: var(--fc-muted);
                transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
            }
            .fchat-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--fc-surface-hover); color: var(--fc-text); }
            .fchat-icon-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

            .fchat-btn {
                height: 36px; padding: 0 18px;
                border-radius: var(--fc-r);
                border: 1px solid var(--fc-line-strong);
                background: var(--fc-surface);
                font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
                transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
            }
            .fchat-btn:hover { background: var(--fc-surface-hover); }
            .fchat-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
            .fchat-btn.primary { background: var(--fc-accent); border-color: var(--fc-accent); color: #fff; }

            .fchat-btn.danger { color: #ff8f8f; border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3); }
            .fchat-btn.danger:hover { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.14); }
            .fchat-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; transform: none; }

            /* ---------- Avatars ---------- */

            .fchat-avatar {

                overflow: hidden; user-select: none;
            }

            /* ---------- Sidebar ---------- */

            .fchat-side {

            }

            }
            .fchat-side-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fc-muted); }

            .fchat-new {
                display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;

            }
            .fchat-new:hover { background: var(--fc-accent-hover); }

            .fchat-filter { padding: 12px 14px; }

                transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
            }
            .fchat-filter input::placeholder { color: var(--fc-faint); }

            .fchat-list { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 0 8px; }

            .fchat-conv-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

            .fchat-menu-btn { display: none; }
            .fchat-head-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
            .fchat-head-title { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.2px; }
            .fchat-head-sub { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; margin-top: 1px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fc-muted); }

            .fchat-jump {

            .fchat-empty-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

            /* ---------- Composer ---------- */

            .fchat-composer-area { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 8px clamp(16px, 4vw, 48px) 18px; }
            .fchat-composer {
                position: relative;
