                padding: 5px 5px 5px 16px;
                border-radius: var(--fc-r-lg);
                border: 1px solid var(--fc-line-strong);
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
                transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
            }
            .fchat-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--fc-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--fc-accent-soft); }
            .fchat-composer textarea {
                flex: 1; min-width: 0;
                max-height: 150px;
                height: 38px; padding: 9px 0;
                display: block;
                border: 0; outline: 0; resize: none;
                background: transparent;
                font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px;
            }
            .fchat-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--fc-faint); }
            .fchat-send {
                width: 38px; height: 38px;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                display: grid; place-items: center;
                border-radius: var(--fc-r);
                background: var(--fc-accent);
                color: #fff;
                transition: background 0.15s, opacity 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
            }
            .fchat-send:hover { background: var(--fc-accent-hover); }
            .fchat-send:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
            .fchat-send:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: default; transform: none; }
            .fchat-send svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
            .fchat-count { position: absolute; right: 52px; top: -22px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fc-faint); }
            .fchat-count.over { color: #ff8f8f; }

            /* ---------- Dialog ---------- */

            .fchat-backdrop {
                position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 20;
                display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
                padding: 16px;
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
                backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            }
            .fchat-backdrop.open { display: flex; }
            .fchat-dialog {
                width: min(440px, 100%);
                max-height: 100%;
                overflow-y: auto;
                padding: 24px;
                border-radius: var(--fc-r-lg);
                border: 1px solid var(--fc-line-strong);
                background: #16161a;
                box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
            }
            .fchat-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.3px; }
            .fchat-dialog-lead { margin: 0 0 18px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--fc-muted); }

            .fchat-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; margin-bottom: 20px; border-radius: var(--fc-r); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); border: 1px solid var(--fc-line); }
            .fchat-tab { flex: 1; height: 34px; border-radius: var(--fc-r-sm); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fc-muted); transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s; }
            .fchat-tab:hover { color: var(--fc-text); }
            .fchat-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--fc-accent); color: #fff; }

            .fchat-field { display: block; margin-bottom: 16px; }
            .fchat-field > span { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fc-muted); }
            .fchat-field input, .fchat-chips {
                width: 100%; min-height: 42px;
                padding: 0 12px;
                border-radius: var(--fc-r);
                border: 1px solid var(--fc-line-strong);
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
                font-size: 14px;
                outline: none;
                transition: border-color 0.15s;
            }
            .fchat-field input { height: 42px; }
            .fchat-field input:focus, .fchat-chips:focus-within { border-color: var(--fc-accent); }
            .fchat-field input::placeholder { color: var(--fc-faint); }
            .fchat-hint { margin: 7px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fc-faint); }

            .fchat-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; }
            .fchat-chips input { flex: 1; min-width: 110px; height: 28px; min-height: 0; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; background: transparent; }
            .fchat-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 26px; padding: 0 4px 0 10px; border-radius: var(--fc-r-sm); border: 1px solid rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.35); background: var(--fc-accent-soft); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; }
            .fchat-chip button { width: 18px; height: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--fc-muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }
            .fchat-chip button:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); color: var(--fc-text); }

            .fchat-error { min-height: 18px; margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 12.5px; color: #ff8f8f; }
            .fchat-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; }

            .fchat-people { margin: 0 0 18px; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--fc-line); }
            .fchat-person { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fc-line); }
            .fchat-person-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
            .fchat-person-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
            .fchat-person-user { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fc-muted); }
            .fchat-tag { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--fc-r-sm); border: 1px solid var(--fc-line-strong); background: var(--fc-surface-hover); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fc-muted); }

            /* ---------- Small screens ---------- */

            @media (max-width: 760px) {
                .fchat-side {
                    position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; z-index: 10;
                    width: min(320px, 88%);
                    background: #111114;
                    transform: translateX(-102%);
                    transition: transform 0.22s ease;
                }
                .fchat-side.open { transform: translateX(0); box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); }
                .fchat-menu-btn { display: grid; }
                .fchat-head { padding-left: 12px; }
                .fchat-run-main { max-width: 84%; }
            }

            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
                .fchat * { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; }
            }
        </style>

        <div class="fchat" id="fchat-root">

            <aside class="fchat-side" id="fchat-side" aria-label="Conversations">
                <div class="fchat-side-head">
                    <div class="fchat-side-title">Messages</div>
                    <button type="button" class="fchat-new" id="fchat-new">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14"/><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg>
                        New
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div class="fchat-filter">
                    <input type="search" id="fchat-filter" placeholder="Search your chats" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search your chats">
                </div>

                <div class="fchat-list" id="fchat-list"></div>

                <div class="fchat-user">
                    <div class="fchat-avatar s36" id="fchat-user-avatar">U</div>
                    <div class="fchat-user-text">
                        <div class="fchat-user-name fchat-named" id="fchat-user-name">User</div>
                        <div class="fchat-user-handle" id="fchat-user-handle"></div>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="fchat-icon-btn" id="fchat-edit-name" aria-label="Edit profile" title="Edit profile">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </aside>

            <section class="fchat-main">
                <header class="fchat-head">
                    <button type="button" class="fchat-icon-btn fchat-menu-btn" id="fchat-menu" aria-label="Show conversations">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16"/><path d="M4 12h16"/><path d="M4 18h16"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <div id="fchat-head-avatar"></div>
                    <div class="fchat-head-text">
                        <div class="fchat-head-title fchat-named" id="fchat-title">Messages</div>
                        <div class="fchat-head-sub" id="fchat-sub"></div>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="fchat-icon-btn" id="fchat-info" aria-label="Conversation details" title="Details" hidden>
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v5"/><path d="M12 8h.01"/></svg>
                    </button>
                </header>

                <div class="fchat-scroll">
                    <div class="fchat-messages" id="fchat-messages" role="log" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Messages"></div>
                    <button type="button" class="fchat-jump" id="fchat-jump" hidden>New messages</button>
                </div>

                <div class="fchat-composer-area" id="fchat-composer-area" hidden>
                    <div class="fchat-composer">
                        <span class="fchat-count" id="fchat-count" hidden></span>
                        <textarea id="fchat-input" rows="1" placeholder="Write a message" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Message"></textarea>
                        <button type="button" class="fchat-send" id="fchat-send" aria-label="Send message" title="Send" disabled>
                            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 19V5"/><path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7"/></svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <div class="fchat-backdrop" id="fchat-backdrop">
                <div class="fchat-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" id="fchat-dialog"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Setup                                                              */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    const $ = selector => container.querySelector(selector);
    const root = $("#fchat-root");
    const side = $("#fchat-side");
    const listEl = $("#fchat-list");
    const filterEl = $("#fchat-filter");
    const messagesEl = $("#fchat-messages");
    const jumpBtn = $("#fchat-jump");
    const composerArea = $("#fchat-composer-area");
    const input = $("#fchat-input");
    const sendBtn = $("#fchat-send");
    const countEl = $("#fchat-count");
    const titleEl = $("#fchat-title");
    const subEl = $("#fchat-sub");
    const headAvatar = $("#fchat-head-avatar");
    const infoBtn = $("#fchat-info");
    const userName = $("#fchat-user-name");
    const userAvatar = $("#fchat-user-avatar");
    const userHandle = $("#fchat-user-handle");
    const backdrop = $("#fchat-backdrop");
    const dialog = $("#fchat-dialog");

    const MAX_TEXT = 2000;
    const IDLE_CLOSE_MS = 10000; // how long the connection lingers after the page/tab is left
    const RUN_GAP_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // messages this close together share one run
    const AVATAR_COLORS = ["#6d5dfc", "#5865f2", "#2f9e6b", "#d64550", "#d9902b", "#c2478f", "#1f8fd6", "#7a6ad8"];
    const SEEN_KEY = "fusion:chat:seen";
    const cacheKey = id => `fusion:chat:list:${id}`;

    let me = null;
    let conversations = []; // newest first
    let activeId = null;
    let live = []; // newest page, from the live subscription
    let earlier = []; // older pages the person asked for
    let hasMore = false;
    let threadReady = false;
    let pending = []; // messages that are sending or failed
    let filterText = "";
    let stickToBottom = true;
    let seen = readJson(SEEN_KEY, null);

    // Connection state
    let client = null;
    let clientPromise = null;
    let unsubFeed = null;
    let subscribedFor = undefined; // the conversation id the live subscription was opened with (null = none)
    let closeTimer = null;
    let listLoaded = false;
    let refs = null;
    let statusState = "connecting";
    let generation = 0; // bumped whenever the connection is torn down, so late arrivals can be discarded

    /* ---------- tiny helpers ---------- */

    function readJson(key, fallback) { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)) ?? fallback; } catch { return fallback; } }
    function writeJson(key, value) { try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch { /* storage full or blocked */ } }
    function el(tag, className, text) { const node = document.createElement(tag); if (className) node.className = className; if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text; return node; }
    function uid() { return `${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`; }
    function notify(type, message) { window.FusionNotify?.[type]?.(message); }
    function initial(name) { return String(name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || "?"; }
    function colorFor(seed) {
        let hash = 0;
        for (const char of String(seed || "")) hash = (hash * 31 + char.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0;
        return AVATAR_COLORS[hash % AVATAR_COLORS.length];
    }
    function errorText(error, fallback) {
        const data = error?.data;
        if (typeof data === "string") return data;
        if (typeof data?.message === "string") return data.message;
        if (/Failed to fetch|NetworkError|Load failed|WebSocket/i.test(String(error?.message))) return "Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.";
        return fallback;
    }
    const ROLE_LABELS = { moderator: "Moderator", admin: "Admin", dev: "Developer", owner: "Owner" };
    const VERIFIED_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="4.5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="4.5" fill="currentColor" transform="rotate(45 12 12)"/><path d="M8.1 12.5l2.7 2.7 5.2-5.6" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
    function verifiedBadge(person) {
        if (!person?.verified) return null;
        const label = ROLE_LABELS[person.role] ? `Verified · ${ROLE_LABELS[person.role]}` : "Verified";
        const badge = el("span", "fchat-verified");
        badge.style.color = "#4da3ff"; badge.title = label; badge.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
        badge.innerHTML = VERIFIED_SVG;
        return badge;
    }
    function nameNodes(name, person) {
        const nodes = [el("span", "fchat-name-text", name)];
        const badge = verifiedBadge(person);
        if (badge) nodes.push(badge);
        return nodes;
    }
    function nameEl(className, name, person) {
        const wrap = el("span", `${className} fchat-named`);
        wrap.append(...nameNodes(name, person));
        return wrap;
    }
    function svgIcon(paths) { return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">${paths}</svg>`; }
    const ICONS = {
        chat: svgIcon('<path d="M21 12a8 8 0 0 1-11.6 7.1L4 20l1-4.6A8 8 0 1 1 21 12Z"/>'),
        trash: svgIcon('<path d="M4 7h16"/><path d="M9 7V4h6v3"/><path d="m6 7 1 13h10l1-13"/>')
    };

    function dayLabel(timestamp) {
        const date = new Date(timestamp);
        const today = new Date();
        const startOf = d => new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()).getTime();
        const diff = Math.round((startOf(today) - startOf(date)) / 86400000);
        if (diff === 0) return "Today";
        if (diff === 1) return "Yesterday";
        const sameYear = date.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear();
        return date.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: diff < 7 ? "long" : undefined, month: "short", day: "numeric", year: sameYear ? undefined : "numeric" });
    }
    function clock(timestamp) { return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }); }
    function listTime(timestamp) {
        const age = Date.now() - timestamp;
        if (age < 60000) return "now";
        const date = new Date(timestamp);
        const today = new Date();
        if (date.toDateString() === today.toDateString()) return clock(timestamp);
        if (age < 7 * 86400000) return date.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "short" });
        return date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
    }

    /* ---------- people and conversations ---------- */

    const activeConversation = () => conversations.find(c => c.id === activeId) || null;
    const isMine = id => id === me?.id;

    function personIn(conversation, id) {
        if (isMine(id)) return me;
        return conversation?.members?.find(m => m.id === id) || null;
    }
    function displayName(person) { return person?.displayName || person?.username || "Former member"; }
    function otherPerson(conversation) { return conversation.members.find(m => m.id !== me?.id) || null; }
    function conversationName(conversation) {
        if (conversation.type === "group") return conversation.name || "Group";
        return displayName(otherPerson(conversation));
    }
    function conversationSeed(conversation) {
        return conversation.type === "group" ? conversation.id : otherPerson(conversation)?.id || conversation.id;
    }

    function fillAvatar(node, { imageUrl, name, seed }) {
        node.replaceChildren();
        node.style.background = colorFor(seed);
        if (typeof imageUrl === "string" && /^(https:|data:image\/)/.test(imageUrl)) {
            const img = document.createElement("img");
            img.src = imageUrl; img.alt = "";
            img.addEventListener("error", () => { node.replaceChildren(); node.textContent = initial(name); });
            node.appendChild(img);
        } else node.textContent = initial(name);
    }
    function makeAvatar(size, { imageUrl, name, seed, group }) {
        const node = el("div", `fchat-avatar s${size}${group ? " group" : ""}`);
        fillAvatar(node, { imageUrl, name, seed });
        return node;
    }
    function conversationAvatar(conversation, size) {
        if (conversation.type === "group") return makeAvatar(size, { name: conversation.name, seed: conversation.id, group: true });
        const other = otherPerson(conversation);
        return makeAvatar(size, { imageUrl: other?.imageUrl, name: displayName(other), seed: other?.id || conversation.id });
    }

    /* ---------- read state (lives in this browser: zero calls) ---------- */

    function markSeen(conversation) {
        if (!conversation) return;
        seen ||= {};
        const at = Math.max(conversation.lastMessageAt || 0, seen[conversation.id] || 0);
        if (seen[conversation.id] === at) return;
        seen[conversation.id] = at;
        writeJson(SEEN_KEY, seen);
    }
    function isUnread(conversation) {
        if (conversation.id === activeId && pageIsShowing()) return false;
        if (!conversation.lastAuthorId || isMine(conversation.lastAuthorId)) return false;
        return conversation.lastMessageAt > (seen?.[conversation.id] || 0);
    }
    function initializeSeen() {
        // First time on this device: treat what already exists as read.
        if (seen) return;
        seen = {};
        conversations.forEach(c => { seen[c.id] = c.lastMessageAt; });
        writeJson(SEEN_KEY, seen);
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Connection (Convex, live)                                          */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    function pageIsShowing() {
        return document.visibilityState === "visible" && container.classList.contains("active");
    }

    function setStatus(state) { statusState = state; } // only used to word the empty list; nothing is shown for it

    async function getClient() {
        if (client) return client;
        const gen = generation;
        clientPromise ||= (async () => {
            const auth = window.FusionAuth;
            if (!auth?.convexUrl) throw new Error("Chat isn't set up yet.");
            const cdn = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/convex@1.27.0/dist/esm";
            const [{ ConvexClient }, { makeFunctionReference }] = await Promise.all([
                __fusionImport(`${cdn}/browser/index.js`, "assets/pages"),
                __fusionImport(`${cdn}/server/api.js`, "assets/pages")
            ]);
            if (gen !== generation) throw new Error("reset");
            const instance = new ConvexClient(auth.convexUrl);
            instance.setAuth(async ({ forceRefreshToken }) => auth.getToken(!!forceRefreshToken));
            refs = name => makeFunctionReference(name);
            client = instance;
            return instance;
        })();
        try { return await clientPromise; }
        catch (error) { clientPromise = null; throw error; }
    }

    function subscribeFeed(instance) {
        const wanted = activeId || null;
        if (unsubFeed && subscribedFor === wanted) return;
        unsubFeed?.();
        subscribedFor = wanted;
        unsubFeed = instance.onUpdate(refs("chat:sync"), wanted ? { conversationId: wanted } : {}, result => {
            if (!me || !result) return; // signed out or not ready
            conversations = result.conversations;
            listLoaded = true;
            initializeSeen();
            if (wanted === activeId) {
                if (activeId && !activeConversation()) { closeConversation(); return; } // left, or deleted elsewhere
                if (result.thread) {
                    threadReady = true;
                    live = result.thread.messages;
                    hasMore = earlier.length ? hasMore : !!result.thread.hasMore;
                }
            }
            if (activeId && pageIsShowing()) markSeen(activeConversation());
            writeJson(cacheKey(me.id), conversations);
            setStatus("live");
            renderList();
            renderHeader();
            renderMessages();
        }, error => { console.error("[FUSION] Chat connection error:", error); setStatus("error"); renderList(); });
    }

    async function connect() {
        if (!me) return;
        clearTimeout(closeTimer); closeTimer = null;
        try {
            if (!client) setStatus("connecting");
            const instance = await getClient();
            subscribeFeed(instance);
        } catch (error) {
            if (error?.message === "reset") return; // torn down while loading; a newer connect() will follow if needed
            console.error("[FUSION] Chat connection failed:", error);
            setStatus("error");
        }
    }

    function disconnect() {
        unsubFeed?.(); unsubFeed = null; subscribedFor = undefined;
        const old = client;
        generation += 1;
        client = null; clientPromise = null; listLoaded = false;
        old?.close?.().catch?.(() => {});
        if (me) setStatus("paused");
    }

    // Open while the page is showing; close shortly after it is left.
    function syncConnection() {
        if (me && pageIsShowing()) {
            connect();
            if (activeId) { markSeen(activeConversation()); renderList(); }
        } else if (client || clientPromise) {
            clearTimeout(closeTimer);
            closeTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (!pageIsShowing()) disconnect(); }, IDLE_CLOSE_MS);
        }
    }

    async function call(kind, name, args = {}) {
        const instance = await getClient();
        return instance[kind](refs(name), args);
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Rendering                                                          */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    function renderUser() {
        if (!me) { userName.replaceChildren(el("span", "fchat-name-text", "Signed out")); userHandle.textContent = ""; userAvatar.textContent = "?"; userAvatar.style.background = "#444"; return; }
        const name = me.displayName || me.username || "You";
        userName.replaceChildren(...nameNodes(name, me));
        userHandle.textContent = me.username ? `@${me.username}` : "";
        fillAvatar(userAvatar, { imageUrl: me.imageUrl, name, seed: me.id });
    }

    function renderList() {
        listEl.replaceChildren();
        const query = filterText.trim().toLowerCase();
        const shown = conversations.filter(c => !query || conversationName(c).toLowerCase().includes(query)
            || (c.type === "dm" && (otherPerson(c)?.username || "").toLowerCase().includes(query)));

        if (!shown.length) {
            const empty = el("div", "fchat-list-empty");
            empty.textContent = query ? "No chats match that search."
                : !me ? "Sign in to see your chats."
                : listLoaded ? "No chats yet. Start one with the New button."
                : statusState === "error" ? "Can't reach chat right now. Reload the page to try again."
                : "Loading your chats";
            listEl.appendChild(empty);
            return;
        }

        shown.forEach(conversation => {
            const unread = isUnread(conversation);
            const button = el("button", `fchat-conv${conversation.id === activeId ? " active" : ""}${unread ? " unread" : ""}`);
            button.type = "button";
            if (conversation.id === activeId) button.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");

            const body = el("div", "fchat-conv-body");
            const top = el("div", "fchat-conv-top");
            top.append(nameEl("fchat-conv-name", conversationName(conversation), conversation.type === "dm" ? otherPerson(conversation) : null));
            if (conversation.lastAuthorId) top.append(el("span", "fchat-conv-time", listTime(conversation.lastMessageAt)));

            const bottom = el("div", "fchat-conv-bottom");
            let preview = "No messages yet";
            if (conversation.lastAuthorId) {
                const who = isMine(conversation.lastAuthorId) ? "You: "
                    : conversation.type === "group" ? `${displayName(personIn(conversation, conversation.lastAuthorId)).split(" ")[0]}: ` : "";
                preview = who + conversation.lastText;
            }
            bottom.append(el("span", "fchat-conv-preview", preview));
            if (unread) { const dot = el("span", "fchat-dot-unread"); dot.title = "Unread"; bottom.append(dot); }

            body.append(top, bottom);
            button.append(conversationAvatar(conversation, 44), body);
            button.addEventListener("click", () => { openConversation(conversation.id); side.classList.remove("open"); });
            listEl.appendChild(button);
        });
    }

    function renderHeader() {
        const conversation = activeConversation();
        headAvatar.replaceChildren();
        infoBtn.hidden = !conversation;
        composerArea.hidden = !conversation;
        if (!conversation) { titleEl.replaceChildren(el("span", "fchat-name-text", "Messages")); subEl.textContent = ""; return; }
        headAvatar.appendChild(conversationAvatar(conversation, 36));
        titleEl.replaceChildren(...nameNodes(conversationName(conversation), conversation.type === "dm" ? otherPerson(conversation) : null));
        if (conversation.type === "group") subEl.textContent = `${conversation.members.length} ${conversation.members.length === 1 ? "person" : "people"}`;
        else { const other = otherPerson(conversation); subEl.textContent = other ? `@${other.username}` : "Former member"; }
    }

    function showEmpty({ icon = ICONS.chat, title, text, actions = [] }) {
        messagesEl.replaceChildren();
        const box = el("div", "fchat-empty");
        const iconEl = el("div", "fchat-empty-icon"); iconEl.innerHTML = icon;
        box.append(iconEl, el("h2", "", title), el("p", "", text));
        if (actions.length) {
            const row = el("div", "fchat-empty-actions");
            actions.forEach(({ label, onClick, primary }) => {
                const b = el("button", `fchat-btn${primary ? " primary" : ""}`, label); b.type = "button"; b.addEventListener("click", onClick); row.appendChild(b);
            });
            box.append(row);
        }
        messagesEl.appendChild(box);
        jumpBtn.hidden = true;
    }

    function visibleMessages() {
        const known = new Set();
        const merged = [];
        [...earlier, ...live].forEach(m => { if (!known.has(m.id)) { known.add(m.id); merged.push(m); } });
        const clientIds = new Set(merged.map(m => m.clientId).filter(Boolean));
        const mineNow = pending.filter(p => p.conversationId === activeId && !clientIds.has(p.clientId))
            .map(p => ({ id: `pending:${p.clientId}`, authorId: me.id, text: p.text, at: p.at, pending: p }));
        return [...merged, ...mineNow];
    }

    function renderMessages() {
        const conversation = activeConversation();
        if (!me) {
            showEmpty({ title: "Sign in to chat", text: "Message other FUSION players one-on-one or in a group.", actions: [{ label: "Sign in", primary: true, onClick: () => window.FusionNavigate?.("login") }] });
            return;
        }
        if (!conversation) {
            if (listLoaded && !conversations.length) {
                showEmpty({ title: "Start your first chat", text: "Message a friend by their FUSION username, or make a group for your whole squad.",
                    actions: [{ label: "New message", primary: true, onClick: () => openNewDialog("dm") }, { label: "New group", onClick: () => openNewDialog("group") }] });
            } else {
                showEmpty({ title: conversations.length ? "Pick a conversation" : "Your messages", text: conversations.length ? "Choose a chat on the left, or start a new one." : "Your chats will show up here." ,
                    actions: conversations.length ? [{ label: "New message", primary: true, onClick: () => openNewDialog("dm") }] : [] });
            }
            return;
        }
        if (!threadReady && !live.length && !pending.length) { messagesEl.replaceChildren(); return; }

        const items = visibleMessages();
        if (!items.length) {
            showEmpty({ title: `Say hi to ${conversationName(conversation)}`, text: conversation.type === "group" ? "This group is new. Send the first message." : "This is the start of your conversation." });
            return;
        }

        const wasNearBottom = messagesEl.scrollHeight - messagesEl.scrollTop - messagesEl.clientHeight < 90;
        const previousHeight = messagesEl.scrollHeight;
        const previousTop = messagesEl.scrollTop;
        const lastItem = items[items.length - 1];
        const shouldStick = !earlierJustLoaded && (stickToBottom || wasNearBottom || !!lastItem.pending);
        const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

        if (hasMore) {
            const more = el("button", "fchat-btn fchat-earlier", "Load earlier messages"); more.type = "button"; more.id = "fchat-earlier";
            more.addEventListener("click", loadEarlier); frag.appendChild(more);
        }

        // Group into runs: same author, close in time, same day
        const isGroupChat = conversation.type === "group";
        let previous = null; let run = null; let runMain = null; let lastBubbleInRun = null;
        items.forEach((message, index) => {
            const day = new Date(message.at).toDateString();
            if (!previous || new Date(previous.at).toDateString() !== day) { frag.appendChild(el("div", "fchat-day", dayLabel(message.at))); previous = null; run = null; }

            const startsRun = !previous || previous.authorId !== message.authorId || message.at - previous.at > RUN_GAP_MS;
            if (startsRun) {
                const mine = isMine(message.authorId);
                run = el("div", `fchat-run${mine ? " mine" : ""}`);
                const gutter = el("div", "fchat-run-side");
                runMain = el("div", "fchat-run-main");
                const person = personIn(conversation, message.authorId);
                if (!mine && isGroupChat) { runMain.appendChild(nameEl("fchat-run-name", displayName(person), person)); run.classList.add("named"); }
                gutter.appendChild(makeAvatar(28, { imageUrl: person?.imageUrl, name: displayName(person), seed: person?.id || message.authorId }));
                run.append(gutter);
                run.append(runMain);
                frag.appendChild(run);
                lastBubbleInRun = null;
            }

            const row = el("div", "fchat-bubble-row");
            const bubble = el("div", "fchat-bubble", message.text);
            if (message.pending) bubble.classList.add(message.pending.state === "failed" ? "failed" : "sending");
            bubble.title = `${dayLabel(message.at)}, ${clock(message.at)}`;
            if (lastBubbleInRun) { lastBubbleInRun.classList.add("joins-below"); bubble.classList.add("joins-above"); }
            lastBubbleInRun = bubble;

            row.appendChild(bubble);
            if (isMine(message.authorId) && !message.pending) row.appendChild(deleteTool(message));
            runMain.appendChild(row);

            const next = items[index + 1];
            const endsRun = !next || next.authorId !== message.authorId || next.at - message.at > RUN_GAP_MS
                || new Date(next.at).toDateString() !== day;
            if (endsRun) {
                if (message.pending?.state === "failed") {
                    const meta = el("div", "fchat-run-meta failed", message.pending.error || "Not sent.");
                    const retry = el("button", "", "Retry"); retry.type = "button"; retry.addEventListener("click", () => retrySend(message.pending));
                    const drop = el("button", "", "Delete"); drop.type = "button"; drop.addEventListener("click", () => { pending = pending.filter(p => p !== message.pending); renderMessages(); });
                    meta.append(retry, drop); runMain.appendChild(meta);
                } else runMain.appendChild(el("div", "fchat-run-meta", message.pending ? "Sending" : clock(message.at)));
            }
            previous = message;
        });

        messagesEl.replaceChildren(frag);
        if (shouldStick) { messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight; jumpBtn.hidden = true; stickToBottom = true; }
        else {
            messagesEl.scrollTop = previousTop + (earlierJustLoaded ? messagesEl.scrollHeight - previousHeight : 0);
            jumpBtn.hidden = earlierJustLoaded ? messagesEl.scrollHeight - messagesEl.scrollTop - messagesEl.clientHeight < 90 : false;
        }
        earlierJustLoaded = false;
    }
    let earlierJustLoaded = false;

    function deleteTool(message) {
        const tools = el("div", "fchat-bubble-tools");
        const button = el("button", "fchat-icon-btn"); button.type = "button"; button.innerHTML = ICONS.trash;
        button.setAttribute("aria-label", "Delete message"); button.title = "Delete message";
        let armed = false; let timer = null;
        button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            if (!armed) {
                armed = true; button.className = "fchat-icon-btn confirm"; button.textContent = "Delete?";
                timer = setTimeout(() => { armed = false; button.className = "fchat-icon-btn"; button.innerHTML = ICONS.trash; }, 3000);
                return;
            }
            clearTimeout(timer); button.disabled = true;
            try {
                await call("mutation", "chat:remove", { messageId: message.id });
                earlier = earlier.filter(m => m.id !== message.id); renderMessages();
            } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; notify("error", errorText(error, "Couldn't delete that message.")); }
        });
        tools.appendChild(button);
        return tools;
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Actions                                                            */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    function openConversation(id) {
        if (id === activeId) { input.focus(); return; }
        activeId = id;
        live = []; earlier = []; hasMore = false; threadReady = false; stickToBottom = true;
        markSeen(activeConversation());
        renderList(); renderHeader(); renderMessages();
        if (client) subscribeFeed(client); else syncConnection();
        if (window.matchMedia("(min-width: 761px)").matches) input.focus();
    }

    function closeConversation() {
        activeId = null;
        live = []; earlier = []; threadReady = false;
        if (client) subscribeFeed(client);
        renderList(); renderHeader(); renderMessages();
    }

    async function loadEarlier() {
        const oldest = [...earlier, ...live][0];
        const button = $("#fchat-earlier");
        if (!oldest || !activeId) return;
        if (button) { button.disabled = true; button.textContent = "Loading"; }
        const id = activeId;
        try {
            const page = await call("query", "chat:older", { conversationId: id, before: oldest.at });
            if (id !== activeId) return;
            earlier = [...page.messages, ...earlier]; hasMore = page.hasMore;
            earlierJustLoaded = true; stickToBottom = false;
            renderMessages();
        } catch (error) {
            if (button) { button.disabled = false; button.textContent = "Load earlier messages"; }
            notify("error", errorText(error, "Couldn't load earlier messages."));
        }
    }

    async function deliver(entry) {
        entry.state = "sending"; entry.error = "";
        renderMessages();
        try {
            await call("mutation", "chat:send", { conversationId: entry.conversationId, text: entry.text, clientId: entry.clientId });
            pending = pending.filter(p => p !== entry);
        } catch (error) {
            entry.state = "failed"; entry.error = errorText(error, "Couldn't send that message.");
        }
        renderMessages();
    }
    function retrySend(entry) { deliver(entry); }

    function sendMessage() {
        if (!me) { window.FusionNavigate?.("login"); return; }
        const text = input.value.trim();
        if (!text || !activeId) return;
        if (text.length > MAX_TEXT) { notify("warning", `Messages can be up to ${MAX_TEXT} characters.`); return; }
        const entry = { clientId: uid(), conversationId: activeId, text, at: Date.now(), state: "sending", error: "" };
        pending.push(entry);
        input.value = ""; resizeInput(); stickToBottom = true;
        deliver(entry);
    }

    function resizeInput() {
        input.style.height = "auto";
        input.style.height = Math.min(input.scrollHeight, 150) + "px";
        const length = input.value.length;
        sendBtn.disabled = !input.value.trim();
        countEl.hidden = length < MAX_TEXT - 300;
        countEl.textContent = `${length}/${MAX_TEXT}`;
        countEl.classList.toggle("over", length > MAX_TEXT);
    }

    /* ---------- dialogs ---------- */

    function closeDialog() { backdrop.classList.remove("open"); dialog.replaceChildren(); }
    function openDialog() { backdrop.classList.add("open"); }

    function chipsField(labelText, placeholder) {
        const label = el("label", "fchat-field");
        label.appendChild(el("span", "", labelText));
        const wrap = el("div", "fchat-chips");
        const field = document.createElement("input");
        field.type = "text"; field.placeholder = placeholder; field.autocomplete = "off"; field.autocapitalize = "off"; field.spellcheck = false;
        wrap.appendChild(field); label.appendChild(wrap);
        const names = [];
        const addFromField = () => {
            field.value.split(/[\s,]+/).map(s => s.replace(/^@+/, "").trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(name => {
                if (!names.some(n => n.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())) {
                    names.push(name);
                    const chip = el("span", "fchat-chip", `@${name}`);
                    const x = el("button", "", "×"); x.type = "button"; x.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove ${name}`);
                    x.addEventListener("click", () => { names.splice(names.indexOf(name), 1); chip.remove(); });
                    chip.appendChild(x); wrap.insertBefore(chip, field);
                }
            });
            field.value = "";
        };
        field.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
            if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === "," || event.key === " ") { if (field.value.trim()) { event.preventDefault(); addFromField(); } else if (event.key !== "Enter") event.preventDefault(); }
            else if (event.key === "Backspace" && !field.value && names.length) { wrap.querySelectorAll(".fchat-chip:last-of-type").forEach(c => c.remove()); names.pop(); }
        });
        field.addEventListener("blur", addFromField);
        return { label, field, getNames: () => { addFromField(); return names.slice(); } };
    }

    function openNewDialog(initialTab = "dm") {
        if (!me) { window.FusionNavigate?.("login"); return; }
        dialog.replaceChildren();
        dialog.appendChild(el("h2", "", "New chat"));
        dialog.appendChild(el("p", "fchat-dialog-lead", "Find people by their FUSION username."));

        const tabs = el("div", "fchat-tabs"); tabs.setAttribute("role", "tablist");
        const tabDm = el("button", "fchat-tab", "Direct message"); const tabGroup = el("button", "fchat-tab", "Group");
        [tabDm, tabGroup].forEach(t => { t.type = "button"; t.setAttribute("role", "tab"); tabs.appendChild(t); });
        const body = el("div"); const error = el("p", "fchat-error"); error.setAttribute("role", "alert");
        const actions = el("div", "fchat-dialog-actions");
        const cancel = el("button", "fchat-btn", "Cancel"); cancel.type = "button";
        const go = el("button", "fchat-btn primary"); go.type = "button";
        actions.append(cancel, go);
        dialog.append(tabs, body, error, actions);

        let tab = initialTab; let submit = () => {};
        function show(next) {
            tab = next; error.textContent = ""; body.replaceChildren();
            tabDm.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(tab === "dm")); tabGroup.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(tab === "group"));
            if (tab === "dm") {
                const label = el("label", "fchat-field"); label.appendChild(el("span", "", "Username"));
                const field = document.createElement("input"); field.type = "text"; field.placeholder = "@username"; field.autocomplete = "off"; field.autocapitalize = "off"; field.spellcheck = false;
                label.appendChild(field); body.appendChild(label);
                go.textContent = "Start chat";
                submit = async () => {
                    const username = field.value.trim();
                    if (!username) { error.textContent = "Enter a username."; return; }
                    await run(async () => { const id = await call("mutation", "chat:openDm", { username }); return { id }; });
                };
                setTimeout(() => field.focus(), 0);
                field.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); go.click(); } });
            } else {
                const nameLabel = el("label", "fchat-field"); nameLabel.appendChild(el("span", "", "Group name"));
                const nameField = document.createElement("input"); nameField.type = "text"; nameField.maxLength = 40; nameField.placeholder = "Friday squad"; nameField.autocomplete = "off";
                nameLabel.appendChild(nameField);
                const people = chipsField("People", "Type a username and press Enter");
                people.label.appendChild(el("p", "fchat-hint", "Add up to 24 people. You can add more later."));
                body.append(nameLabel, people.label);
                go.textContent = "Create group";
                submit = async () => {
                    const title = nameField.value.trim(); const names = people.getNames();
                    if (!title) { error.textContent = "Give the group a name."; return; }
                    if (!names.length) { error.textContent = "Add at least one person."; return; }
                    await run(async () => {
                        const res = await call("mutation", "chat:createGroup", { name: title, usernames: names });
                        if (res.missing?.length) notify("warning", `No one found for: ${res.missing.map(n => "@" + n).join(", ")}`);
                        return { id: res.conversationId };
                    });
                };
                setTimeout(() => nameField.focus(), 0);
            }
        }
        async function run(work) {
            go.disabled = true; error.textContent = "";
            try {
                const { id } = await work();
                closeDialog();
                await waitForConversation(id);
                openConversation(id);
            } catch (err) { error.textContent = errorText(err, "Something went wrong. Try again."); go.disabled = false; }
        }
        tabDm.addEventListener("click", () => show("dm")); tabGroup.addEventListener("click", () => show("group"));
        cancel.addEventListener("click", closeDialog); go.addEventListener("click", () => submit());
        show(initialTab); openDialog();
    }

    // The new conversation reaches the list through the live subscription; wait briefly for it.
    function waitForConversation(id) {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            const started = Date.now();
            const check = () => { if (conversations.some(c => c.id === id) || Date.now() - started > 2500) resolve(); else setTimeout(check, 60); };
            check();
        });
    }

    function openInfoDialog() {
        const conversation = activeConversation(); if (!conversation) return;
        dialog.replaceChildren();
        const isGroup = conversation.type === "group";
        const owner = isGroup && isMine(conversation.ownerId);
        dialog.appendChild(el("h2", "", conversationName(conversation)));
        dialog.appendChild(el("p", "fchat-dialog-lead", isGroup ? `${conversation.members.length} people in this group` : "Direct message"));

        const list = el("ul", "fchat-people");
        conversation.members.forEach(person => {
            const item = el("li", "fchat-person");
            const text = el("div", "fchat-person-text");
            text.append(nameEl("fchat-person-name", isMine(person.id) ? `${displayName(person)} (you)` : displayName(person), person), el("div", "fchat-person-user", `@${person.username}`));
            item.append(makeAvatar(36, { imageUrl: person.imageUrl, name: displayName(person), seed: person.id }), text);
            if (isGroup && person.id === conversation.ownerId) item.append(el("span", "fchat-tag", "Owner"));
            else if (isGroup && !isMine(person.id)) {
                const dm = el("button", "fchat-btn", "Message"); dm.type = "button";
                dm.addEventListener("click", async () => {
                    dm.disabled = true;
                    try { const id = await call("mutation", "chat:openDm", { username: person.username }); closeDialog(); await waitForConversation(id); openConversation(id); }
                    catch (error) { dm.disabled = false; notify("error", errorText(error, "Couldn't open that chat.")); }
                });
                item.append(dm);
            }
            list.appendChild(item);
        });
        dialog.appendChild(list);

        const error = el("p", "fchat-error"); error.setAttribute("role", "alert");
        let people = null;
        if (owner) {
            people = chipsField("Add people", "Type a username and press Enter");
            dialog.appendChild(people.label);
        }
        dialog.appendChild(error);

        const actions = el("div", "fchat-dialog-actions");
        const leave = el("button", "fchat-btn danger", isGroup ? "Leave group" : "Delete chat"); leave.type = "button";
        const close = el("button", "fchat-btn", "Close"); close.type = "button";
        actions.append(leave); actions.style.justifyContent = "space-between";
        const right = el("div", "fchat-dialog-actions");
        right.append(close);
        if (owner) {
            const add = el("button", "fchat-btn primary", "Add"); add.type = "button";
            add.addEventListener("click", async () => {
                const names = people.getNames(); if (!names.length) { error.textContent = "Type a username first."; return; }
                add.disabled = true; error.textContent = "";
                try {
                    const res = await call("mutation", "chat:addMembers", { conversationId: conversation.id, usernames: names });
                    if (res.missing?.length) notify("warning", `No one found for: ${res.missing.map(n => "@" + n).join(", ")}`);
                    if (res.added) notify("success", `Added ${res.added} ${res.added === 1 ? "person" : "people"}.`);
                    closeDialog();
                } catch (err) { error.textContent = errorText(err, "Couldn't add them."); add.disabled = false; }
            });
            right.appendChild(add);
        }
        actions.appendChild(right);
        dialog.appendChild(actions);

        let armed = false;
        leave.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            if (!armed) { armed = true; leave.textContent = isGroup ? "Tap again to leave" : "Tap again to delete"; return; }
            leave.disabled = true;
            try { await call("mutation", "chat:leave", { conversationId: conversation.id }); closeDialog(); }
            catch (err) { leave.disabled = false; error.textContent = errorText(err, "Couldn't do that."); }
        });
        close.addEventListener("click", closeDialog);
        openDialog();
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Wiring                                                             */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    sendBtn.addEventListener("click", sendMessage);
    input.addEventListener("input", resizeInput);
    input.addEventListener("keydown", event => { if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey && !event.isComposing) { event.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); } });
    filterEl.addEventListener("input", () => { filterText = filterEl.value; renderList(); });
    $("#fchat-new").addEventListener("click", () => openNewDialog("dm"));
    $("#fchat-edit-name").addEventListener("click", () => window.FusionNavigate?.("profile"));
    $("#fchat-menu").addEventListener("click", () => side.classList.toggle("open"));
    infoBtn.addEventListener("click", openInfoDialog);
    backdrop.addEventListener("click", event => { if (event.target === backdrop) closeDialog(); });
    container.addEventListener("keydown", event => { if (event.key === "Escape") { closeDialog(); side.classList.remove("open"); } });
    jumpBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight; stickToBottom = true; jumpBtn.hidden = true; });
    messagesEl.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
        const nearBottom = messagesEl.scrollHeight - messagesEl.scrollTop - messagesEl.clientHeight < 90;

    });

    // Pause when this page or the tab isn't showing (pages are kept mounted by the router).
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", syncConnection);
    new MutationObserver(syncConnection).observe(container, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });

    function applyUser(user) {
        const changedPerson = (user?.id || null) !== (me?.id || null);
        me = user || null;
        renderUser();
        if (changedPerson) {
            disconnect();
            conversations = []; activeId = null; live = []; earlier = []; pending = []; listLoaded = false; seen = readJson(SEEN_KEY, null);
            if (me) {
                const cached = readJson(cacheKey(me.id), null);

            } else setStatus("offline");

        }
        syncConnection();
    }

    resizeInput();
    applyUser(window.FusionAuth?.getUser?.() || null);
}

;return { render };

});

                transition:
                    border-color .18s ease,

            }

            .games-search:focus-within {
                border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.075);

            .games-toolbar-btn:focus-visible {

                border-color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.32);

                    rgba(255,255,255,.09);
            }

            .games-search svg {
                width: 18px;
                height: 18px;

                flex-shrink: 0;

                fill: none;
                stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.55);

                stroke-width: 1.8;

                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            .games-search input {
                flex: 1;
                min-width: 0;

                border: 0;
                outline: 0;

                background: transparent;
                color: #fff;

            }

            .games-search input::placeholder {
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.42);
            }

            .games-toolbar-btn {

                display: flex;
                align-items: center;

                height: 46px;

                padding: 0 16px;

                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
                border-radius: 13px;

            }

            .games-toolbar-btn:hover {

                    rgba(255,255,255,.09);

            .games-toolbar-btn.active {

                    rgba(255,255,255,.25);
