            }

            .games-toolbar-btn svg {
                width: 17px;
                height: 17px;

                flex-shrink: 0;

                fill: none;
                stroke: currentColor;

                stroke-width: 1.8;

                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            .games-toolbar-btn.active svg {
                fill: currentColor;
            }

            .games-grid {
                flex: 0 0 auto;
                min-height: 0;

                display: grid;

                grid-template-columns:
                    repeat(
                        auto-fill,
                        minmax(190px, 1fr)
                    );

                grid-auto-rows: min-content;

                gap: 18px;

                align-content: start;
                overflow: visible;

                padding: 4px 0 8px;

                scrollbar-width: thin;

                scrollbar-color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.18)
                    transparent;
            }

            .games-grid::-webkit-scrollbar {
                width: 8px;
            }

            .games-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
                background: transparent;
            }

            .games-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
                background:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.14);

                border-radius: 8px;
            }

            .games-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
                background:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.24);
            }

            .games-grid.is-empty {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .games-empty {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;

                align-items: center;

                gap: 14px;

                padding: 40px 20px;

                text-align: center;
            }

            .games-empty svg {
                width: 40px;
                height: 40px;

                fill: none;

                stroke:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.32);

                stroke-width: 1.6;

                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            .games-empty-title {
                margin: 0;

                color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.82);

                font-size: 15px;
                font-weight: 600;
            }

            .games-empty-subtext {
                margin: 0;

                max-width: 280px;

                color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.45);

                font-size: 13px;
                line-height: 1.5;
            }

            .game-cube {
                position: relative;

                animation:
                    game-card-in
                    .55s
                    cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
                    both;

                aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;

                border:
                    1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);

                border-radius: 14px;

                background:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.04);

                overflow: hidden;

                cursor: pointer;

                box-shadow:
                    0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);

                transition:
                    transform .28s ease,
                    box-shadow .28s ease,
                    border-color .28s ease;
            }

            .game-cube:hover,
            .game-cube:focus-visible {
                transform:
                    translateY(-4px)
                    scale(1.03);

                border-color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.22);

                box-shadow:
                    0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.5);

                outline: none;
            }

            .game-cube-face {
                position: absolute;
                inset: 0;

                background-size: cover;
                background-position: center;

                transition:
                    transform .28s ease,
                    filter .28s ease;
            }

            .game-cube:hover .game-cube-face,
            .game-cube:focus-visible .game-cube-face {
                transform: scale(1.06);
                filter: brightness(.55);
            }

            .game-tags {
                position: absolute;

                top: 9px;
                left: 9px;
                right: 44px;

                z-index: 2;

                display: flex;
                flex-wrap: wrap;

                gap: 5px;

                pointer-events: none;
            }

            .game-badge {
                display: inline-flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                min-height: 20px;

                padding: 3px 7px;

                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
                border-radius: 6px;

                background: rgba(10,10,12,.72);
                color: #fff;

                font-size: 9px;
                font-weight: 800;

                letter-spacing: .55px;
                line-height: 1;

                backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
                -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            }

            .game-badge-hot {
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.94);
                color: #17131d;
                border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.94);
            }

            .game-badge-updated {
                background: rgba(105,92,254,.82);
                border-color: rgba(142,132,255,.55);
            }

            .game-cube-overlay {
                position: absolute;
                inset: 0;

                z-index: 1;

                display: flex;
                align-items: flex-end;

                padding: 12px;

                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        to top,
                        rgba(0,0,0,.75),
                        rgba(0,0,0,0) 60%
                    );

                opacity: 0;

                transition: opacity .22s ease;
            }

            .game-cube:hover .game-cube-overlay,
            .game-cube:focus-visible .game-cube-overlay {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            .game-cube-name {
                color: #fff;

                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;

                line-height: 1.25;
            }

            .game-heart {
                position: absolute;

                top: 8px;
                right: 8px;

                z-index: 2;

                width: 30px;
                height: 30px;

                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                border: 0;
                border-radius: 50%;

                background:
                    rgba(0,0,0,.45);

                backdrop-filter: blur(4px);

                cursor: pointer;

                opacity: 0;

                transform: scale(.85);

                transition:
                    opacity .2s ease,
                    transform .2s ease,
                    background .16s ease;
            }

            .game-cube:hover .game-heart,
            .game-cube:focus-within .game-heart,
            .game-heart.active {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(1);
            }

            .game-heart:hover {
                background:
                    rgba(0,0,0,.65);
            }

            .game-heart svg {
                width: 15px;
                height: 15px;

                fill: none;
                stroke: #fff;

                stroke-width: 1.8;

                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            .game-heart.active svg {
                fill: #fff;
            }

            /* ---------- EXACT GAMES FOOTER ---------- */

            .games-footer {
                flex-shrink: 0;

                width: min(100%, 560px);

                margin: 34px auto 8px;

                padding: 22px 24px 20px;

                border-top:
                    1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);

                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 11px;

                text-align: center;
            }

            .games-footer-brand {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .games-footer-logo {
                display: block;

                width: 112px;
                height: auto;
                max-width: 100%;

                opacity: .72;
            }

            .games-footer-info {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                flex-wrap: wrap;

                gap: 7px 12px;
            }

            .games-footer-text {
                margin: 0;

                color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.38);

                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 500;

                line-height: 1.5;
            }

            .games-footer-links {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 10px;
            }

            .games-footer-link {
                color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.52);

                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 600;

                text-decoration: none;

                transition:
                    color .16s ease;
            }

            .games-footer-link:hover {
                color: #fff;
            }

            .games-footer-separator {
                width: 3px;
                height: 3px;

                border-radius: 50%;

                background:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.22);
            }

            /* ---------- game viewer ---------- */

            .game-viewer {
                position: fixed;

                inset: 0;

                z-index: 9999;

                width: 100vw;
                height: 100dvh;

                overflow: hidden;

                background: #000;

                opacity: 0;
                visibility: hidden;

                transform: translateY(24px) scale(.985);

                transition:
                    opacity .26s ease,
                    transform .5s
                        cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),
                    visibility 0s
                        linear .5s;
            }

            .game-viewer:not([hidden]) {
                opacity: 1;
                visibility: visible;

                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);

                transition:
                    opacity .26s ease,
                    transform .5s
                        cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),
                    visibility 0s
                        linear 0s;
            }

            .game-viewer::after {
                content: "";

                position: absolute;
                inset: 0;

                z-index: 1;

                pointer-events: none;

                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        to top,
                        rgba(0,0,0,.72) 0%,
                        rgba(0,0,0,.18) 22%,
                        transparent 42%
                    );

                opacity: 0;

                transition:
                    opacity .5s ease .12s;
            }

            .game-viewer.game-title-visible::after {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            .game-viewer-frame {
                position: relative;

                z-index: 0;

                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;

                border: 0;

                display: block;

                background: #000;
            }

            .game-viewer-title {
                position: absolute;

                left:
                    clamp(22px,4vw,56px);

                bottom:
                    clamp(24px,5vw,58px);

                z-index: 3;

                max-width:
                    min(70vw,760px);

                color: #fff;

                font-size:
                    clamp(20px,2.5vw,34px);

                font-weight: 700;

                line-height: 1.1;

                letter-spacing: -.7px;

                text-shadow:
                    0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.55);

                opacity: 0;

                transform: translateY(34px);

                pointer-events: none;

                transition:
                    opacity .42s ease,
                    transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
            }

            .game-viewer-title.is-visible {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }

            .game-viewer-title.is-hidden {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(34px);
            }

            .game-viewer-close {
                position: absolute;

                top: 14px;
                right: 14px;

                z-index: 4;

                width: 38px;
                height: 38px;

                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                border: 0;
                border-radius: 50%;

                background:
                    rgba(0,0,0,.55);

                color: #fff;

                cursor: pointer;

                backdrop-filter: blur(6px);

                transition:
                    background .16s ease,
                    transform .16s ease;
            }

            .game-viewer-close:hover {
                background:
                    rgba(0,0,0,.75);

                transform: scale(1.06);
            }

            .game-viewer-close svg {
                width: 18px;
                height: 18px;

                fill: none;
                stroke: currentColor;

                stroke-width: 2;

                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            @keyframes games-toolbar-in {
                from {
                    opacity: 0;
                    transform: translateY(-12px);
                }

                to {
                    opacity: 1;
                    transform: translateY(0);
                }
            }

            @keyframes game-card-in {
                from {
                    opacity: 0;
                    transform:
                        translateY(18px)
                        scale(.97);
                }

                to {
                    opacity: 1;
                    transform:
                        translateY(0)
                        scale(1);
                }
            }

            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
                .games-toolbar,
                .game-cube,
                .game-viewer,
                .game-viewer-title {
                    animation: none !important;
                    transition: none !important;
                }
            }

            @media (max-width: 520px) {
                .games-page {
                    padding: 16px 14px 20px;
                }

                .games-footer {
                    width: 100%;

                    padding:
                        20px 10px 16px;

                    margin-top: 26px;
                }

                .games-footer-logo {
                    width: 100px;
                }

                .games-footer-info {
                    flex-direction: column;
                    gap: 8px;
                }
            }
        </style>

        <div class="games-page">

            <div class="games-toolbar">

                <div class="games-search">
                    <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                        <circle
                            cx="10.8"
                            cy="10.8"
                            r="6.2"
                        ></circle>

                        <path
                            d="m16 16 4.2 4.2"
                        ></path>
                    </svg>

                    <input
                        type="text"
                        id="games-search-input"
                        autocomplete="off"
                        placeholder="Search games"
                        aria-label="Search games"
                    >
                </div>

                <div class="games-toolbar-actions">

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="games-toolbar-btn"
                        id="games-favorites-btn"
                        aria-pressed="false"
                    >
                        <svg
                            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                        >
                            <path d="M20.42 4.58a5.4 5.4 0 0 0-7.65 0L12 5.36l-.77-.78a5.4 5.4 0 0 0-7.65 0C1.46 6.7 1.33 10.28 4 13l8 8 8-8c2.67-2.72 2.54-6.3.42-8.42z"></path>
                        </svg>

                        <span>Favorites</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="games-toolbar-btn"
                        id="games-random-btn"
                    >
                        <svg
                            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                        >
                            <path d="m18 14 4 4-4 4"></path>
                            <path d="m18 2 4 4-4 4"></path>
                            <path d="M2 18h1.973a4 4 0 0 0 3.3-1.7l5.454-8.6a4 4 0 0 1 3.3-1.7H22"></path>
                            <path d="M2 6h1.972a4 4 0 0 1 3.6 2.2"></path>
                            <path d="M22 18h-6.041a4 4 0 0 1-3.3-1.8l-.359-.45"></path>
                        </svg>

                        <span>Random</span>
                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>

            <div
                class="games-grid"
                id="games-grid"
            ></div>

            <footer class="games-footer">

                <div class="games-footer-brand">
                    <img
                        class="games-footer-logo"
                        src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"
                        alt="FUSION"
                    >
                </div>

                <div class="games-footer-info">

                    <p class="games-footer-text">
                        © ${new Date().getFullYear()} FUSION · Games for everyone.
                    </p>

                    <span
                        class="games-footer-separator"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    ></span>

                    <nav
                        class="games-footer-links"
                        aria-label="Legal"
                    >

                        <a
                            class="games-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="terms"
                        >
                            Terms
                        </a>

                        <a
                            class="games-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="privacy"
                        >
                            Privacy
                        </a>

                    </nav>

                </div>

            </footer>

            <div
                class="game-viewer"
                id="game-viewer"
                hidden
            >

                <button
                    type="button"
                    class="game-viewer-close"
                    id="game-viewer-close"
                    aria-label="Close game"
                    title="Close game"
                >
                    <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                        <path d="M18 6 6 18"></path>
                        <path d="m6 6 12 12"></path>
                    </svg>
                </button>

                <div
                    class="game-viewer-title"
                    id="game-viewer-title"
                ></div>

                <iframe
                    class="game-viewer-frame"
                    id="game-viewer-frame"
                    title="Game"
                    allowfullscreen
                ></iframe>

            </div>

        </div>
    `;

    const grid =
        container.querySelector(
            "#games-grid"
        );

    const searchInput =
        container.querySelector(
            "#games-search-input"
        );

    const favoritesBtn =
        container.querySelector(
            "#games-favorites-btn"
        );

    const randomBtn =
        container.querySelector(
            "#games-random-btn"
        );

    const viewer =
        container.querySelector(
            "#game-viewer"
        );

    const viewerFrame =
        container.querySelector(
            "#game-viewer-frame"
        );

    const viewerClose =
        container.querySelector(
            "#game-viewer-close"
        );

    const viewerTitle =
        container.querySelector(
            "#game-viewer-title"
        );

    let favorites = loadFavorites();

    let showFavoritesOnly = false;
    let searchTerm = "";
    let currentGameId = null;
    let currentGameBlobURL = null;
    let gameLoadToken = 0;
    let titleHideTimer = null;
    let gameLoadNotification = null;

    function getFilteredGames() {
        return games.filter(game => {

            if (
                showFavoritesOnly &&
                !favorites.has(game.id)
            ) {
                return false;
            }

            if (
                searchTerm &&
                !game.name
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes(searchTerm)
            ) {
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        });
    }

    /*
     * Determine the directory that should be used as the
     * base URL for a fetched game document.
     *
     * Example:
     * https://cdn.example.com/games/foo/index.html
     * becomes:
     * https://cdn.example.com/games/foo/
     */
    function getGameBaseURL(documentURL) {
        try {
            return new URL(
                ".",
                documentURL
            ).href;
        } catch {
            return documentURL;
        }
    }

    /*
     * Make sure the fetched game HTML has the correct
     * document base.
     *
     * Existing <base> elements are preserved.
     * Relative existing bases are resolved against the
     * final HTML URL.
     *
     * If the document has no <base>, one is injected.
     */
    function injectGameBase(
        html,
        baseURL,
        documentURL
    ) {
        const parser =
            new DOMParser();

        const parsed =
            parser.parseFromString(
                html,
                "text/html"
            );

        const existingBase =
            parsed.querySelector(
                "base[href]"
            ) ||
            parsed.querySelector(
                "base"
            );

        if (existingBase) {
            let existingHref =
                existingBase.getAttribute(
                    "href"
                );

            if (
                existingHref &&
                existingHref.trim()
            ) {
                try {
                    existingHref =
                        new URL(
                            existingHref.trim(),
                            documentURL
                        ).href;

                    existingBase.setAttribute(
                        "href",
                        existingHref
                    );
                } catch (error) {
                    console.warn(
                        "[FUSION Games] Invalid game <base> URL; falling back to the HTML directory.",
                        existingHref,
                        error
                    );

                    existingBase.setAttribute(
                        "href",
                        baseURL
                    );
                }
            } else {
                existingBase.setAttribute(
                    "href",
                    baseURL
                );
            }

            return parsed
                .documentElement
                .outerHTML;
        }

        const safeBase =
            baseURL
                .replace(
                    /&/g,
                    "&"
                )
                .replace(
                    /"/g,
                    """
                );

        const baseTag =
            `<base href="${safeBase}">`;

        if (
            /<head\b[^>]*>/i.test(
                html
            )
        ) {
            return html.replace(
                /<head\b[^>]*>/i,
                match =>
                    `${match}${baseTag}`
            );
        }

        if (
            /<html\b[^>]*>/i.test(
                html
            )
        ) {
            return html.replace(
                /<html\b[^>]*>/i,
                match =>
                    `${match}<head>${baseTag}</head>`
            );
        }

        return `<!doctype html><html><head>${baseTag}</head><body>${html}</body></html>`;
    }

    /*
     * Fetch a game's raw HTML and turn it into a Blob URL.
     *
     * fetch(..., redirect:"follow") automatically follows
     * HTTP redirects. response.url gives us the final URL,
     * which is important for resolving relative assets.
     */
    async function createGameBlobURL(
        sourceURL
    ) {
        const response =
            await fetch(
                sourceURL,
                {
                    method: "GET",
                    redirect: "follow",
                    credentials: "omit",
                    cache: "no-cache"
                }
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Game HTML request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`
            );
        }

        const html =
            await response.text();

        const finalURL =
            response.url ||
            sourceURL;

        const baseURL =
            getGameBaseURL(
                finalURL
            );

        const documentHTML =
            injectGameBase(
                html,
                baseURL,
                finalURL
            );

        const blob =
            new Blob(
                [documentHTML],
                {
                    type:
                        "text/html;charset=utf-8"
                }
            );

        return URL.createObjectURL(
            blob
        );
    }

    /*
     * Revoke the currently active Blob URL.
     */
    function revokeCurrentGameBlobURL() {
        if (
            !currentGameBlobURL
        ) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(
                currentGameBlobURL
            );
        } catch {
            // Ignore cleanup failures.
        }

        currentGameBlobURL = null;
    }

    async function openGame(game) {
        if (!game) return;

        if (!game.link) {
            window.FusionNotify?.error?.(
                "This game does not have a playable link.",
                {
                    title:
                        "Unable to open game"
                }
            );

            return;
        }

        /*
         * Every open gets a unique token.
         *
         * If another game is opened while this fetch is
         * still running, the old request is prevented from
         * replacing the newer game.
         */
        const loadToken =
            ++gameLoadToken;

        currentGameId =
            game.id;

        if (titleHideTimer) {
            clearTimeout(
                titleHideTimer
            );

            titleHideTimer = null;
        }

        if (
            gameLoadNotification?.close
        ) {
            gameLoadNotification.close();
            gameLoadNotification = null;
        }

        revokeCurrentGameBlobURL();

        viewerTitle.textContent =
            game.name;

        viewerTitle.classList.remove(
            "is-visible"
        );

        viewerTitle.classList.add(
            "is-hidden"
        );

        viewer.classList.remove(
            "game-title-visible"
        );

        viewer.hidden = false;

        document.body.classList.add(
            "fusion-game-open"
        );

        /*
         * Start the title on the bottom edge,
         * then animate it upward.
         */
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (
                    gameLoadToken ===
                        loadToken &&
                    currentGameId ===
                        game.id &&
                    !viewer.hidden
                ) {
                    viewerTitle.classList.remove(
                        "is-hidden"
                    );

                    viewerTitle.classList.add(
                        "is-visible"
                    );

                    viewer.classList.add(
                        "game-title-visible"
                    );
                }
            });
        });

        gameLoadNotification =
            window.FusionNotify?.loading?.(
                `Loading ${game.name}…`,
                {
                    className:
                        "fusion-game-loading"
                }
            ) || null;

        /*
         * Clear the iframe while the new HTML is being
         * fetched. This also stops the previous document.
         */
        viewerFrame.src =
            "about:blank";

        try {
            const blobURL =
                await createGameBlobURL(
                    game.link
                );

            /*
             * The user may have closed the viewer or opened
             * another game while fetch() was running.
             *
             * Do not allow this stale request to replace
             * the current game.
             */
            if (
                gameLoadToken !==
                    loadToken ||
                currentGameId !==
                    game.id ||
                viewer.hidden
            ) {
                try {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(
                        blobURL
                    );
                } catch {
                    // Ignore cleanup failures.
                }

                return;
            }

            currentGameBlobURL =
                blobURL;

            viewerFrame.src =
                blobURL;

        } catch (error) {
            if (
                gameLoadToken !==
                    loadToken ||
                currentGameId !==
                    game.id
            ) {
                return;
            }

            if (
                gameLoadNotification?.close
            ) {
                gameLoadNotification.close();
                gameLoadNotification = null;
            }

            console.error(
                "[FUSION Games] Failed to load game HTML:",
                error
            );

            window.FusionNotify?.error?.(
                "The game could not be loaded. Please try again.",
                {
                    title:
                        "Game failed to load"
                }
            );

            viewerFrame.src =
                "about:blank";

            revokeCurrentGameBlobURL();
        }

        titleHideTimer =
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (
                    gameLoadToken ===
                        loadToken &&
                    currentGameId ===
                        game.id &&
                    !viewer.hidden
                ) {
                    viewerTitle.classList.remove(
                        "is-visible"
                    );

                    viewerTitle.classList.add(
                        "is-hidden"
                    );

                    viewer.classList.remove(
                        "game-title-visible"
                    );
                }
            }, 2000);
    }

    function closeGame() {
        /*
         * Invalidate every pending async game load.
         */
        ++gameLoadToken;

        currentGameId = null;

        if (titleHideTimer) {
            clearTimeout(
                titleHideTimer
            );

            titleHideTimer = null;
        }

        if (
            gameLoadNotification?.close
        ) {
            gameLoadNotification.close();
            gameLoadNotification = null;
        }

        viewerTitle.classList.remove(
            "is-visible"
        );

        viewerTitle.classList.add(
            "is-hidden"
        );

        viewer.classList.remove(
            "game-title-visible"
        );

        /*
         * Stop the game and any audio when the viewer closes.
         */
        viewerFrame.src =
            "about:blank";

        revokeCurrentGameBlobURL();

        viewerTitle.textContent =
            "";

        viewer.hidden = true;

        document.body.classList.remove(
            "fusion-game-open"
        );
    }

    /*
     * Consume a game request left by home.js.
     */
    function openRequestedGame() {
        const requestedId =
            window.FusionPendingGameId;

        if (
            requestedId == null
        ) {
            return;
        }

        delete window.FusionPendingGameId;

        const requestedGame =
            games.find(
                game =>
                    String(game.id) ===
                    String(requestedId)
            );

        if (!requestedGame) {
            return;
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            openGame(
                requestedGame
            );
        });
    }

    /*
     * Receive game-open requests from home.js.
     *
     * This is needed when the Games page has already
     * been rendered before the Home page sends the request.
     */
    function handleHomeGameRequest(
        event
    ) {
        const requestedId =
            event.detail?.id;

        if (
            requestedId == null
        ) {
            return;
        }

        const requestedGame =
            games.find(
                game =>
                    String(game.id) ===
                    String(requestedId)
            );

        if (requestedGame) {
            openGame(
                requestedGame
            );
        }
    }

    /*
     * Listen for Home → Games game requests.
     */
    window.addEventListener(
        "fusion:open-game",
        handleHomeGameRequest
    );

    function renderGrid() {
        const list =
            getFilteredGames();

        grid.innerHTML = "";

        if (!list.length) {
            grid.classList.add(
                "is-empty"
            );

            grid.innerHTML = `
                <div class="games-empty">

                    <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                        <circle
                            cx="10.8"
                            cy="10.8"
                            r="6.2"
                        ></circle>

                        <path
                            d="m16 16 4.2 4.2"
                        ></path>
                    </svg>

                    <p class="games-empty-title">
                        No games found
                    </p>

                    <p class="games-empty-subtext">
                        Try a different search term,
                        or clear your filters and try again.
                    </p>

                </div>
            `;

            return;
        }

        grid.classList.remove(
            "is-empty"
        );

        list.forEach(game => {
            const isFavorite =
                favorites.has(
                    game.id
                );

            const card =
                document.createElement(
                    "div"
                );

            card.className =
                "game-cube";

            card.style.setProperty(
                "--card-index",
                String(
                    grid.children.length
                )
            );

            card.style.animationDelay =
                `${Math.min(
                    grid.children.length,
                    12
                ) * 35}ms`;

            card.dataset.gameId =
                game.id;

            card.setAttribute(
                "role",
                "button"
            );

            card.setAttribute(
                "tabindex",
                "0"
            );

            card.setAttribute(
                "aria-label",
                `Play ${game.name}`
            );

            card.innerHTML = `
                <span
                    class="game-cube-face"
                    style="background-image:url('${game.img}')"
                ></span>

                <span
                    class="game-tags"
                    aria-label="Game tags"
                >
                    ${
                        game.hot
                            ? '<span class="game-badge game-badge-hot">HOT</span>'
                            : ""
                    }

                    ${
                        game.updated
                            ? '<span class="game-badge game-badge-updated">UPDATED</span>'
                            : ""
                    }

                    ${
                        game.new
                            ? '<span class="game-badge">NEW</span>'
                            : ""
                    }
                </span>

                <span class="game-cube-overlay">
                    <span class="game-cube-name">
                        ${game.name}
                    </span>
                </span>

                <button
                    type="button"
                    class="game-heart${
                        isFavorite
                            ? " active"
                            : ""
                    }"
                    aria-label="${
                        isFavorite
                            ? "Remove from favorites"
                            : "Add to favorites"
                    }"
                    aria-pressed="${isFavorite}"
                >
                    <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                        <path d="M20.42 4.58a5.4 5.4 0 0 0-7.65 0L12 5.36l-.77-.78a5.4 5.4 0 0 0-7.65 0C1.46 6.7 1.33 10.28 4 13l8 8 8-8c2.67-2.72 2.54-6.3.42-8.42z"></path>
                    </svg>
                </button>
            `;

            card.addEventListener(
                "click",
                () =>
                    openGame(
                        game
                    )
            );

            card.addEventListener(
                "keydown",
                event => {
                    if (
                        event.key ===
                            "Enter" ||
                        event.key ===
                            " "
                    ) {
                        event.preventDefault();

                        openGame(
                            game
                        );
                    }
                }
            );

            const heart =
                card.querySelector(
                    ".game-heart"
                );

            heart.addEventListener(
                "click",
                event => {
                    event.stopPropagation();

                    if (
                        favorites.has(
                            game.id
                        )
                    ) {
                        favorites.delete(
                            game.id
                        );
                    } else {
                        favorites.add(
                            game.id
                        );
                    }

                    saveFavorites(
                        favorites
                    );

                    const nowFavorite =
                        favorites.has(
                            game.id
                        );

                    heart.classList.toggle(
                        "active",
                        nowFavorite
                    );

                    heart.setAttribute(
                        "aria-pressed",
                        String(
                            nowFavorite
                        )
                    );

                    heart.setAttribute(
                        "aria-label",
                        nowFavorite
                            ? "Remove from favorites"
                            : "Add to favorites"
                    );

                    if (
                        nowFavorite
                    ) {
                        window.FusionNotify?.success?.(
                            `${game.name} added to favorites`,
                            {
                                duration:
                                    2600
                            }
                        );
                    } else {
                        window.FusionNotify?.info?.(
                            `${game.name} removed from favorites`,
                            {
                                duration:
                                    2200
                            }
                        );
                    }

                    if (
                        showFavoritesOnly &&
                        !nowFavorite
                    ) {
                        renderGrid();
                    }
                }
            );

            grid.appendChild(
                card
            );
        });
    }

    /*
     * Search.
     */
    searchInput.addEventListener(
        "input",
        () => {
            searchTerm =
                searchInput.value
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase();

            renderGrid();
        }
    );

    /*
     * Favorites.
     */
    favoritesBtn.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
            showFavoritesOnly =
                !showFavoritesOnly;

            favoritesBtn.classList.toggle(
                "active",
                showFavoritesOnly
            );

            favoritesBtn.setAttribute(
                "aria-pressed",
                String(
                    showFavoritesOnly
                )
            );

            renderGrid();
        }
    );

    /*
     * Random game.
     */
    randomBtn.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
            const list =
                getFilteredGames();

            if (!list.length) {
                window.FusionNotify?.info?.(
                    "No games match your current filters.",
                    {
                        title:
                            "No random game available"
                    }
                );

                return;
            }

            const choices =
                list.length > 1
                    ? list.filter(
                          game =>
                              game.id !==
                              currentGameId
                      )
                    : list;

            const pick =
                choices[
                    Math.floor(
                        Math.random() *
                            choices.length
                    )
                ];

            openGame(
                pick
            );
        }
    );

    viewerFrame.addEventListener(
        "load",
        () => {
            if (!currentGameId) {
                return;
            }

            if (
                gameLoadNotification?.close
            ) {
                gameLoadNotification.close();
                gameLoadNotification = null;
            }
        }
    );

    viewerFrame.addEventListener(
        "error",
        () => {
            if (
                gameLoadNotification?.close
            ) {
                gameLoadNotification.close();
                gameLoadNotification = null;
            }

            window.FusionNotify?.error?.(
                "The game could not be loaded. Please try again.",
                {
                    title:
                        "Game failed to load"
                }
            );
        }
    );

    /*
     * Close viewer.
     */
    viewerClose.addEventListener(
        "click",
        closeGame
    );

    /*
     * Escape closes the game.
     */
    const handleViewerKeydown =
        event => {
            if (
                event.key ===
                    "Escape" &&
                !viewer.hidden
            ) {
                event.preventDefault();

                closeGame();
            }
        };

    document.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        handleViewerKeydown
    );

    /*
     * Footer links.
     *
     * Same navigation behavior as the
     * Games page footer.
     */
    const termsLink =
        container.querySelector(
            '[data-footer-link="terms"]'
        );

    const privacyLink =
        container.querySelector(
            '[data-footer-link="privacy"]'
        );

    const navigate =
        page => {
            const button =
                document.querySelector(
                    `[data-page="${page}"]`
                ) ||
                document.getElementById(
                    `${page}-btn`
                );

            if (button) {
                button.click();
                return;
            }

            window.location.hash =
                page;
        };

    termsLink?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        event => {
            event.preventDefault();

            navigate(
                "terms"
            );
        }
    );

    privacyLink?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        event => {
            event.preventDefault();

            navigate(
                "privacy"
            );
        }
    );

    /*
     * Page containers remain mounted while navigation switches visibility,
     * so this page keeps a stable listener set instead of watching the whole
     * document for DOM changes.
     */

    /*
     * Render the normal game grid first.
     */
    renderGrid();

    /*
     * Finally check whether Home requested
     * a specific game.
     *
     * This covers the case where Games wasn't
     * mounted when Home sent the request.
     */
    openRequestedGame();
}
;return { render };

});

<script>
__fusionDefine("assets/pages/home.js", async function () { "use strict";
// assets/pages/home.js
//

//

function render(container) {
    container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="fusion-home">

            <section class="home-intro">
                <div class="home-brand">
                    <img
                        src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"

                    </p>
                </div>

                <div class="home-actions">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="home-primary-btn"
                        data-home-action="games"
                    >
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M17.32 5H6.68a4 4 0 0 0-3.978 3.59c-.006.052-.01.101-.017.152C2.604 9.416 2 14.456 2 16a3 3 0 0 0 3 3c1 0 1.5-.5 2-1l1.414-1.414A2 2 0 0 1 9.828 16h4.344a2 2 0 0 1 1.414.586L17 18c.5.5 1 1 2 1a3 3 0 0 0 3-3c0-1.545-.604-6.584-.685-7.258-.007-.05-.011-.1-.017-.151A4 4 0 0 0 17.32 5z"></path>
                            <line x1="6" x2="10" y1="11" y2="11"></line>
                            <line x1="8" x2="8" y1="9" y2="13"></line>
                            <line x1="15" x2="15.01" y1="12" y2="12"></line>
                            <line x1="18" x2="18.01" y1="10" y2="10"></line>
                        </svg>
                        Play Now
                    </button>
                </div>
            </section>

            <section class="home-popular">

                <div class="home-popular-head">

                    </h2>

                    <button
                        type="button"

                    >
                        View All

                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"></path>
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div
                    class="popular-grid"
                    data-popular-grid
                ></div>

            </section>

            <footer class="games-footer">

                <div class="games-footer-brand">
                    <img
                        class="games-footer-logo"
                        src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"
                        alt="FUSION"
                    >
                </div>

                <div class="games-footer-info">

                    <p class="games-footer-text">
                        © ${new Date().getFullYear()} FUSION · Games for everyone.

                    <span

                    <nav

                        >
                            Privacy
                        </a>
                    </nav>

                </div>

            </footer>

        </div>

        <style>

            /* =========================================
               HOME PAGE
            ========================================= */

            .fusion-home {
                position: relative;

                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: center;

                width: 100%;

                }

            }


            /* =========================================

            .home-intro {

            }

            .home-tagline {

                color:

            .home-actions {

            }

                    rgba(105,92,254,.92);

                    box-shadow .18s ease;
            }

            .home-primary-btn::before {
                content: "";

                position: absolute;

                inset: 0;

                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        115deg,
                        transparent 30%,
                        rgba(255,255,255,.28) 48%,
                        transparent 66%
                    );

                transform:
                    translateX(-120%);

                transition:
                    transform .55s ease;
            }

            .home-primary-btn:hover::before {
                transform:
                    translateX(120%);
            }

            .home-primary-btn:hover {
                transform: translateY(-2px);

                background: #7569ff;

                border-color: #8278ff;

                box-shadow:
                    0 10px 34px
                    rgba(105,92,254,.28);
            }

            .home-primary-btn:active {
                transform: translateY(0);
            }

            .home-primary-btn svg {
                width: 16px;
                height: 16px;

                fill: none;

                stroke: currentColor;

                stroke-width: 1.7;

                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }


            /* =========================================
               POPULAR GAMES
            ========================================= */

            .home-popular {
                position: relative;
                z-index: 5;

                width: 100%;
                max-width: 1180px;

                margin-top: 46px;

                animation:
                    home-fade-up .6s ease .1s both;
            }

            /*
             * Keep Popular Games and View All on

             */
            .home-popular-head {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: space-between;

                width: 100%;

                margin-bottom: 18px;
            }

            .home-popular-title {

                letter-spacing: .01em;

                border-radius: 3px;

                    linear-gradient(

                        #8f85ff,
                        rgba(105,92,254,.4)
                    );
            }

            .home-popular-viewall {
                display: inline-flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 6px;

                padding: 0;

                border: none;

                background: none;

                color:
                    rgba(255,255,255,.55);

                font: inherit;
                font-size: 12px;
                font-weight: 600;

                cursor: pointer;

                transition:
                    color .18s ease;
            }

            .home-popular-viewall:hover {
                color: #fff;
            }

            .home-popular-viewall svg {
                width: 14px;
                height: 14px;

                fill: none;

                stroke: currentColor;

                transition:
                    transform .18s ease;
            }

            .home-popular-viewall:hover svg {
                transform: translateX(2px);
            }

            .popular-grid {
                display: grid;

                grid-template-columns: 1fr;

                gap: 28px;
