                margin: 0 auto;
            }

            @media (min-width: 700px) {

                .popular-grid {
                    grid-template-columns:
                        repeat(
                            3,
                            minmax(0, 1fr)
                        );

                    gap: 30px;
                }

            }


            /* =========================================
               GAME CARD
            ========================================= */

            .tilt-wrap {
                position: relative;

                width: 100%;
                max-width: 230px;

                perspective: 1100px;

                --tilt-rx: 0deg;
                --tilt-ry: 0deg;
                --tilt-scale: 1;

                animation:
                    home-fade-in .5s ease
                    both;
            }

            .tilt-wrap:nth-child(1) {
                animation-delay: .16s;
            }

            .tilt-wrap:nth-child(2) {
                animation-delay: .24s;
            }

            .tilt-wrap:nth-child(3) {
                animation-delay: .32s;
            }

            @media (min-width: 700px) {

                .tilt-wrap.is-rank-1 {
                    order: 2;

                    transform:
                        translateY(-1.5rem)
                        scale(1.05);
                }

                .tilt-wrap.is-rank-2 {
                    order: 1;

                    transform:
                        translateY(-.5rem);
                }

                .tilt-wrap.is-rank-3 {
                    order: 3;

                    transform:
                        translateY(.5rem);
                }

            }

            .home-game-card {
                position: relative;

                display: block;

                width: 100%;

                aspect-ratio: 1.08 / 1;

                overflow: hidden;

                border:
                    1px solid
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .075
                    );

                border-radius: 16px;

                background: #111215;

                cursor: pointer;

                padding: 0;

                text-align: left;

                transform:
                    rotateX(
                        var(--tilt-rx)
                    )
                    rotateY(
                        var(--tilt-ry)
                    )
                    scale3d(
                        var(--tilt-scale),
                        var(--tilt-scale),
                        var(--tilt-scale)
                    );

                transition:
                    transform .15s ease-out,
                    border-color .18s ease,
                    box-shadow .2s ease;
            }

            .tilt-wrap.is-rank-1
            .home-game-card {
                border-color:
                    rgba(
                        105,
                        92,
                        254,
                        .55
                    );

                box-shadow:
                    0 22px 46px
                    rgba(
                        105,
                        92,
                        254,
                        .28
                    );
            }

            .tilt-wrap.is-rank-2
            .home-game-card {
                border-color:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .16
                    );

                box-shadow:
                    0 16px 32px
                    rgba(0,0,0,.4);
            }

            .tilt-wrap.is-rank-3
            .home-game-card {
                border-color:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .1
                    );

                box-shadow:
                    0 14px 26px
                    rgba(0,0,0,.36);
            }

            .home-game-rank {
                position: absolute;

                top: 10px;
                left: 10px;

                z-index: 3;

                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                min-width: 24px;
                height: 22px;

                padding: 0 7px;

                border-radius: 999px;

                border:
                    1px solid
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .18
                    );

                background:
                    rgba(
                        8,
                        8,
                        11,
                        .72
                    );

                color: #fff;

                font-size: 10px;
                font-weight: 700;

                letter-spacing: .04em;
            }

            .tilt-wrap.is-rank-1
            .home-game-rank {
                border-color:
                    rgba(
                        105,
                        92,
                        254,
                        .6
                    );

                background:
                    rgba(
                        105,
                        92,
                        254,
                        .85
                    );
            }

            .home-game-shine {
                position: absolute;

                inset: 0;

                border-radius: inherit;

                pointer-events: none;

                mix-blend-mode: screen;

                opacity: 0;

                transition:
                    opacity .15s ease-out;
            }

            .home-game-image {
                position: absolute;

                inset: 0;

                display: block;

                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;

                object-fit: cover;
                object-position: center;

                opacity: 0;

                background: #111215;

                transition:
                    transform .3s ease,
                    opacity .25s ease;
            }

            .home-game-image.is-loaded {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            .home-game-card::before {
                content: "";

                position: absolute;

                inset: 0;

                z-index: 1;

                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        100deg,
                        rgba(255,255,255,0) 35%,
                        rgba(255,255,255,.06) 50%,
                        rgba(255,255,255,0) 65%
                    );

                background-size: 200% 100%;

                opacity: 1;

                animation:
                    home-shimmer 1.6s
                    ease-in-out
                    infinite;

                transition: opacity .2s ease;

                pointer-events: none;
            }

            .home-game-card:has(.home-game-image.is-loaded)::before,
            .home-game-card:not(:has(.home-game-image))::before {
                opacity: 0;
                animation: none;
            }

            @keyframes home-shimmer {

                0% {
                    background-position: 140% 0;
                }

                100% {
                    background-position: -40% 0;
                }

            }

            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

                .home-game-card::before {
                    animation: none;
                    opacity: 0;
                }

            }

            .home-game-card:hover
            .home-game-image {
                transform:
                    scale(1.055);
            }

            .home-game-fallback {
                position: absolute;

                inset: 0;

                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        155deg,
                        rgba(
                            105,
                            92,
                            254,
                            .35
                        ),
                        rgba(
                            20,
                            20,
                            26,
                            .9
                        )
                    );

                color:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .85
                    );

                font-size: 34px;
                font-weight: 700;
            }

            .home-game-overlay {
                position: absolute;

                inset: 0;

                pointer-events: none;

                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        to bottom,
                        rgba(5,5,7,0) 20%,
                        rgba(5,5,7,.02) 42%,
                        rgba(5,5,7,.28) 65%,
                        rgba(5,5,7,.9) 100%
                    );
            }

            .home-game-info {
                position: absolute;

                right: 11px;
                bottom: 11px;
                left: 11px;

                z-index: 2;

                pointer-events: none;
            }

            .home-game-name {
                display: block;

                overflow: hidden;

                color: #fff;

                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 700;

                line-height: 1.3;

                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;

                text-shadow:
                    0 1px 5px
                    rgba(0,0,0,.7),
                    0 2px 10px
                    rgba(0,0,0,.5);
            }

            .home-game-category {
                display: block;

                margin-top: 4px;

                overflow: hidden;

                color:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .65
                    );

                font-size: 9px;
                font-weight: 500;

                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;

                text-shadow:
                    0 1px 7px
                    rgba(0,0,0,.7);
            }

            .home-popular-empty {
                padding: 30px 0;

                color:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .45
                    );

                font-size: 12px;

                text-align: center;
            }


            /* =========================================
               FOOTER
            ========================================= */

            .games-footer {
                flex-shrink: 0;

                width: min(
                    100%,
                    560px
                );

                margin:
                    70px auto 8px;

                padding:
                    22px 24px 20px;

                border-top:
                    1px solid
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .08
                    );

                display: flex;

                flex-direction: column;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 11px;

                text-align: center;

                animation:
                    home-fade-in .6s ease .2s
                    both;
            }

            .games-footer-brand {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .games-footer-logo {
                display: block;

                width: 112px;
                height: auto;

                max-width: 100%;

                opacity: .72;
            }

            .games-footer-info {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                flex-wrap: wrap;

                gap:
                    7px 12px;
            }

            .games-footer-text {
                margin: 0;

                color:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .38
                    );

                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 500;

                line-height: 1.5;
            }

            .games-footer-links {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 10px;
            }

            .games-footer-link {
                color:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .52
                    );

                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 600;

                text-decoration: none;

                transition:
                    color .16s ease;
            }

            .games-footer-link:hover {
                color: #fff;
            }

            .games-footer-separator {
                width: 3px;
                height: 3px;

                border-radius: 50%;

                background:
                    rgba(
                        255,
                        255,
                        255,
                        .22
                    );
            }


            /* =========================================
               RESPONSIVE
            ========================================= */

            @media (max-width: 1050px) {

                .fusion-home {
                    padding:
                        76px
                        25px
                        30px;
                }

                .home-logo {
                    width: 320px;
                }

            }

            @media (max-width: 800px) {

                .fusion-home {
                    padding:
                        66px
                        20px
                        30px;
                }

                .home-logo {
                    width: 280px;
                }

                .popular-grid {
                    grid-template-columns:
                        repeat(
                            3,
                            1fr
                        );

                    gap: 12px;
                }

            }

            @media (max-width: 500px) {

                .fusion-home {
                    padding:
                        58px
                        16px
                        25px;
                }

                .home-logo {
                    width: 230px;
                }

                .home-primary-btn {
                    width: 100%;
                }

                .popular-grid {
                    grid-template-columns:
                        repeat(
                            auto-fill,
                            minmax(
                                120px,
                                1fr
                            )
                        );
                }

                .games-footer {
                    width: 100%;

                    padding:
                        20px
                        10px
                        16px;

                    margin-top: 50px;
                }

                .games-footer-logo {
                    width: 100px;
                }

                .games-footer-info {
                    flex-direction: column;

                    gap: 8px;
                }

            }

            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

                .home-game-card,
                .home-primary-btn,
                .home-popular-viewall svg {
                    transition: none;
                }

                .home-intro,
                .home-popular,
                .games-footer,
                .tilt-wrap,
                .home-primary-btn::before {
                    animation: none;
                    opacity: 1;
                    transform: none;
                }

            }

        </style>
    `;

    /*
     * Make the Home page itself capable of scrolling.
     */
    container.style.height = "100%";
    container.style.minHeight = "0";
    container.style.overflow = "auto";
    container.style.boxSizing = "border-box";


    /* =========================================
       GAME DATA
    ========================================= */

    const allGames = Array.isArray(games)
        ? games.filter(Boolean)
        : [];


    const getName = game =>
        game.name ||
        game.title ||
        game.gameName ||
        "Untitled Game";


    const getImage = game => {

        const image =
            game.img ||
            game.image ||
            game.thumbnail ||
            game.thumb ||
            game.cover ||
            game.icon ||
            game.imageUrl ||
            game.thumbnailUrl ||
            game.coverImage ||
            game.coverUrl ||
            "";

        if (typeof image === "string") {
            return image;
        }

        if (
            image &&
            typeof image === "object"
        ) {
            return (
                image.url ||
                image.src ||
                image.path ||
                image.href ||
                ""
            );
        }

        return "";
    };


    const resolveImage = image => {

        if (!image) {
            return "";
        }

        if (
            /^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(
                image
            ) ||
            image.startsWith("data:")
        ) {
            return image;
        }

        try {
            return new URL(
                image,
                document.baseURI
            ).href;
        } catch {
            return image;
        }
    };


    const getCategory = game =>
        game.category ||
        game.genre ||
        game.type ||
        "Game";


    const escapeHTML = value =>
        String(value ?? "")
            .replace(
                /&/g,
                "&"
            )
            .replace(
                /</g,
                "<"
            )
            .replace(
                />/g,
                ">"
            )
            .replace(
                /"/g,
                """
            )
            .replace(
                /'/g,
                "'"
            );


    /*
     * Popular Games use games marked hot.
     * If there are fewer than three hot games,
     * fill the remaining slots with other games.
     */
    const getPopularGames = (
        list,
        limit
    ) => {

        const hotGames =
            list.filter(
                game =>
                    game.hot === true
            );

        if (
            hotGames.length >=
            limit
        ) {
            return hotGames.slice(
                0,
                limit
            );
        }

        const remaining =
            list.filter(
                game =>
                    !hotGames.includes(
                        game
                    )
            );

        return [
            ...hotGames,
            ...remaining
        ].slice(
            0,
            limit
        );
    };


    /*
     * Home cards select the game and
     * send it to the Games page.
     */
    const openGame = game => {

        if (!game) {
            return;
        }

        window.FusionPendingGameId =
            game.id;

        navigate("games");

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {

            window.dispatchEvent(
                new CustomEvent(
                    "fusion:open-game",
                    {
                        detail: {
                            id: game.id
                        }
                    }
                )
            );

        });
    };


    const navigate = page => {

        const button =
            document.querySelector(
                `[data-page="${page}"]`
            ) ||
            document.getElementById(
                `${page}-btn`
            );

        if (button) {
            button.click();
            return;
        }

        window.location.hash =
            page;
    };


    /*
     * Navigation buttons.
     */
    container
        .querySelectorAll(
            '[data-home-action="games"]'
        )
        .forEach(el => {

            el.addEventListener(
                "click",
                () => navigate("games")
            );

        });


    /* =========================================
       RENDER POPULAR GAMES
    ========================================= */

    const grid =
        container.querySelector(
            "[data-popular-grid]"
        );

    const popularGames =
        getPopularGames(
            allGames,
            3
        );


    if (!popularGames.length) {

        grid.innerHTML = `
            <p class="home-popular-empty">
                No games found yet.
            </p>
        `;

        return;
    }


    grid.innerHTML =
        popularGames
            .map(
                (
                    game,
                    index
                ) => {

                    const name =
                        getName(game);

                    const image =
                        resolveImage(
                            getImage(game)
                        );

                    const category =
                        getCategory(game);

                    const initial =
                        escapeHTML(
                            name
                                .trim()
                                .charAt(
                                    0
                                )
                                .toUpperCase() ||
                            "?"
                        );

                    const rank =
                        index + 1;


                    return `
                        <div
                            class="tilt-wrap is-rank-${rank}"
                        >

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                class="home-game-card"
                                data-game-index="${index}"
                                aria-label="Play ${escapeHTML(name)}"
                            >

                                <span
                                    class="home-game-rank"
                                >
                                    #${rank}
                                </span>

                                <span
                                    class="home-game-fallback"
                                >
                                    ${initial}
                                </span>

                                ${
                                    image
                                        ? `
                                            <img
                                                class="home-game-image"
                                                src="${escapeHTML(image)}"
                                                alt=""
                                                loading="eager"
                                                decoding="async"
                                                draggable="false"
                                            >
                                        `
                                        : ""
                                }

                                <span
                                    class="home-game-overlay"
                                ></span>

                                <span
                                    class="home-game-shine"
                                ></span>

                                <span
                                    class="home-game-info"
                                >

                                    <span
                                        class="home-game-name"
                                    >
                                        ${escapeHTML(name)}
                                    </span>

                                    <span
                                        class="home-game-category"
                                    >
                                        ${escapeHTML(category)}
                                    </span>

                                </span>

                            </button>

                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            )
            .join("");


    /* =========================================
       CARD INTERACTIONS
    ========================================= */

    grid
        .querySelectorAll(
            ".tilt-wrap"
        )
        .forEach(wrap => {

            const card =
                wrap.querySelector(
                    ".home-game-card"
                );

            const shine =
                wrap.querySelector(
                    ".home-game-shine"
                );

            const cardIndex =
                Number(
                    card.dataset
                        .gameIndex
                );

            const sourceGame =
                popularGames[
                    cardIndex
                ];


            card.addEventListener(
                "click",
                () => {
                    openGame(
                        sourceGame
                    );
                }
            );


            card.addEventListener(
                "mousemove",
                e => {

                    const rect =
                        card.getBoundingClientRect();

                    const px =
                        (
                            e.clientX -
                            rect.left
                        ) /
                        rect.width;

                    const py =
                        (
                            e.clientY -
                            rect.top
                        ) /
                        rect.height;

                    const ry =
                        Math.max(
                            -14,
                            Math.min(
                                14,
                                (
                                    px -
                                    0.5
                                ) * 28
                            )
                        );

                    const rx =
                        Math.max(
                            -14,
                            Math.min(
                                14,
                                (
                                    0.5 -
                                    py
                                ) * 28
                            )
                        );

                    const dx =
                        px - 0.5;

                    const dy =
                        py - 0.5;

                    const dist =
                        Math.min(
                            1,
                            Math.sqrt(
                                dx * dx +
                                dy * dy
                            ) /
                            0.7071
                        );


                    wrap.style.setProperty(
                        "--tilt-rx",
                        `${rx.toFixed(2)}deg`
                    );

                    wrap.style.setProperty(
                        "--tilt-ry",
                        `${ry.toFixed(2)}deg`
                    );

                    wrap.style.setProperty(
                        "--tilt-scale",
                        "1.02"
                    );

                    shine.style.opacity =
                        (
                            0.22 +
                            dist * 0.34
                        ).toFixed(3);


                    shine.style.background =
                        `radial-gradient(
                            circle at
                            ${Math.round(
                                px * 100
                            )}%
                            ${Math.round(
                                py * 100
                            )}%,
                            rgba(
                                255,
                                255,
                                255,
                                0.26
                            ) 0%,
                            transparent 42%
                        )`;

                }
            );


            card.addEventListener(
                "mouseleave",
                () => {

                    wrap.style.setProperty(
                        "--tilt-rx",
                        "0deg"
                    );

                    wrap.style.setProperty(
                        "--tilt-ry",
                        "0deg"
                    );

                    wrap.style.setProperty(
                        "--tilt-scale",
                        "1"
                    );

                    shine.style.opacity =
                        "0";
                }
            );


            const img =
                card.querySelector(
                    ".home-game-image"
                );


            if (img) {

                if (
                    img.complete &&
                    img.naturalWidth > 0
                ) {

                    img.classList.add(
                        "is-loaded"
                    );

                } else {

                    img.addEventListener(
                        "load",
                        () => {

                            img.classList.add(
                                "is-loaded"
                            );

                        }
                    );


                    img.addEventListener(
                        "error",
                        () => {

                            img.remove();

                        }
                    );

                }

            }

        });

}
;return { render };

});

</script>
<script>
__fusionDefine("assets/pages/leaderboard.js", async function () { "use strict";
// assets/pages/leaderboard.js
//
// FUSION Leaderboard page
//
// Data source:
//   assets/scores.js
//
// Expected global:
//   leaderboardData = {
//       submitUrl: "...",
//       games: [...]
//   }
//
// Each game has one top score.
//
// scoreType:
//   - "score" = higher is better
//   - "time"  = lower is better
//
// The order of games comes directly from scores.js.
//

const { getGameDataUrl, loadScores } = (await __fusionImport("../env.js", "assets/pages"));
const { games: gameData } = await __fusionImport(await getGameDataUrl(), "assets/pages");
await loadScores(); // sets window.leaderboardData (latest scores_vN.js from the CDN)

function render(container) {
    container.innerHTML = `
        <style>
            /* =====================================================
               LEADERBOARD PAGE
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-page {
                width: 100%;
                min-height: 100%;

                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;

                /* Breathing room inside the page frame. */
                padding: 32px 36px 40px;
            }

            /* =====================================================
               HEADER
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-header {
                width: 100%;

                display: flex;
                align-items: flex-end;
                justify-content: space-between;

                gap: 24px;

                margin-bottom: 24px;

                animation:
                    leaderboard-header-in
                    .55s
                    cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
                    both;
            }

            .leaderboard-header-copy {
                min-width: 0;
            }

            .leaderboard-title {
                margin: 0;

                font-size: 30px;
                line-height: 1.1;

                font-weight: 700;
                letter-spacing: -.7px;

                color: #fff;
            }

            .leaderboard-subtitle {
                margin: 7px 0 0;

                font-size: 14px;
                line-height: 1.5;

                font-weight: 500;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.48);
            }

            .leaderboard-submit {
                flex-shrink: 0;

                display: inline-flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 8px;

                min-height: 42px;

                padding: 0 16px;

                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
                border-radius: 11px;

                background: rgba(255,255,255,.065);
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.88);

                font-family: inherit;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 700;

                cursor: pointer;

                transition:
                    background .18s ease,
                    border-color .18s ease,
                    transform .15s ease;
            }

            .leaderboard-submit:hover {
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
                border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.20);
            }

            .leaderboard-submit:active {
                transform: scale(.97);
            }

            .leaderboard-submit svg {
                width: 17px;
                height: 17px;

                fill: none;
                stroke: currentColor;

                stroke-width: 1.8;
                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            /* =====================================================
               GAME GRID
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-grid {
                width: 100%;

                display: grid;

                grid-template-columns:
                    repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

                gap: 14px;
            }

            /* =====================================================
               GAME CARD
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-card {
                position: relative;

                min-width: 0;

                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;

                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
                border-radius: 16px;

                background: rgba(17,18,21,.72);

                overflow: hidden;

                cursor: pointer;

                transition:
                    border-color .2s ease,
                    background .2s ease,
                    transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),
                    box-shadow .2s ease;

                animation:
                    leaderboard-card-in
                    .5s
                    cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
                    both;
            }

            .leaderboard-card:hover {
                transform: translateY(-3px);

                border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.18);

                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        145deg,
                        rgba(255,255,255,.10),
                        rgba(255,255,255,.045)
                    );

                box-shadow:
                    0 16px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
            }

            .leaderboard-card:active {
                transform: translateY(-1px) scale(.995);
            }

            /* =====================================================
               IMAGE
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-card-image-wrap {
                position: relative;

                width: 100%;

                aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;

                overflow: hidden;

                background: rgba(255,255,255,.035);
            }

            .leaderboard-card-image {
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;

                display: block;

                object-fit: cover;

                transition:
                    transform .35s
                    cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
            }

            .leaderboard-card:hover
            .leaderboard-card-image {
                transform: scale(1.035);
            }

            .leaderboard-card-image.is-missing {
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;

                opacity: .25;
            }

            /* =====================================================
               RANK
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-card-rank {
                position: absolute;

                top: 10px;
                left: 10px;

                display: inline-flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                min-width: 31px;
                height: 28px;

                padding: 0 9px;

                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
                border-radius: 8px;

                background: rgba(8,8,9,.72);

                backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
                -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);

                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 700;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.80);
            }

            /* =====================================================
               CARD BODY
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-card-body {
                min-width: 0;

                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;

                padding: 15px 16px 17px;
            }

            .leaderboard-card-name {
                margin: 0;

                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;

                font-size: 17px;
                line-height: 1.25;

                font-weight: 700;
                letter-spacing: -.2px;

                color: #fff;
            }

            .leaderboard-card-player {
                margin-top: 5px;

                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;

                font-size: 12px;
                font-weight: 500;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
            }

            /* =====================================================
               SCORE
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-card-score {
                display: flex;

                align-items: baseline;

                gap: 6px;

                margin-top: 13px;
            }

            .leaderboard-card-score-value {
                font-size: 24px;
                line-height: 1;

                font-weight: 700;
                letter-spacing: -.6px;

                color: #fff;
            }

            .leaderboard-card-score-unit {
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 600;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.40);
            }

            .leaderboard-card-empty {
                margin-top: 13px;

                font-size: 13px;
                line-height: 1;

                font-weight: 600;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.30);
            }

            /* =====================================================
               DATE
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-card-date {
                margin-top: 7px;

                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 500;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.32);
            }

            /* =====================================================
               NO DATA
            ===================================================== */

            .leaderboard-empty {
                grid-column: 1 / -1;

                min-height: 260px;

                display: flex;

                flex-direction: column;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                text-align: center;

                padding: 40px;

                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
                border-radius: 16px;

                background: rgba(255,255,255,.025);
            }

            .leaderboard-empty-icon {
                width: 42px;
                height: 42px;

                margin-bottom: 14px;

                fill: none;

                stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.40);

                stroke-width: 1.5;

                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round;
            }

            .leaderboard-empty-title {
                margin: 0;

                font-size: 18px;
                font-weight: 700;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
            }

            .leaderboard-empty-text {
                max-width: 420px;

                margin: 7px 0 0;

                font-size: 13px;
                line-height: 1.5;

                font-weight: 500;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.40);
            }

            /* =====================================================
               FOOTER
            ===================================================== */

            .games-footer {
                flex-shrink: 0;

                width: min(100%, 560px);

                margin: 34px auto 8px;

                padding: 22px 24px 20px;

                border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);

                display: flex;

                flex-direction: column;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 11px;

                text-align: center;
            }

            .games-footer-brand {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .games-footer-logo {
                display: block;

                width: 112px;

                height: auto;

                max-width: 100%;

                opacity: .72;
            }

            .games-footer-info {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                flex-wrap: wrap;

                gap: 7px 12px;
            }

            .games-footer-text {
                margin: 0;

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.38);

                font-size: 11px;

                font-weight: 500;

                line-height: 1.5;
            }

            .games-footer-links {
                display: flex;

                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                gap: 10px;
            }

            .games-footer-link {
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.52);

                font-size: 11px;

                font-weight: 600;

                text-decoration: none;

                transition: color .16s ease;
            }

            .games-footer-link:hover {
                color: #fff;
            }

            .games-footer-separator {
                width: 3px;
                height: 3px;

                border-radius: 50%;

                background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
            }

            /* =====================================================
               ANIMATIONS
            ===================================================== */

            @keyframes leaderboard-header-in {
                from {
                    opacity: 0;
                    transform: translateY(9px);
                }

                to {
                    opacity: 1;
                    transform: translateY(0);
                }
            }

            @keyframes leaderboard-card-in {
                from {
                    opacity: 0;
                    transform: translateY(14px);
                }

                to {
                    opacity: 1;
                    transform: translateY(0);
                }
            }

            /* =====================================================
               RESPONSIVE
            ===================================================== */

            @media (max-width: 1050px) {
                .leaderboard-grid {
                    grid-template-columns:
                        repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
                }
            }

            @media (max-width: 650px) {
                .leaderboard-page {
                    padding: 20px 16px 32px;
                }

                .leaderboard-header {
                    align-items: flex-start;

                    flex-direction: column;

                    gap: 14px;
                }

                .leaderboard-submit {
                    width: 100%;
                }

                .leaderboard-grid {
                    grid-template-columns: 1fr;

                    gap: 12px;
                }
            }

            @media (max-width: 430px) {
                .leaderboard-title {
                    font-size: 26px;
                }

                .leaderboard-card-body {
                    padding: 13px 14px 15px;
                }

                .leaderboard-card-score-value {
                    font-size: 21px;
                }
            }
        </style>

        <div class="leaderboard-page">

            <header class="leaderboard-header">

                <div class="leaderboard-header-copy">

                    <h1 class="leaderboard-title">
                        Leaderboard
                    </h1>

                    <p class="leaderboard-subtitle">
                        The best scores across FUSION games.
                    </p>

                </div>

                <button
                    class="leaderboard-submit"
                    type="button"
                    data-leaderboard-submit
                >
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                        <path d="M12 3v12"></path>
                        <path d="m7 8 5-5 5 5"></path>
                        <path d="M5 21h14"></path>
                    </svg>

                    <span>
                        Submit Your Score
                    </span>
                </button>

            </header>

            <div
                class="leaderboard-grid"
                data-leaderboard-grid
            ></div>

            <footer class="games-footer">

                <div class="games-footer-brand">

                    <img
                        class="games-footer-logo"
                        src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"
                        alt="FUSION"
                    >

                </div>

                <div class="games-footer-info">

                    <p class="games-footer-text">
                        © ${new Date().getFullYear()} FUSION · Games for everyone.
                    </p>

                    <span
                        class="games-footer-separator"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    ></span>

                    <nav
                        class="games-footer-links"
                        aria-label="Legal"
                    >

                        <a
                            class="games-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="terms"
                        >
                            Terms
                        </a>

                        <a
                            class="games-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="privacy"
                        >
                            Privacy
                        </a>

                    </nav>

                </div>

            </footer>

        </div>
    `;

    const grid =
        container.querySelector(
            "[data-leaderboard-grid]"
        );

    const submitButton =
        container.querySelector(
            "[data-leaderboard-submit]"
        );

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * DATA
     * ==========================================================
     */

    const data =
        window.leaderboardData;

    const scoreGames =
        Array.isArray(data?.games)
            ? data.games
            : [];

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * GAME DATA LOOKUP
     * ==========================================================
     */

    const gameMap =
        new Map(
            gameData.map(game => [
                String(game.id),
                game
            ])
        );

    const mergedGames =
        scoreGames.map(scoreGame => {

            const game =
                gameMap.get(
                    String(scoreGame.id)
                );

            return {
                ...game,
                ...scoreGame,

                img:
                    scoreGame.img ||
                    game?.img ||
                    ""
            };
        });

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * HELPERS
     * ==========================================================
     */

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&")
            .replace(/</g, "<")
            .replace(/>/g, ">")
            .replace(/"/g, """)
            .replace(/'/g, "'");
    }

    function formatDate(dateString) {

        if (!dateString) {
            return "";
        }

        const date =
            new Date(
                `${dateString}T00:00:00`
            );

        if (
            Number.isNaN(
                date.getTime()
            )
        ) {
            return String(dateString);
        }

        return date.toLocaleDateString(
            undefined,
            {
                month: "short",
                day: "numeric",
                year: "numeric"
            }
        );
    }

    function getScoreDisplay(game) {

        if (!game.entry) {
            return "";
        }

        return (
            game.entry.display ??
            String(
                game.entry.score ??
                ""
            )
        );
    }

    function getScoreUnit(game) {

        if (!game.entry) {
            return "";
        }

        return game.scoreUnit || "";
    }

    function createImage(game) {

        if (!game.img) {

            return `
                <div
                    class="leaderboard-card-image is-missing"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                ></div>
            `;

        }

        return `
            <img
                class="leaderboard-card-image"
                src="${escapeHtml(game.img)}"
                alt=""
                loading="lazy"
                decoding="async"
                data-game-image
            >
        `;
    }

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * RENDER CARDS
     * ==========================================================
     */

    if (!mergedGames.length) {

        grid.innerHTML = `

            <div class="leaderboard-empty">

                <svg
                    class="leaderboard-empty-icon"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                >
                    <path d="M8 21h8"></path>
                    <path d="M9 21v-4"></path>
                    <path d="M15 21v-4"></path>
                    <path d="M7 4h10"></path>
                    <path d="M9 4v4a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V4"></path>
                    <path d="M7 5H5v2a4 4 0 0 0 4 4"></path>
                    <path d="M17 5h2v2a4 4 0 0 1-4 4"></path>
                </svg>

                <h2 class="leaderboard-empty-title">
                    No leaderboard data
                </h2>

                <p class="leaderboard-empty-text">
                    Leaderboard scores will appear here once
                    score data has been added.
                </p>

            </div>

        `;

    } else {

        grid.innerHTML =
            mergedGames
                .map((game, index) => {

                    const hasEntry =
                        Boolean(
                            game.entry &&
                            typeof game.entry === "object"
                        );

                    const display =
                        hasEntry
                            ? getScoreDisplay(game)
                            : "";

                    const unit =
                        hasEntry
                            ? getScoreUnit(game)
                            : "";

                    const player =
                        hasEntry
                            ? (
                                game.entry.name ||
                                "Anonymous"
                            )
                            : "";

                    const date =
                        hasEntry
                            ? formatDate(
                                game.entry.date
                            )
                            : "";

                    return `

                        <article
                            class="leaderboard-card"
                            data-game-id="${escapeHtml(game.id)}"
                            tabindex="0"
                            role="button"
                            aria-label="Open ${escapeHtml(game.name)}"
                            style="
                                animation-delay:${Math.min(
                                    index * 55,
                                    600
                                )}ms
                            "
                        >

                            <div
                                class="leaderboard-card-image-wrap"
                            >

                                ${createImage(game)}

                                <div
                                    class="leaderboard-card-rank"
                                >
                                    #${index + 1}
                                </div>

                            </div>

                            <div
                                class="leaderboard-card-body"
                            >

                                <h2
                                    class="leaderboard-card-name"
                                >
                                    ${escapeHtml(game.name)}
                                </h2>

                                ${
                                    hasEntry
                                        ? `
                                            <div
                                                class="leaderboard-card-player"
                                            >
                                                ${escapeHtml(player)}
                                            </div>
                                        `
                                        : `
                                            <div
                                                class="leaderboard-card-player"
                                            >
                                                No score submitted
                                            </div>
                                        `
                                }

                                ${
                                    hasEntry
                                        ? `
                                            <div
                                                class="leaderboard-card-score"
                                            >

                                                <span
                                                    class="leaderboard-card-score-value"
                                                >
                                                    ${escapeHtml(display)}
                                                </span>

                                                ${
                                                    unit
                                                        ? `
                                                            <span
                                                                class="leaderboard-card-score-unit"
                                                            >
                                                                ${escapeHtml(unit)}
                                                            </span>
                                                        `
                                                        : ""
                                                }

                                            </div>
                                        `
                                        : `
                                            <div
                                                class="leaderboard-card-empty"
                                            >
                                                No score yet
                                            </div>
                                        `
                                }

                                ${
                                    date
                                        ? `
                                            <div
                                                class="leaderboard-card-date"
                                            >
                                                ${escapeHtml(date)}
                                            </div>
                                        `
                                        : ""
                                }

                            </div>

                        </article>

                    `;

                })
                .join("");

    }

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * IMAGE FALLBACK
     * ==========================================================
     */

    grid
        .querySelectorAll("[data-game-image]")
        .forEach(image => {

            image.addEventListener(
                "error",
                () => {

                    image.style.display =
                        "none";

                },
                {
                    once: true
                }
            );

        });

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * OPEN GAME
     * ==========================================================
     */

    function openGame(game) {

        if (!game) {
            return;
        }

        window.FusionPendingGameId =
            game.id;

        window.FusionRequestedGame = {
            id: game.id,
            timestamp: Date.now()
        };

        if (
            typeof window.FusionNavigate ===
            "function"
        ) {

            window.FusionNavigate(
                "games"
            );

        } else {

            window.location.hash =
                "games";

        }

        window.dispatchEvent(
            new CustomEvent(
                "fusion:open-game",
                {
                    detail: {
                        id: game.id
                    }
                }
            )
        );

    }

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * CARD CLICK
     * ==========================================================
     */

    grid.addEventListener(
        "click",
        event => {

            const card =
                event.target.closest(
                    "[data-game-id]"
                );

            if (!card) {
                return;
            }

            const game =
                mergedGames.find(
                    item =>
                        String(item.id) ===
                        String(
                            card.dataset.gameId
                        )
                );

            if (game) {
                openGame(game);
            }

        }
    );

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * CARD KEYBOARD ACCESS
     * ==========================================================
     */

    grid.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        event => {

            if (
                event.key !== "Enter" &&
                event.key !== " "
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const card =
                event.target.closest(
                    "[data-game-id]"
                );

            if (!card) {
                return;
            }

            event.preventDefault();

            const game =
                mergedGames.find(
                    item =>
                        String(item.id) ===
                        String(
                            card.dataset.gameId
                        )
                );

            if (game) {
                openGame(game);
            }

        }
    );

    /*
     * ==========================================================
     * SUBMIT SCORE PAGE NAVIGATION
     * ==========================================================
     */

    submitButton?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {

            if (
                typeof window.FusionNavigate ===
                "function"
            ) {

                window.FusionNavigate(
                    "submit_scores"
                );

            } else {

                window.location.hash =
                    "submit_scores";

            }

        }
    );
}
;return { render };

});
//# sourceURL=fusion-bundle/assets/pages/leaderboard.js
</script>

            .fusion-login-primary-btn {

                height: 48px;

                font-weight: 800;
