                box-shadow: 0 11px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.28), 0 0 30px rgba(105,92,254,.10);
            }

            .fusion-login-primary-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.99); }
            .fusion-login-primary-btn:disabled { opacity: .52; cursor: default; transform: none; }

            .fusion-login-secondary-btn {
                width: 100%;
                height: 44px;
                margin-top: 11px;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.095);
                border-radius: 12px;
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.035);
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 700;
                font-family: inherit;
                cursor: pointer;
                transition: background .16s ease, color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease;
            }

            .fusion-login-secondary-btn:hover {
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
                border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
                color: #fff;
            }

            .fusion-login-switch {
                margin-top: 21px;
                padding-top: 18px;
                border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055);
                text-align: center;
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.44);
                font-size: 13px;
            }

            .fusion-login-link-btn {
                border: 0;
                background: none;
                padding: 0;
                margin-left: 4px;
                color: #fff;
                font-weight: 800;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-family: inherit;
                cursor: pointer;
                text-decoration: none;
            }

            .fusion-login-link-btn:hover { color: #b8b2ff; }

            .fusion-login-code-grid {
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
                gap: 9px;
                margin-top: 8px;
            }

            .fusion-login-code-digit {
                width: 100%;
                height: 68px;
                padding: 0;
                border-radius: 12px;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.035);
                color: #fff;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: 28px;
                font-weight: 800;
                font-family: inherit;
                outline: none;
                transition: border-color .16s ease, background .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease, transform .16s ease;
            }

            .fusion-login-code-digit:focus {
                border-color: rgba(123,111,255,.72);
                background: rgba(105,92,254,.08);
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(105,92,254,.10), 0 8px 24px rgba(105,92,254,.08);
                transform: translateY(-1px);
            }

            .fusion-login-code-digit::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
            .fusion-login-code-digit::-webkit-inner-spin-button { appearance: none; margin: 0; }

            @media (max-width: 420px) {
                .fusion-login-code-grid { gap: 6px; }
                .fusion-login-code-digit { height: 60px; font-size: 24px; border-radius: 11px; }
            }

            .fusion-login-resend-row {
                margin-top: 15px;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: 12px;
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.40);
            }

            .fusion-login-resend-btn { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
            .fusion-login-resend-btn:disabled { color: rgba(255,255,255,.28); cursor: default; text-decoration: none; }

            .fusion-login-loading {
                position: absolute;
                inset: 0;
                z-index: 10;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                border-radius: inherit;
                background: rgba(7,7,9,.64);
                backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
                -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
                transition: opacity .2s ease;
            }

            .fusion-login-loading.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

            .fusion-login-loader {
                width: 30px;
                height: 30px;
                border-radius: 50%;
                border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
                border-top-color: #fff;
                box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(105,92,254,.18);
                animation: fusion-login-spin .7s linear infinite;
            }

            @keyframes fusion-login-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

            @media (max-width: 520px) {
                .fusion-login-page { padding: 28px 15px; }
                .fusion-login-card { padding: 28px 20px 24px; border-radius: 18px; }
                .fusion-login-logo { height: 31px; }
            }

            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
                .fusion-login-card { animation: none; }
                .fusion-login-loader { animation-duration: 1.4s; }
            }
        </style>

        <div class="fusion-login-page">

            <div class="fusion-login-card">

                <div class="fusion-login-brand">
                    <img
                        src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"
                        alt="FUSION"
                        class="fusion-login-logo"
                    >
                </div>

                <\!-- SIGN IN -->
                <section class="fusion-login-view" id="login-signin-view">

                    <div class="fusion-login-heading">
                        <h1>Welcome back</h1>
                        <p>Sign in to your FUSION account.</p>
                    </div>

                    <form id="login-signin-form">

                        <div class="fusion-login-field">
                            <label for="login-signin-email">Email</label>
                            <input
                                id="login-signin-email"
                                type="email"
                                autocomplete="email"
                                placeholder="you@example.com"
                                required
                            >
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-login-field">
                            <div class="fusion-login-field-label-row">
                                <label for="login-signin-password">Password</label>
                                <button class="fusion-login-forgot-link" id="login-show-forgot" type="button">Forgot password?</button>
                            </div>
                            <div class="fusion-login-password-wrap">
                                <input
                                    id="login-signin-password"
                                    type="password"
                                    autocomplete="current-password"
                                    placeholder="Enter your password"
                                    required
                                >
                                <button class="fusion-login-password-toggle" type="button" data-toggle-for="login-signin-password" aria-label="Show password" aria-pressed="false">
                                    ${EYE_ICON}
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-login-error" id="login-signin-error"></div>

                        <button class="fusion-login-primary-btn" id="login-signin-button" type="submit">
                            Sign in
                        </button>

                    </form>

                    <div class="fusion-login-switch">
                        Don't have an account?
                        <button class="fusion-login-link-btn" id="login-show-signup" type="button">Create one</button>
                    </div>

                </section>

                <\!-- SIGN UP -->
                <section class="fusion-login-view hidden" id="login-signup-view">

                    <div class="fusion-login-heading">
                        <h1>Create your account</h1>
                        <p>Join FUSION and get started.</p>
                    </div>

                    <form id="login-signup-form">

                        <div class="fusion-login-field">
                            <label for="login-signup-username">Username</label>
                            <input
                                id="login-signup-username"
                                type="text"
                                autocomplete="username"
                                placeholder="Choose a username"
                                required
                            >
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-login-field">
                            <label for="login-signup-email">Email</label>
                            <input
                                id="login-signup-email"
                                type="email"
                                autocomplete="email"
                                placeholder="you@example.com"
                                required
                            >
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-login-field">
                            <label for="login-signup-password">Password</label>
                            <div class="fusion-login-password-wrap">
                                <input
                                    id="login-signup-password"
                                    type="password"
                                    autocomplete="new-password"
                                    placeholder="Create a password"
                                    required
                                >
                                <button class="fusion-login-password-toggle" type="button" data-toggle-for="login-signup-password" aria-label="Show password" aria-pressed="false">
                                    ${EYE_ICON}
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-login-error" id="login-signup-error"></div>

                        <button class="fusion-login-primary-btn" id="login-signup-button" type="submit">
                            Create account
                        </button>

                    </form>

                    <div class="fusion-login-switch">
                        Already have an account?
                        <button class="fusion-login-link-btn" id="login-show-signin" type="button">Sign in</button>
                    </div>

                </section>

                <\!-- VERIFICATION -->
                <section class="fusion-login-view hidden" id="login-verification-view">

                    <div class="fusion-login-heading">
                        <h1>Check your email</h1>
                        <p>We sent a verification code to <strong id="login-verification-email">your email</strong>.</p>
                    </div>

                    <form id="login-verification-form">

                        <div class="fusion-login-field">
                            <label>Verification code</label>
                            <div class="fusion-login-code-grid" id="login-verification-code-grid" role="group" aria-label="Verification code">
                                ${Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => `<input class="fusion-login-code-digit" data-code-group="verification" data-code-index="${i}" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="${i === 0 ? 'one-time-code' : 'off'}" maxlength="1" aria-label="Verification digit ${i + 1}" ${i === 0 ? 'required' : ''}>`).join('')}
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="fusion-login-error" id="login-verification-error"></div>

                        <button class="fusion-login-primary-btn" id="login-verification-button" type="submit">
                            Verify email
                        </button>

                    </form>

                    <div class="fusion-login-resend-row">
                        Didn't get a code?
                        <button class="fusion-login-resend-btn" id="login-resend-code" type="button">Resend code</button>
                    </div>

                    <button class="fusion-login-secondary-btn" id="login-back-to-signup" type="button">Back</button>

                </section>

                <\!-- PASSWORD RESET -->
                <section class="fusion-login-view hidden" id="login-forgot-view">

                    <\!-- RESET STEP 1: EMAIL -->
                    <div id="login-forgot-email-step" class="fusion-login-forgot-step">
                        <div class="fusion-login-heading">
                            <h1>Reset your password</h1>
                            <p>Enter your email and we'll send you a verification code.</p>
                        </div>

                        <form id="login-forgot-request-form">
                            <div class="fusion-login-field">
                                <label for="login-forgot-email">Email</label>
                                <input id="login-forgot-email" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required>
                            </div>
                            <div class="fusion-login-error" id="login-forgot-request-error"></div>
                            <button class="fusion-login-primary-btn" id="login-forgot-request-button" type="submit">Send reset code</button>
                        </form>
                    </div>

                    <\!-- RESET STEP 2: CODE -->
                    <div id="login-forgot-code-step" class="fusion-login-forgot-step hidden">
                        <div class="fusion-login-heading">
                            <h1>Check your email</h1>
                            <p>Enter the 6-digit code we sent to <strong id="login-forgot-code-email">your email</strong>.</p>
                        </div>

                        <form id="login-forgot-code-form">
                            <div class="fusion-login-field">
                                <label>Verification code</label>
                                <div class="fusion-login-code-grid" id="login-forgot-code-grid" role="group" aria-label="Reset verification code">
                                    ${Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => `<input class="fusion-login-code-digit" data-code-group="reset" data-code-index="${i}" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="${i === 0 ? 'one-time-code' : 'off'}" maxlength="1" aria-label="Reset code digit ${i + 1}" ${i === 0 ? 'required' : ''}>`).join('')}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="fusion-login-error" id="login-forgot-code-error"></div>
                            <button class="fusion-login-primary-btn" id="login-forgot-code-button" type="submit">Verify code</button>
                        </form>

                        <div class="fusion-login-resend-row">
                            Didn't get a code?
                            <button class="fusion-login-resend-btn" id="login-forgot-resend-code" type="button">Resend code</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <\!-- RESET STEP 3: NEW PASSWORD -->
                    <div id="login-forgot-password-step" class="fusion-login-forgot-step hidden">
                        <div class="fusion-login-heading">
                            <h1>Choose a new password</h1>
                            <p>Create a new password for your FUSION account.</p>
                        </div>

                        <form id="login-forgot-password-form">
                            <div class="fusion-login-field">
                                <label for="login-forgot-new-password">New password</label>
                                <div class="fusion-login-password-wrap">
                                    <input id="login-forgot-new-password" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Enter a new password" required>
                                    <button class="fusion-login-password-toggle" type="button" data-toggle-for="login-forgot-new-password" aria-label="Show password" aria-pressed="false">
                                        ${EYE_ICON}
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="fusion-login-field">
                                <label for="login-forgot-confirm-password">Confirm password</label>
                                <div class="fusion-login-password-wrap">
                                    <input id="login-forgot-confirm-password" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Enter it again" required>
                                    <button class="fusion-login-password-toggle" type="button" data-toggle-for="login-forgot-confirm-password" aria-label="Show password" aria-pressed="false">
                                        ${EYE_ICON}
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="fusion-login-error" id="login-forgot-password-error"></div>
                            <button class="fusion-login-primary-btn" id="login-forgot-password-button" type="submit">Change password</button>
                        </form>
                    </div>

                    <button class="fusion-login-secondary-btn" id="login-back-to-signin-from-forgot" type="button">Back to sign in</button>

                </section>

            </div>

            <div class="fusion-login-loading" id="login-loading">
                <div class="fusion-login-loader"></div>
            </div>

        </div>
    `;

    initLoginPage(container);
}

/* ======================================================
   PAGE LOGIC
====================================================== */

function initLoginPage(container) {
    const signinView = container.querySelector("#login-signin-view");
    const signupView = container.querySelector("#login-signup-view");
    const verificationView = container.querySelector("#login-verification-view");
    const forgotView = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-view");
    const forgotEmailStep = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-email-step");
    const forgotCodeStep = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-code-step");
    const forgotPasswordStep = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-password-step");
    const loadingScreen = container.querySelector("#login-loading");

    const showOnly = view => {
        [signinView, signupView, verificationView, forgotView].forEach(element => element?.classList.add("hidden"));
        view?.classList.remove("hidden");
    };

    function showError(element, message) {
        if (element) element.textContent = message || "";
    }

    function setButtonLoading(button, loading, loadingText, defaultText) {
        if (!button) return;
        if (loading) {
            button.disabled = true;
            button.dataset.defaultText = defaultText || button.textContent;
            button.textContent = loadingText || "Please wait...";
        } else {
            button.disabled = false;
            button.textContent = button.dataset.defaultText || defaultText || "Continue";
        }
    }

    function setupCodeInputs(group) {
        const inputs = [...container.querySelectorAll(`.fusion-login-code-digit[data-code-group="${group}"]`)];
        inputs.forEach((input, index) => {
            input.addEventListener("input", event => {
                const value = event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "");
                event.target.value = value.slice(-1);
                if (value) inputs[Math.min(index + 1, inputs.length - 1)]?.focus();
            });
            input.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                if (event.key === "Backspace" && !input.value) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    inputs[Math.max(index - 1, 0)]?.focus();
                }
            });
            input.addEventListener("paste", event => {
                event.preventDefault();
                const pasted = (event.clipboardData?.getData("text") || "").replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, inputs.length);
                pasted.split("").forEach((digit, offset) => { if (inputs[index + offset]) inputs[index + offset].value = digit; });
                inputs[Math.min(index + pasted.length, inputs.length - 1)]?.focus();
            });
        });
        return () => inputs.map(input => input.value).join("");
    }

    const getResetCode = setupCodeInputs("reset");
    const getVerificationCode = setupCodeInputs("verification");

    container.querySelectorAll(".fusion-login-password-toggle").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const input = container.querySelector(`#${button.dataset.toggleFor || ""}`);
            if (!input) return;
            const visible = input.type === "password";
            input.type = visible ? "text" : "password";
            button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(visible));
            button.setAttribute("aria-label", visible ? "Hide password" : "Show password");
        });
    });

    function goToSignedInDestination() {
        window.FusionNavigate?.(window.FusionAuth?.consumeRedirectTarget("profile") || "profile");
    }

    function showVerification(email) {
        const label = container.querySelector("#login-verification-email");
        if (label) label.textContent = email;
        showError(container.querySelector("#login-verification-error"), "");
        showOnly(verificationView);
    }

    container.querySelector("#login-show-signup")?.addEventListener("click", () => showOnly(signupView));
    container.querySelector("#login-show-signin")?.addEventListener("click", () => showOnly(signinView));
    container.querySelector("#login-back-to-signup")?.addEventListener("click", () => showOnly(signupView));
    container.querySelector("#login-show-forgot")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        showOnly(forgotView);
        forgotEmailStep?.classList.remove("hidden");
        forgotCodeStep?.classList.add("hidden");
        forgotPasswordStep?.classList.add("hidden");
    });
    container.querySelector("#login-back-to-signin-from-forgot")?.addEventListener("click", () => showOnly(signinView));

    container.querySelector("#login-signin-form")?.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-signin-error");
        const button = container.querySelector("#login-signin-button");
        showError(errorElement, "");
        setButtonLoading(button, true, "Signing in...", "Sign in");
        try {
            const result = await window.FusionAuth.signIn({
                email: container.querySelector("#login-signin-email")?.value,
                password: container.querySelector("#login-signin-password")?.value
            });
            if (result?.verificationRequired) showVerification(result.email);
            else goToSignedInDestination();
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't sign in.");
        } finally {
            setButtonLoading(button, false, "Signing in...", "Sign in");
        }
    });

    container.querySelector("#login-signup-form")?.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-signup-error");
        const button = container.querySelector("#login-signup-button");
        showError(errorElement, "");
        setButtonLoading(button, true, "Creating...", "Create account");
        try {
            const result = await window.FusionAuth.signUp({
                username: container.querySelector("#login-signup-username")?.value,
                email: container.querySelector("#login-signup-email")?.value,
                password: container.querySelector("#login-signup-password")?.value
            });
            if (result?.verificationRequired) {
                showVerification(result.email);
            } else {
                window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Account created.");
                goToSignedInDestination();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't create your account.");
        } finally {
            setButtonLoading(button, false, "Creating...", "Create account");
        }
    });

    container.querySelector("#login-verification-form")?.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-verification-error");
        const button = container.querySelector("#login-verification-button");
        const code = getVerificationCode();
        if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) {
            showError(errorElement, "Enter the 6-digit code from your email.");
            return;
        }
        showError(errorElement, "");
        setButtonLoading(button, true, "Verifying...", "Verify email");
        try {
            await window.FusionAuth.confirmEmailVerification({ code });
            window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Email verified.");
            goToSignedInDestination();
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't verify that code.");
        } finally {
            setButtonLoading(button, false, "Verifying...", "Verify email");
        }
    });

    container.querySelector("#login-resend-code")?.addEventListener("click", async event => {
        const button = event.currentTarget;
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-verification-error");
        button.disabled = true;
        try {
            await window.FusionAuth.resendEmailVerification();
            showError(errorElement, "");
            window.FusionNotify?.info?.("We sent another code.");
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't resend the code.");
        } finally {
            button.disabled = false;
        }
    });

    const forgotRequestForm = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-request-form");
    const forgotCodeForm = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-code-form");
    const forgotPasswordForm = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-password-form");

    forgotRequestForm?.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-request-error");
        const email = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-email")?.value || "";
        try {
            const result = await window.FusionAuth.createPasswordReset(email);
            const codeLabel = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-code-email");
            if (codeLabel) codeLabel.textContent = email;
            showError(errorElement, "");
            forgotEmailStep?.classList.add("hidden");
            forgotCodeStep?.classList.remove("hidden");
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't start password reset.");
        }
    });

    container.querySelector("#login-forgot-resend-code")?.addEventListener("click", async event => {
        const button = event.currentTarget;
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-code-error");
        const email = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-email")?.value || "";
        button.disabled = true;
        try {
            await window.FusionAuth.createPasswordReset(email);
            showError(errorElement, "");
            window.FusionNotify?.info?.("We sent another code.");
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't resend the code.");
        } finally {
            button.disabled = false;
        }
    });

    forgotCodeForm?.addEventListener("submit", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const code = getResetCode();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-code-error");
        if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) {
            showError(errorElement, "Enter the 6-digit code from your email.");
            return;
        }
        showError(errorElement, "");
        forgotCodeStep?.classList.add("hidden");
        forgotPasswordStep?.classList.remove("hidden");
    });

    forgotPasswordForm?.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const errorElement = container.querySelector("#login-forgot-password-error");
        try {
            await window.FusionAuth.confirmPasswordReset({
                code: getResetCode(),
                password: container.querySelector("#login-forgot-new-password")?.value
            });
            showOnly(signinView);
            window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Password changed. You can sign in now.");
        } catch (error) {
            showError(errorElement, error?.message || "Couldn't change the password.");
        }
    });

    (async () => {
        if (window.FusionAuth?.isSignedIn()) {
            const confirmedUser = await window.FusionAuth.refresh().catch(() => null);
            if (confirmedUser) {
                goToSignedInDestination();
                return;
            }
            // The cached session didn't check out (e.g. it was revoked or the
            // account no longer exists) — fall through to the sign-in form
            // instead of bouncing back and forth to the profile page.
        }
        showOnly(signinView);
        loadingScreen?.classList.add("hidden");
    })();
}
;return { render };

});

</script>
<script>
__fusionDefine("assets/pages/privacy.js", async function () { "use strict";

// assets/pages/privacy.js
//
// FUSION Privacy Policy page.
// Rendered into #page-privacy when the Privacy page is opened.

function render(container) {
    container.style.height = "100%";
    container.style.minHeight = "0";
    container.style.overflowY = "auto";
    container.style.overflowX = "hidden";
    container.style.scrollbarWidth = "thin";

    container.innerHTML = `
        <style>
            .fusion-legal-page {
                width: 100%;
                min-height: 100%;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding: 42px 20px 0;
                overflow: visible;
            }

            .fusion-legal-content {
                width: min(100%, 820px);
                margin: 0 auto;
            }

            .fusion-legal-header {
                margin-bottom: 34px;
            }

        <main class="fusion-legal-page">

                <article class="fusion-legal-card">

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>1. Introduction</h2>
                        <p>
                            This Privacy Policy explains how FUSION may collect,
                            use, store, and disclose information when you use the
                            FUSION website and its features.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            FUSION is designed to minimize unnecessary collection
                            of personal information. Information may nevertheless
                            be processed as necessary to operate, secure, improve,
                            and maintain the website.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>2. Information We May Collect</h2>

                        <h3>Information you provide</h3>
                        <p>
                            Some FUSION features may allow you to voluntarily
                            provide information. For example, the game request
                            form may collect information such as the name of a
                            requested game, its type, and information about where
                            the game can be found.
                        </p>

                        <h3>Technical information</h3>
                        <p>
                            When you access a website, certain technical information
                            may be processed automatically by FUSION, its hosting
                            infrastructure, content delivery networks, or other
                            services used to operate the site.
                        </p>
                        <ul>
                            <li>IP address or approximate network information.</li>
                            <li>Browser and device information.</li>
                            <li>Operating system information.</li>
                            <li>Requested pages and resources.</li>
                            <li>Referring pages or websites.</li>
                            <li>Date and time of requests.</li>
                            <li>Basic diagnostic and security information.</li>
                        </ul>

                        <h3>Local browser data</h3>
                        <p>
                            FUSION may use browser storage technologies such as
                            localStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, cookies, or
                            service-worker storage to remember settings, improve
                            performance, cache resources, maintain functionality,
                            or support browser-based features.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>3. How Information Is Used</h2>
                        <p>
                            Information may be used to:
                        </p>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Provide and operate FUSION.</li>
                            <li>Load and deliver games and other website resources.</li>
                            <li>Operate proxy and browser-based functionality.</li>
                            <li>Process game requests and other submissions.</li>
                            <li>Maintain website security and prevent abuse.</li>
                            <li>Diagnose technical problems and errors.</li>
                            <li>Improve website performance and reliability.</li>
                            <li>Understand general website usage when analytics are enabled.</li>
                            <li>Comply with applicable legal obligations.</li>
                        </ul>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>4. Cookies and Similar Technologies</h2>
                        <p>
                            FUSION or services used by FUSION may use cookies and
                            similar technologies where necessary to operate the
                            website, maintain functionality, provide security,
                            remember preferences, or understand usage.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            Browser storage may also be used for functionality that
                            does not require traditional cookies.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            You can control or clear cookies and browser storage
                            through your browser settings. Disabling certain
                            technologies may cause some features to stop working
                            correctly.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>5. Game Requests</h2>
                        <p>
                            When you submit a game request, the information you
                            enter is transmitted to the service used to process
                            that request. FUSION may retain or access submitted
                            information as necessary to review, process, secure,
                            or troubleshoot requests.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            Please do not submit passwords, payment information,
                            private credentials, or other sensitive information
                            through a game request form.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>6. Games and Third-Party Content</h2>
                        <p>
                            Games and other resources available through FUSION may
                            be hosted or provided by third parties. When you access
                            third-party content, your browser may communicate
                            directly with those third parties.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            Those third parties may independently collect or process
                            information according to their own privacy policies.
                            FUSION does not control the privacy practices of
                            third-party websites or game providers.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>7. Proxy and Web Access</h2>
                        <p>
                            FUSION may provide browser-based proxy or web-access
                            functionality. Depending on how a requested website is
                            accessed, technical information associated with the
                            request may be processed by FUSION infrastructure,
                            proxy infrastructure, content delivery services, or
                            the destination website.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            Information handled by third-party destinations is
                            governed by their own privacy policies.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>8. AI Features</h2>
                        <p>
                            FUSION may provide AI features. Depending on how an AI
                            feature is implemented, prompts and generated responses
                            may be processed locally in your browser or transmitted
                            to a third-party AI service.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            You should avoid entering passwords, private credentials,
                            financial information, or other sensitive personal
                            information into AI features unless the applicable
                            feature explicitly indicates that such information is
                            appropriate.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>9. Analytics and Diagnostics</h2>
                        <p>
                            If analytics or diagnostic services are enabled,
                            information about how the website is used may be
                            collected to understand performance, identify errors,
                            measure usage, and improve FUSION.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            Analytics services may process technical identifiers,
                            device information, page activity, approximate
                            geographic information, or similar data depending on
                            the service configuration.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>10. How Information Is Shared</h2>
                        <p>
                            FUSION does not need to sell personal information in
                            order to operate the website. Information may,
                            however, be processed by service providers that help
                            operate FUSION.
                        </p>
                        <p>Examples may include:</p>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Hosting and infrastructure providers.</li>
                            <li>Content delivery networks.</li>
                            <li>Game or content providers.</li>
                            <li>Form and submission providers.</li>
                            <li>Analytics or diagnostic providers.</li>
                            <li>AI service providers where applicable.</li>
                            <li>Security and abuse-prevention services.</li>
                        </ul>
                        <p>
                            Information may also be disclosed when required by law,
                            legal process, or to protect the rights, safety, and
                            security of FUSION, its users, or others.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>11. Data Retention</h2>
                        <p>
                            Information may be retained only for as long as
                            reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was
                            collected, to maintain security, to resolve disputes,
                            to comply with legal obligations, or for legitimate
                            operational purposes.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            Retention periods may vary depending on the type of
                            information and the service responsible for processing
                            it.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>12. Security</h2>
                        <p>
                            FUSION takes reasonable measures intended to protect
                            information and maintain the security of its services.
                            However, no website, network, or method of electronic
                            transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>13. Children's Privacy</h2>
                        <p>
                            FUSION is not intended to knowingly collect unnecessary
                            personal information from children. If you believe that
                            personal information belonging to a child has been
                            submitted to FUSION and should be removed, contact the
                            appropriate FUSION administrator.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>14. Your Choices</h2>
                        <p>
                            Depending on your location and applicable law, you may
                            have rights regarding personal information processed
                            by FUSION or its service providers.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            You can also control certain locally stored information
                            through your browser by clearing cookies, site data,
                            local storage, IndexedDB, cache, or service-worker data.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>15. Third-Party Privacy Policies</h2>
                        <p>
                            FUSION may link to or provide access to third-party
                            services. Their privacy practices are controlled by
                            their own policies, not this Privacy Policy.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            You should review the privacy policy of a third-party
                            service before providing information directly to it.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>16. Changes to This Privacy Policy</h2>
                        <p>
                            This Privacy Policy may be updated as FUSION's
                            functionality, infrastructure, or legal requirements
                            change.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            The updated version will be published on this page with
                            a revised "Last updated" date.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                    <section class="fusion-legal-section">
                        <h2>17. Contact</h2>
                        <p>
                            Questions or requests regarding this Privacy Policy
                            should be directed through the official contact method
                            provided by FUSION.
                        </p>
                    </section>

                </article>

                <footer class="games-footer">
                    <div class="games-footer-brand">

                                Terms
                            </a>

                            <a

                                Privacy
                            </a>
                        </nav>
                    </div>
                </footer>

            </div>
        </main>
    `;

    bindNavigation(container);
}

function bindNavigation(container) {
    const navigate = (page) => {
        const navButton = document.querySelector(
            `[data-page="${page}"], [data-nav="${page}"], #nav-${page}`
        );

        if (navButton) {
            navButton.click();
            return;
        }

        window.location.hash = page;
    };

    container.querySelectorAll("[data-footer-link]").forEach((link) => {
        link.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();

            const page = link.dataset.footerLink;
            if (page) navigate(page);
        });
    });
}

                z-index: 9999;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                padding: 20px;
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
                backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            }

            .fusion-profile-modal {
                width: min(100%, 440px);
                padding: 28px;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
                border-radius: 20px;
                background: #15161a;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }

            .fusion-profile-modal h4 {
                margin: 0 0 8px;
                color: #fff;
                font-size: 19px;
                font-weight: 800;
            }

            .fusion-profile-modal p {
                margin: 0 0 16px;
                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
                font-size: 14px;
                line-height: 1.6;
            }

            .fusion-profile-modal .fusion-profile-danger-btn {
                height: 42px;
                padding: 0 20px;
                border-radius: 11px;
            }

            .fusion-profile-modal-actions {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: flex-end;
                gap: 10px;
                margin-top: 20px;
            }

            .fusion-profile-loading,
            .fusion-profile-error {
                grid-column: 1 / -1;
                padding: 60px 20px;
                text-align: center;
                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
                font-size: 15px;
            }

            /* ---------- shared FUSION footer (same as Games / Home) ---------- */

            .games-footer {
                flex-shrink: 0;
                width: min(100%, 560px);
                margin: 34px auto 8px;
                padding: 22px 24px 20px;
                border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                gap: 11px;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .games-footer-brand {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .games-footer-logo {
                display: block;
                width: 112px;
                height: auto;
                max-width: 100%;
                opacity: .72;
            }

            .games-footer-info {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                gap: 7px 12px;
            }

            .games-footer-text {
                margin: 0;
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.38);
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 500;
                line-height: 1.5;
            }

            .games-footer-links {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .games-footer-link {
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.52);
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 600;
                text-decoration: none;
                transition: color .16s ease;
            }

            .games-footer-link:hover {
                color: #fff;
            }

            .games-footer-separator {
                width: 3px;
                height: 3px;
                border-radius: 50%;
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
            }

            @media (max-width: 720px) {
                .fusion-profile-head {
                    flex-wrap: wrap;
                    gap: 18px;
                    padding: 28px 18px 24px;
                }

                .fusion-profile-avatar,
                .fusion-profile-avatar-fallback {
                    width: 84px;
                    height: 84px;
                }

                .fusion-profile-avatar-fallback {
                    font-size: 30px;
                }

                .fusion-profile-avatar-edit {
                    width: 28px;
                    height: 28px;
                }

                .fusion-profile-name-row h2 {
                    font-size: 24px;
                }

                .fusion-verified {
                    width: 20px;
                    height: 20px;
                }

                .fusion-profile-section {
                    padding: 24px 18px 4px;
                }

                .fusion-profile-row {
                    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
                    gap: 6px 12px;
                    padding: 16px 0;
                }

                .fusion-profile-row-label {
                    grid-column: 1 / -1;
                    font-size: 13px;
                }

                .games-footer {
                    width: 100%;
                    padding: 20px 10px 16px;
                    margin-top: 26px;
                }

                .games-footer-info {
                    flex-direction: column;
                    gap: 8px;
                }
            }
        </style>

        <main class="fusion-profile-page">
            <div class="fusion-profile-root" id="profile-card">
                <div class="fusion-profile-loading">Loading your profile…</div>
            </div>

            <footer class="games-footer">

                <div class="games-footer-brand">
                    <img
                        class="games-footer-logo"
                        src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"
                        alt="FUSION"
                    >
                </div>

                <div class="games-footer-info">

                    <p class="games-footer-text">
                        © ${new Date().getFullYear()} FUSION · Games for everyone.
                    </p>

                    <span
                        class="games-footer-separator"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    ></span>

                    <nav
                        class="games-footer-links"
                        aria-label="Legal"
                    >
                        <a
                            class="games-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="terms"
                        >
                            Terms
                        </a>

                        <a
                            class="games-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="privacy"
                        >
                            Privacy
                        </a>
                    </nav>

                </div>

            </footer>
        </main>
    `;

    initProfilePage(container);
}

const COOLDOWN_MS = 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_AVATAR_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

const ROLES = {
    player:    { label: "Player",    color: "#9aa4b2" },
    moderator: { label: "Moderator", color: "#4ade80" },
    admin:     { label: "Admin",     color: "#f87171" },
    dev:       { label: "Developer", color: "#60a5fa" },
    owner:     { label: "Owner",     color: "#fbbf24" }
};

const VERIFIED_DEFAULT_COLOR = "#4da3ff";
const VERIFIED_BADGE_SVG = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
        <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="4.5" fill="currentColor"/>
        <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="4.5" fill="currentColor" transform="rotate(45 12 12)"/>
        <path d="M8.1 12.5l2.7 2.7 5.2-5.6" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </svg>
`;
const PENCIL_SVG = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
        <path d="M12 20h9"></path>
        <path d="M16.5 3.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1-1-4L16.5 3.5z"></path>
    </svg>
`;

function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({
        "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """, "'": "'"
    }[char]));
}

function roleInfo(role) {
    return ROLES[role] || ROLES.player;
}

function initProfilePage(container) {
    const card = container.querySelector("#profile-card");

    function formatJoinDate(dateInput) {
        if (!dateInput) return "—";
        try {
            return new Date(dateInput).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric"
            });
        } catch { return "—"; }
    }

    function initials(name) {
        return String(name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || "?";
    }

    function notify(kind, message) {
        window.FusionNotify?.[kind]?.(message, { duration: 2800 });
    }

    function cooldownActive(changedAt) {
        return changedAt !== null && changedAt !== undefined && Date.now() < changedAt + COOLDOWN_MS;
    }

    function cooldownHint(label, changedAt) {
        if (cooldownActive(changedAt)) {
            const date = new Date(changedAt + COOLDOWN_MS).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric"
            });
            return `You can change your ${label} again on ${date}.`;
        }
        return `You can change your ${label} once every 14 days.`;
    }

    function openModal(innerHtml) {
        const backdrop = document.createElement("div");
        backdrop.className = "fusion-profile-modal-backdrop";
        backdrop.innerHTML = `<div class="fusion-profile-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">${innerHtml}</div>`;
        const modal = {
            el: backdrop,
            busy: false,
            close() {
                if (modal.busy) return;
                document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeydown);
                backdrop.remove();
            }
        };
        function onKeydown(event) { if (event.key === "Escape") modal.close(); }
        document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeydown);
        backdrop.addEventListener("click", event => { if (event.target === backdrop) modal.close(); });
        document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
        return modal;
    }

    function renderUser(user) {
        if (!user) {
            card.innerHTML = `<div class="fusion-profile-error">You're not signed in. <br>Redirecting you to sign in…</div>`;
            window.FusionAuth?.setRedirectTarget("profile");
            window.FusionNavigate?.("login");
            return;
        }

        const username = user.username || "FUSION user";
        const shownName = user.displayName || username;
        const roleData = roleInfo(user.role);
        const badgeLabel = user.role !== "player" ? `Verified · ${roleData.label}` : "Verified";
        const avatarUrl = user.imageUrl || "";

        card.innerHTML = `
            <header class="fusion-profile-head">
                <div class="fusion-profile-avatar-wrap">
                    ${avatarUrl ? `<img class="fusion-profile-avatar" src="${escapeHtml(avatarUrl)}" alt="${escapeHtml(shownName)}'s avatar">` : `<div class="fusion-profile-avatar-fallback">${escapeHtml(initials(shownName))}</div>`}
                    <button class="fusion-profile-avatar-edit" id="profile-avatar-button" type="button" aria-label="Change profile picture" title="Change profile picture">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M23 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2-3h6l2 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="4"></circle></svg>
                    </button>
                    <input type="file" id="profile-avatar-input" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif" hidden>
                </div>
                <div class="fusion-profile-head-text">
                    <div class="fusion-profile-name-row">
                        <h2>${escapeHtml(shownName)}</h2>
                        ${user.verified ? `<span class="fusion-verified" style="color:${VERIFIED_DEFAULT_COLOR}" title="${escapeHtml(badgeLabel)}" aria-label="${escapeHtml(badgeLabel)}">${VERIFIED_BADGE_SVG}</span>` : ""}
                        <button class="fusion-profile-pencil" id="profile-displayname-edit" type="button" aria-label="Change display name" title="Change display name">${PENCIL_SVG}</button>
                    </div>
                    <p class="fusion-profile-handle">@${escapeHtml(username)}</p>
                    <p class="fusion-profile-hint" id="profile-avatar-hint"></p>
                </div>
                <button class="fusion-profile-signout-btn" id="profile-signout-button" type="button">Sign out</button>
            </header>
            <section class="fusion-profile-section">
                <h3 class="fusion-profile-section-label">Account</h3>
                <div class="fusion-profile-row"><span class="fusion-profile-row-label">Email</span><span class="fusion-profile-row-value">${escapeHtml(user.email || "—")}</span></div>
                <div class="fusion-profile-row"><span class="fusion-profile-row-label">Username</span><span class="fusion-profile-row-value">@${escapeHtml(username)}</span><button class="fusion-profile-link-btn" id="profile-username-change" type="button">Change</button></div>
                <div class="fusion-profile-row"><span class="fusion-profile-row-label">Role</span><span class="fusion-profile-row-value">${escapeHtml(roleData.label)}</span></div>
                <div class="fusion-profile-row"><span class="fusion-profile-row-label">Member since</span><span class="fusion-profile-row-value">${escapeHtml(formatJoinDate(user.createdAt))}</span></div>
            </section>
            <section class="fusion-profile-section">
                <h3 class="fusion-profile-section-label danger">Danger zone</h3>
                <div class="fusion-profile-row">
                    <span class="fusion-profile-row-label">Delete account</span>
                    <span class="fusion-profile-row-value fusion-profile-row-note">Permanently deletes your FUSION account and profile. This can't be undone.</span>
                    <button class="fusion-profile-danger-btn" id="profile-delete-button" type="button">Delete my account</button>
                </div>
            </section>
        `;

        bindAvatar();
        card.querySelector("#profile-signout-button")?.addEventListener("click", async event => {
            const button = event.currentTarget;
            button.disabled = true;
            button.textContent = "Signing out...";
            await window.FusionAuth.signOut();
            notify("info", "You've been signed out.");
            window.FusionNavigate?.("home");
        });
        card.querySelector("#profile-displayname-edit")?.addEventListener("click", () => openDisplayNameModal(user));
        card.querySelector("#profile-username-change")?.addEventListener("click", () => openUsernameModal(user));
        card.querySelector("#profile-delete-button")?.addEventListener("click", openDeleteModal);
    }

    function bindAvatar() {
        const button = card.querySelector("#profile-avatar-button");
        const input = card.querySelector("#profile-avatar-input");
        const hint = card.querySelector("#profile-avatar-hint");
        if (!button || !input) return;
        const showHint = (message, kind = "") => {
            hint.textContent = message;
            hint.className = `fusion-profile-hint ${kind}`.trim();
        };
        button.addEventListener("click", () => input.click());
        input.addEventListener("change", async () => {
            const file = input.files?.[0];
            input.value = "";
            if (!file) return;
            if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) { showHint("Please choose an image file (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF).", "error"); return; }
            if (file.size > MAX_AVATAR_BYTES) { showHint("That image is too big. Please use one under 5 MB.", "error"); return; }
            button.disabled = true;
            showHint("Saving…");
            try {
                await window.FusionAuth.setProfileImage(file);
                notify("success", "Profile picture updated.");
            } catch (error) {
                button.disabled = false;
                showHint(error?.message || "Couldn't update your picture.", "error");
            }
        });
    }

    function openNameModal(options) {
        const changedAt = options.getChangedAt();
        const locked = cooldownActive(changedAt);
        const modal = openModal(`
            <h4>${escapeHtml(options.title)}</h4>
            <p>${escapeHtml(options.intro)}</p>
            <input class="fusion-profile-input" id="profile-name-input" type="text" maxlength="${options.maxLength}" placeholder="${escapeHtml(options.placeholder)}" value="${escapeHtml(options.prefill || "")}" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" ${locked ? "disabled" : ""}>
            <p class="fusion-profile-hint" id="profile-name-hint" style="margin:10px 0 0;">${escapeHtml(cooldownHint(options.label, changedAt))}</p>
            <div class="fusion-profile-modal-actions"><button class="fusion-profile-signout-btn" id="profile-name-cancel" type="button">Cancel</button><button class="fusion-profile-signout-btn" id="profile-name-save" type="button" ${locked ? "disabled" : ""}>Save</button></div>
        `);
        const input = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-name-input");
        const hint = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-name-hint");
        const save = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-name-save");
        const cancel = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-name-cancel");
        const update = () => {
            const next = input.value.trim();
            const validation = options.validate(next);
            save.disabled = locked || !!validation || options.isSame(next);
            hint.textContent = validation || cooldownHint(options.label, options.getChangedAt());
            hint.className = `fusion-profile-hint ${validation ? "error" : ""}`.trim();
        };
        input.addEventListener("input", update);
        input.addEventListener("keydown", event => { if (event.key === "Enter" && !save.disabled) save.click(); });
        cancel.addEventListener("click", () => modal.close());
        save.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            const next = input.value.trim();
            const validation = options.validate(next);
            if (validation) { hint.textContent = validation; hint.className = "fusion-profile-hint error"; return; }
            modal.busy = true; save.disabled = true; cancel.disabled = true; input.disabled = true;
            try {
                const updated = await options.submit(next);
                modal.busy = false; modal.close(); notify("success", "Profile updated."); renderUser(updated);
            } catch (error) {
                modal.busy = false; save.disabled = false; cancel.disabled = false; input.disabled = false;
                hint.textContent = error?.message || "Couldn't save that change.";
                hint.className = "fusion-profile-hint error";
            }
        });
        input.focus(); update();
    }

    function openDisplayNameModal(user) {
        openNameModal({
            title: "Change display name", intro: "This is the name shown on your profile. 2-32 characters.", label: "display name", placeholder: "Display name", maxLength: 32,
            prefill: user.displayName || user.username || "", getChangedAt: () => user.displayNameChangedAt,
            validate: next => { const clean = next.replace(/\s+/g, " "); return clean.length >= 2 && clean.length <= 32 ? null : "Display names are 2-32 characters."; },
            isSame: next => next.replace(/\s+/g, " ") === String(user.displayName || ""),
            submit: next => window.FusionAuth.updateProfile({ displayName: next })
        });
    }

    function openUsernameModal(user) {
        openNameModal({
            title: "Change username", intro: "Your @username is how people find you. 3-32 characters: letters, numbers and underscores.", label: "username", placeholder: "New username", maxLength: 32,
            prefill: "", getChangedAt: () => user.usernameChangedAt,
            validate: next => /^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,32}$/.test(next) ? null : "Usernames are 3-32 characters: letters, numbers and underscores only.",
            isSame: next => next.toLowerCase() === String(user.username || "").toLowerCase(),
            submit: next => window.FusionAuth.changeUsername(next)
        });
    }

    function openDeleteModal() {
        const modal = openModal(`<h4>Delete your account?</h4><p>This permanently deletes your FUSION account and profile. Type <strong style="color:#fff">DELETE</strong> to confirm.</p><input class="fusion-profile-input" id="profile-delete-confirm" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="DELETE"><p class="fusion-profile-hint" id="profile-delete-error" style="margin:10px 0 0;"></p><div class="fusion-profile-modal-actions"><button class="fusion-profile-signout-btn" id="profile-delete-cancel" type="button">Cancel</button><button class="fusion-profile-danger-btn" id="profile-delete-confirm-btn" type="button" disabled>Delete account</button></div>`);
        const input = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-delete-confirm");
        const confirmButton = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-delete-confirm-btn");
        const cancelButton = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-delete-cancel");
        const errorText = modal.el.querySelector("#profile-delete-error");
        input.focus();
        cancelButton.addEventListener("click", () => modal.close());
        input.addEventListener("input", () => { confirmButton.disabled = input.value.trim() !== "DELETE"; });
        confirmButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            if (input.value.trim() !== "DELETE") return;
            modal.busy = true; confirmButton.disabled = true; cancelButton.disabled = true; input.disabled = true; confirmButton.textContent = "Deleting…";
            try {
                await window.FusionAuth.deleteAccount();
                modal.busy = false; modal.close(); notify("info", "Your account has been deleted."); window.FusionNavigate?.("home");
            } catch (error) {
                modal.busy = false; confirmButton.disabled = false; cancelButton.disabled = false; input.disabled = false; confirmButton.textContent = "Delete account"; errorText.className = "fusion-profile-hint error"; errorText.textContent = error?.message || "Couldn't delete your account.";
            }
        });
    }

    renderUser(window.FusionAuth?.getUser?.() || null);
    window.FusionAuth?.onChange?.(updatedUser => {
        if (container.isConnected) renderUser(updatedUser);
    });
}
;return { render };

});
//# sourceURL=fusion-bundle/assets/pages/profile.js
</script>
<script>
__fusionDefine("assets/pages/report.js", async function () { "use strict";
function render(container) {
	container.innerHTML = ` <style>

position: relative;
width: 100%;
min-height: 100vh;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
box-sizing: border-box;
overflow: visible;
padding-bottom: 8px;

        .report-content {
            width: min(100%, 760px);

        /* =========================

        .report-label {

        /* =========================

        .report-upload {

        .report-upload:hover,

            border-color: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.65);

                inset 0 0 30px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.025),

        }

        .report-upload.dragover {

        .report-upload-content {

        .report-upload-icon svg {

        }

        .report-upload-title {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .report-upload-subtitle {
            margin-top: 5px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .report-file-input {
            display: none;
        }

        /* =========================
           FILE LIST
           ========================= */

        .report-files {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 7px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .report-file {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            min-width: 0;
            padding: 9px 11px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
            animation: report-file-in 0.2s ease both;
        }

        .report-file-name {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            font-size: 12px;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .report-file-size {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32);
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .report-file-remove {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border: 0;
            border-radius: 7px;
            background: transparent;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition:
                background 0.16s ease,
                color 0.16s ease;
        }

        .report-file-remove:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            color: #ffffff;
        }

        .report-file-remove svg {
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            fill: none;
            stroke: currentColor;
            stroke-width: 1.8;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        /* =========================
           DESCRIPTION
           ========================= */

        .report-textarea {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 190px;
            padding: 14px 15px;
            resize: vertical;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
            border-radius: 13px;
            outline: none;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
            color: #ffffff;
            font: inherit;
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.55;
            transition:
                border-color 0.18s ease,
                background 0.18s ease,
                box-shadow 0.18s ease;
        }

        .report-textarea::placeholder {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32);
        }

        .report-textarea:focus {
            border-color: rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.62);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            box-shadow:
                0 0 0 3px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.055);
        }

           SUBMIT
           ========================= */

        .report-submit-row {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-top: 24px;
