        .report-submit {
            height: 44px;
            padding: 0 19px;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: #695CFE;
            color: #ffffff;
            font: inherit;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 650;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow:
                0 8px 24px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.2);
            transition:
                background 0.16s ease,
                transform 0.16s ease,
                box-shadow 0.16s ease;
        }

        .report-submit:hover {
            background: #786dff;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow:
                0 12px 30px rgba(105, 92, 254, 0.28);
        }

        .report-submit:active {
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .report-submit:disabled {
            opacity: 0.55;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
            box-shadow: none;
        }

        .report-submit svg {
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
            fill: none;
            stroke: currentColor;
            stroke-width: 1.8;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        /* =========================
           FOOTER
           EXACT GAMES.JS STYLE
           ========================= */

        .games-footer {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: min(100%, 560px);
            margin: 34px auto 8px;
            padding: 22px 24px 20px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 11px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .games-footer-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .games-footer-logo {
            display: block;
            width: 112px;
            height: auto;
            max-width: 100%;
            opacity: 0.72;
        }

        .games-footer-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 7px 12px;
        }

        .games-footer-text {
            margin: 0;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .games-footer-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .games-footer-link {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.16s ease;
        }

        .games-footer-link:hover {
            color: #ffffff;
        }

        .games-footer-separator {
            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
        }

        .report-submit-frame {
            display: none;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border: 0;
        }

        /* =========================
           ANIMATIONS
           ========================= */

        @keyframes report-header-in {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }

            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes report-card-in {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(14px);
            }

            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes report-file-in {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-4px);
            }

            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .report-header,
            .report-card,
            .report-file {
                animation: none !important;
            }

            .report-upload,
            .report-submit,
            .report-textarea {
                transition: none !important;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 620px) {
            .report-page {
                min-height: 100vh;
                overflow: visible;
            }

            .report-content {
                width: 100%;
                padding-left: 0;
                padding-right: 0;
            }

            .report-header {
                margin-bottom: 20px;
            }

            .report-card {
                padding: 18px;
                border-radius: 15px;
            }

            .report-submit-row {
                justify-content: stretch;
            }

            .report-submit {
                width: 100%;
            }

            .games-footer {
                width: 100%;
                padding: 20px 10px 16px;
                margin-top: 26px;
            }

            .games-footer-logo {
                width: 100px;
            }

            .games-footer-info {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 8px;
            }
        }
    </style>

    <div class="report-page">

        <main class="report-content">

            <header class="report-header">

                <div class="report-heading">

                    <h1 class="report-title">
                        Report a Bug
                    </h1>

                    <p class="report-subtitle">
                        Found something that isn't working correctly?
                        Let us know and we'll take a look.
                    </p>

                </div>

            </header>

            <form
                class="report-card"
                id="fusion-report-form"
                method="post"
                enctype="multipart/form-data"
            >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="formID"
                    value="262547929389073"
                >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="JWTContainer"
                    value=""
                >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="cardinalOrderNumber"
                    value=""
                >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="uploadServerUrl"
                >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="eventObserver"
                    value="1"
                >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="simple_spc"
                    value="262547929389073-262547929389073"
                >

                <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="website"
                    value=""
                >

                <div class="report-field">

                    <label class="report-label">
                        Screenshots
                        <span>(optional)</span>
                    </label>

                    <div
                        class="report-upload"
                        id="report-upload"
                    >

                        <div class="report-upload-content">

                            <div class="report-upload-icon">

                                <svg
                                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                    aria-hidden="true"
                                >
                                    <path d="M12 16V4"></path>
                                    <path d="m7 9 5-5 5 5"></path>
                                    <path d="M5 20h14"></path>
                                </svg>

                            </div>

                            <div class="report-upload-title">
                                Click to upload screenshots
                            </div>

                            <div class="report-upload-subtitle">
                                or drag and drop files here
                            </div>

                        </div>

                        <input
                            class="report-file-input"
                            id="report-file-input"

                            name="q3_uploadA[]"
                            multiple
                            accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.csv,.txt,.rtf,.html,.zip,.mp3,.wma,.mpg,.flv,.avi,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif"
                        >

    </div>
`;

	const form =
		container.querySelector("#fusion-report-form");

	const upload =
		container.querySelector("#report-upload");

	const input =
		container.querySelector("#report-file-input");

	const filesContainer =
		container.querySelector("#report-files");

	const submitButton =
		container.querySelector("#report-submit");

	let selectedFiles = [];
	let loadingNotification = null;

	function formatFileSize(bytes) {
		if (bytes < 1024) {
			return `${bytes} B`;
		}

		if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) {
			return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
		}

		return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
	}

	function updateInputFiles() {
		if (typeof DataTransfer === "undefined") {
			return;
		}

		const transfer = new DataTransfer();

		selectedFiles.forEach(file => {
			transfer.items.add(file);
		});

		input.files = transfer.files;
	}

	function renderFiles() {
		filesContainer.innerHTML = "";

		selectedFiles.forEach((file, index) => {

			const row =
				document.createElement("div");

			row.className = "report-file";

			row.innerHTML = `
            <span class="report-file-name"></span>

            <span class="report-file-size"></span>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="report-file-remove"
                aria-label="Remove file"
            >
                <svg
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                >
                    <path d="M6 6l12 12"></path>
                    <path d="M18 6 6 18"></path>
                </svg>
            </button>
        `;

			row.querySelector(
				".report-file-name"
			).textContent = file.name;

			row.querySelector(
					".report-file-size"
				).textContent =
				formatFileSize(file.size);

			row.querySelector(
				".report-file-remove"
			).addEventListener(
				"click",
				() => {
					selectedFiles.splice(index, 1);

					updateInputFiles();
					renderFiles();
				}
			);

			filesContainer.appendChild(row);
		});
	}

	function addFiles(fileList) {
		const incoming =
			Array.from(fileList || []);

		incoming.forEach(file => {

			const alreadyAdded =
				selectedFiles.some(existing =>
					existing.name === file.name &&
					existing.size === file.size &&
					existing.lastModified === file.lastModified
				);

			if (!alreadyAdded) {
				selectedFiles.push(file);
			}
		});

		updateInputFiles();
		renderFiles();
	}

	upload.addEventListener(
		"click",
		() => {
			input.value = "";
			input.click();
		}
	);

	input.addEventListener(
		"change",
		() => {
			addFiles(input.files);
		}
	);

	upload.addEventListener(
		"dragover",
		event => {
			event.preventDefault();
			upload.classList.add("dragover");
		}
	);

	upload.addEventListener(
		"dragleave",
		event => {
			event.preventDefault();
			upload.classList.remove("dragover");
		}
	);

	upload.addEventListener(
		"drop",
		event => {
			event.preventDefault();

			upload.classList.remove("dragover");

			addFiles(event.dataTransfer.files);
		}
	);

	form.addEventListener("submit", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!form.checkValidity()) return;
        submitButton.disabled = true;
        submitButton.querySelector("span").textContent = "Saving...";
        const loadingNotification = window.FusionNotify?.loading?.("Saving your bug report locally...");
        setTimeout(() => {
            loadingNotification?.close?.();
            submitButton.disabled = false;
            submitButton.querySelector("span").textContent = "Submit Report";
            window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Bug report saved in this browser. There is no server submission in static mode.");
            form.reset(); selectedFiles = []; updateInputFiles(); renderFiles();
        }, 700);
    });


	container
        .querySelectorAll("[data-footer-link]")
        .forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener("click", event => {
                event.preventDefault();

                const page = link.dataset.footerLink;

                if (typeof window.FusionNavigate === "function") {
                    window.FusionNavigate(page);
                    return;
                }

                window.location.hash = `#${page}`;
            });
        });


}
;return { render };

});
//# sourceURL=fusion-bundle/assets/pages/report.js
</script>

                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 500;
                line-height: 1.5;
            }

            .games-footer-links {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .games-footer-link {
                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 600;
                text-decoration: none;
                transition: color 0.16s ease;
            }

            .games-footer-link:hover {
                color: #ffffff;
            }

            .games-footer-separator {
                width: 3px;
                height: 3px;
                border-radius: 50%;
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
            }

            @media (max-width: 620px) {
                .fusion-request-page {
                    padding: 30px 12px 0;
                }

                .fusion-request-card {
                    padding: 22px 18px;
                    border-radius: 15px;
                }

                .fusion-request-types {
                    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                }

                .games-footer {
                    width: 100%;
                    padding: 20px 10px 16px;
                    margin-top: 26px;
                }

                .games-footer-logo {
                    width: 100px;
                }

                .games-footer-info {
                    flex-direction: column;
                    gap: 8px;
                }
            }
        </style>

        <main class="fusion-request-page">
            <div class="fusion-request-content">

                <header class="fusion-request-header">
                    <h1>Request a Game</h1>
                    <p>
                        Can't find a game you're looking for?
                        Send us a request and we'll take a look.
                    </p>
                </header>

                <div class="fusion-request-card">

                    <form
                        class="fusion-request-form"
                        id="fusion-request-form"
                        method="post"
                        accept-charset="utf-8"
                    >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="simple_spc"
                            value="262548636342058-262548636342058"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="uploadServerUrl"
                            value=""
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="eventObserver"
                            value="1"
                        >

                        <div class="fusion-request-field">

                            <label
                                class="fusion-request-label"
                                for="fusion-game-name"
                            >
                                Game name
                            </label>

                            <input
                                class="fusion-request-input"
                                id="fusion-game-name"
                                type="text"
                                name="q4_gameName"
                                placeholder="Enter the name of the game"
                                autocomplete="off"
                            >

                        </div>


                        <div class="fusion-request-field">

                            <span class="fusion-request-label">
                                Game type
                            </span>

                            <div
                                class="fusion-request-types"
                                role="radiogroup"
                                aria-label="Game type"
                            >

                                <div class="fusion-request-type">
                                    <input
                                        type="radio"
                                        id="fusion-type-html"
                                        name="q5_gameType"
                                        value="HTML"
                                    >

                                    <label for="fusion-type-html">
                                        HTML
                                    </label>
                                </div>

                                <div class="fusion-request-type">
                                    <input
                                        type="radio"
                                        id="fusion-type-flash"
                                        name="q5_gameType"
                                        value="FLASH"
                                    >

                                    <label for="fusion-type-flash">
                                        FLASH
                                    </label>
                                </div>

                                <div class="fusion-request-type">
                                    <input
                                        type="radio"
                                        id="fusion-type-other"
                                        name="q5_gameType"
                                        value="other"
                                    >

                                    <label for="fusion-type-other">
                                        Other
                                    </label>
                                </div>

                            </div>

                            <div
                                class="fusion-request-other"
                                id="fusion-request-other"
                            >
                                <input
                                    class="fusion-request-input"
                                    id="fusion-other-type"
                                    type="text"
                                    name="q5_gameType[other]"
                                    placeholder="Enter the game type"
                                    autocomplete="off"
                                    disabled
                                >
                            </div>

                            <p class="fusion-request-hint">
                                Select Other if the game uses a different format.
                            </p>

                        </div>


                        <div class="fusion-request-field">

                            <label
                                class="fusion-request-label"
                                for="fusion-where-can"
                            >
                                Where can we find it?
                            </label>

                            <textarea
                                class="fusion-request-textarea"
                                id="fusion-where-can"
                                name="q6_whereCan"
                                placeholder="Paste the URL or tell us where the game can be found"
                            ></textarea>

                        </div>


                        <button
                            class="fusion-request-submit"
                            id="fusion-request-submit"
                            type="submit"
                        >
                            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                                <path d="M22 2 11 13"></path>
                                <path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4Z"></path>
                            </svg>

                            <span>Submit Request</span>
                        </button>

                        <p class="fusion-request-note">
                            By submitting this request, you agree that the information
                            you provide may be used to review the request.
                        </p>

                    </form>

                </div>


                


                <footer class="games-footer">

                    <div class="games-footer-brand">
                        <img
                            class="games-footer-logo"
                            src="${__A("brand/fusion-main-h.png")}"
                            alt="FUSION"
                        >
                    </div>

                    <div class="games-footer-info">

                        <p class="games-footer-text">
                            © ${new Date().getFullYear()} FUSION · Games for everyone.
                        </p>

                        <span
                            class="games-footer-separator"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                        ></span>

                        <nav
                            class="games-footer-links"
                            aria-label="Legal"
                        >
                            <a
                                class="games-footer-link"
                                href="#"
                                data-footer-link="terms"
                            >
                                Terms
                            </a>

                            <a
                                class="games-footer-link"
                                href="#"
                                data-footer-link="privacy"
                            >
                                Privacy
                            </a>
                        </nav>

                    </div>

                </footer>

            </div>
        </main>
    `;

    const form = container.querySelector("#fusion-request-form");
    const submitButton = container.querySelector("#fusion-request-submit");

    const otherRadio = container.querySelector("#fusion-type-other");
    const otherContainer = container.querySelector("#fusion-request-other");
    const otherInput = container.querySelector("#fusion-other-type");

    let loadingNotification = null;
    let submitting = false;

    /*
     * Handle the "Other" game type.
     */
    const updateOtherField = () => {
        const isOther = otherRadio.checked;

        otherContainer.classList.toggle("visible", isOther);

        otherInput.disabled = !isOther;
        otherInput.required = isOther;

        if (!isOther) {
            otherInput.value = "";
        }
    };

    container
        .querySelectorAll('input[name="q5_gameType"]')
        .forEach((radio) => {
            radio.addEventListener("change", updateOtherField);
        });

    updateOtherField();


    /*
     * Navigation for the footer.
     */
    const navigate = (page) => {
        const navButton = document.querySelector(
            `[data-page="${page}"], [data-nav="${page}"], #nav-${page}`
        );

        if (navButton) {
            navButton.click();
            return;
        }

        window.location.hash = page;
    };

    container.querySelectorAll("[data-footer-link]").forEach((link) => {
        link.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();

            const page = link.dataset.footerLink;

            if (page) {
                navigate(page);
            }
        });
    });


    form.addEventListener("submit", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!form.checkValidity()) return;
        submitButton.disabled = true;
        const buttonText = submitButton.querySelector("span");
        if (buttonText) buttonText.textContent = "Saving...";
        const loadingNotification = window.FusionNotify?.loading?.("Saving your game request locally...");
        setTimeout(() => {
            loadingNotification?.close?.();
            submitButton.disabled = false;
            if (buttonText) buttonText.textContent = "Submit Request";
            window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Game request saved in this browser. There is no server submission in static mode.");
            form.reset();
            updateOtherField();
        }, 700);
    });

}


;return { render };

});

    "fusion:settings:animatedBackground",
    "fusion:settings:tabTitle",

const TAB_FAVICON_KEY = "fusion:settings:tabFavicon";
const PANIC_KEY = "fusion:settings:panicKey";
const PANIC_URL_KEY = "fusion:settings:panicUrl";

const TAB_CLOAK_PRESETS = {
    "Google Classroom": {
        title: "Google Classroom",
        favicon: "https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=classroom.google.com&sz=64",

function readSetting(key, fallback = "") {
    try {
        return localStorage.getItem(key) ?? fallback;
    } catch {
        return fallback;
    }
}

function writeSetting(key, value) {
    try {
        if (value) localStorage.setItem(key, value);
        else localStorage.removeItem(key);

function normalizeExternalUrl(value) {
    const raw = String(value || "").trim();
    if (!raw) return "";

    // Allow users to type example.com instead of requiring https://.
    const candidate = /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(raw)
        ? raw
        : `https://${raw}`;

    try {
        const parsed = new URL(candidate);
        if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") return "";
        return parsed.href;
    } catch {
        return "";

}

function getKeyCombo(event) {
    const parts = [];

    if (event.ctrlKey) parts.push("Ctrl");
    if (event.altKey) parts.push("Alt");
    if (event.shiftKey) parts.push("Shift");
    if (event.metaKey) parts.push("Meta");

    let key = event.key;
    if (key === " ") key = "Space";
    if (key === "Control" || key === "Alt" || key === "Shift" || key === "Meta") return "";

    if (key.length === 1) key = key.toUpperCase();
    parts.push(key);

    return parts.join("+");
}

function applyTabCloak() {

    document.title = title;

    let favicon = document.getElementById("fusion-tab-cloak-favicon");

    if (!favicon) {

        if (favicon) favicon.id = "fusion-tab-cloak-favicon";

    const faviconUrl = readSetting(TAB_FAVICON_KEY).trim();

function installPanicKey() {

        return 0;

}

    try {

        return [];
    }
}

            <\!-- NOTIFICATIONS -->
            <section class="fusion-settings-card">
                <p class="fusion-settings-card-title">Notifications</p>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text">
                        <h2>Toast notifications</h2>
                        <p>Show pop-up notifications for things like favorites, sign-in, and score submissions.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="fusion-toggle"
                            id="settings-toggle-notifications"
                            role="switch"
                            aria-label="Toggle toast notifications"
                        ></button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text">
                        <h2>Preview</h2>
                        <p>Send a test notification to see how it looks.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="fusion-settings-btn"
                            id="settings-test-notification"
                        >
                            Send test
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <\!-- APPEARANCE -->
            <section class="fusion-settings-card">
                <p class="fusion-settings-card-title">Appearance</p>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text">
                        <h2>Animated background</h2>
                        <p>The moving background effect behind FUSION. Turning this off can help on slower devices or save battery.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="fusion-toggle"
                            id="settings-toggle-background"
                            role="switch"
                            aria-label="Toggle animated background"
                        ></button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <\!-- TAB CLOAK -->
            <section class="fusion-settings-card">
                <p class="fusion-settings-card-title">Tab Cloak</p>

                <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-form">
                    <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-field">
                        <label class="fusion-tab-cloak-label" for="settings-tab-cloak-preset">Preset</label>
                        <select class="fusion-tab-cloak-preset-select" id="settings-tab-cloak-preset">
                            <option value="">Custom</option>
                            ${Object.keys(TAB_CLOAK_PRESETS).map(name => `
                                <option value="${name}">${name}</option>
                            `).join("")}
                        </select>
                        <p class="fusion-tab-cloak-help">Choose a preset to fill the tab title and favicon automatically.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-field">
                        <label class="fusion-tab-cloak-label" for="settings-tab-title">Tab title</label>
                        <input class="fusion-tab-cloak-input" id="settings-tab-title" type="text" maxlength="80" placeholder="FUSION" autocomplete="off">
                    </div>

                    <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-field">
                        <label class="fusion-tab-cloak-label" for="settings-tab-favicon">Favicon URL</label>
                        <input class="fusion-tab-cloak-input" id="settings-tab-favicon" type="url" placeholder="https://example.com/favicon.ico" autocomplete="off">
                        <p class="fusion-tab-cloak-help">Use a direct image URL for the icon shown in the browser tab.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn fusion-settings-btn-primary" id="settings-save-tab-cloak">Save tab cloak</button>
                        <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn" id="settings-reset-tab-cloak">Reset</button>
                    </div>
                </div>

            </section>

            <\!-- PANIC KEY -->
            <section class="fusion-settings-card">
                <p class="fusion-settings-card-title">Panic Key</p>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text">
                        <h2>Exit key</h2>
                        <p>Choose a keyboard key or combination that immediately leaves the current FUSION page.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control">
                        <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn" id="settings-capture-panic-key">Set key</button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-form">
                    <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-field">
                        <label class="fusion-tab-cloak-label" for="settings-panic-url">Panic URL</label>
                        <input class="fusion-tab-cloak-input" id="settings-panic-url" type="text" placeholder="example.com" autocomplete="off">
                        <p class="fusion-tab-cloak-help">You can enter example.com or a full https:// URL. FUSION will add https:// when needed.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="fusion-tab-cloak-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn fusion-settings-btn-primary" id="settings-save-panic">Save panic settings</button>
                        <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn" id="settings-reset-panic">Reset</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <\!-- DATA & PRIVACY -->
            <section class="fusion-settings-card">
                <p class="fusion-settings-card-title">Data & Privacy</p>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text">
                        <h2>Favorite games</h2>
                        <p id="settings-favorites-count">Loading…</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="fusion-settings-btn"
                            id="settings-clear-favorites"
                        >
                            Clear favorites
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text">
                        <h2>Local site data</h2>
                        <p>Clears everything FUSION stores in this browser — favorites and local preferences. This can't be undone.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="fusion-settings-btn fusion-settings-btn-danger"
                            id="settings-clear-all"
                        >
                            Clear all local data
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text">
                        <h2>Privacy Policy</h2>
                        <p>Read how FUSION handles information and local browser storage.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="fusion-settings-btn"
                            data-legal-nav="privacy"
                        >
                            View
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <\!-- ACCOUNT -->
            <section class="fusion-settings-card">
                <p class="fusion-settings-card-title">Account</p>

                <div class="fusion-settings-row">
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-text" id="settings-account-info">
                        <h2>Loading account…</h2>
                    </div>
                    <div class="fusion-settings-row-control fusion-settings-account-actions" id="settings-account-actions"></div>
                </div>
            </section>

        </main>
    `;

    /* ---------------------------------------------------
       NOTIFICATIONS TOGGLE
    --------------------------------------------------- */

    const notificationsToggle = container.querySelector("#settings-toggle-notifications");
    const testNotificationBtn = container.querySelector("#settings-test-notification");

    function syncNotificationsUI() {
        const enabled = window.FusionNotify?.isEnabled?.() ?? true;

        notificationsToggle.classList.toggle("is-on", enabled);
        notificationsToggle.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(enabled));

        testNotificationBtn.disabled = !enabled;
        testNotificationBtn.title = enabled
            ? ""
            : "Turn on toast notifications to send a preview.";
    }

    notificationsToggle?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const nextEnabled = !notificationsToggle.classList.contains("is-on");
        window.FusionNotify?.setEnabled?.(nextEnabled);
        syncNotificationsUI();

        // Give feedback either way — including the moment notifications
        // are switched off, when the normal toast path would otherwise
        // stay silent.
        if (nextEnabled) {
            window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Toast notifications are on.");
        } else {
            window.FusionNotify?.setEnabled?.(true);
            window.FusionNotify?.neutral?.("Toast notifications are off.");
            window.FusionNotify?.setEnabled?.(false);
        }
    });

    testNotificationBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        window.FusionNotify?.info?.("This is what a FUSION notification looks like.", {
            title: "Test notification"
        });
    });

    syncNotificationsUI();

    /* ---------------------------------------------------
       ANIMATED BACKGROUND TOGGLE
    --------------------------------------------------- */

    const backgroundToggle = container.querySelector("#settings-toggle-background");

    function syncBackgroundUI() {
        const enabled = window.FusionTheme?.isAnimatedBackgroundEnabled?.() ?? true;

        backgroundToggle.classList.toggle("is-on", enabled);
        backgroundToggle.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(enabled));
    }

    backgroundToggle?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const nextEnabled = !backgroundToggle.classList.contains("is-on");

        if (window.FusionTheme?.setAnimatedBackground) {
            window.FusionTheme.setAnimatedBackground(nextEnabled);
        }

        syncBackgroundUI();
    });

    syncBackgroundUI();

    /* ---------------------------------------------------
       TAB CLOAK
    --------------------------------------------------- */

    const tabTitleInput = container.querySelector("#settings-tab-title");
    const tabFaviconInput = container.querySelector("#settings-tab-favicon");
    const saveTabCloakBtn = container.querySelector("#settings-save-tab-cloak");
    const resetTabCloakBtn = container.querySelector("#settings-reset-tab-cloak");
    const presetSelect = container.querySelector("#settings-tab-cloak-preset");

    tabTitleInput.value = readSetting(TAB_TITLE_KEY, "FUSION");
    tabFaviconInput.value = readSetting(TAB_FAVICON_KEY);

    saveTabCloakBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const title = tabTitleInput.value.trim() || "FUSION";
        const favicon = tabFaviconInput.value.trim();

        if (favicon) {
            const normalizedFavicon = normalizeExternalUrl(favicon);
            if (!normalizedFavicon) {
                window.FusionNotify?.neutral?.("Enter a valid http:// or https:// favicon URL.");
                return;
            }
            tabFaviconInput.value = normalizedFavicon;
            writeSetting(TAB_FAVICON_KEY, normalizedFavicon);
        } else {
            writeSetting(TAB_FAVICON_KEY, "");
        }

        writeSetting(TAB_TITLE_KEY, title);
        tabTitleInput.value = title;
        applyTabCloak();
        window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Tab cloak settings saved.");
    });

    resetTabCloakBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        writeSetting(TAB_TITLE_KEY, "");
        writeSetting(TAB_FAVICON_KEY, "");
        tabTitleInput.value = "FUSION";
        tabFaviconInput.value = "";
        applyTabCloak();
        window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Tab cloak reset.");
    });

    presetSelect?.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const presetName = presetSelect.value;
        const preset = TAB_CLOAK_PRESETS[presetName];
        if (!preset) return;

        tabTitleInput.value = preset.title;
        tabFaviconInput.value = preset.favicon;

        writeSetting(TAB_TITLE_KEY, preset.title);
        writeSetting(TAB_FAVICON_KEY, preset.favicon);
        applyTabCloak();
        window.FusionNotify?.success?.(`${preset.title} tab cloak applied.`);
    });

    /* ---------------------------------------------------
       PANIC KEY
    --------------------------------------------------- */

    const panicKeyButton = container.querySelector("#settings-capture-panic-key");
    const panicUrlInput = container.querySelector("#settings-panic-url");
    const savePanicBtn = container.querySelector("#settings-save-panic");
    const resetPanicBtn = container.querySelector("#settings-reset-panic");

    panicUrlInput.value = readSetting(PANIC_URL_KEY);

    function syncPanicKeyButton() {
        const key = readSetting(PANIC_KEY);
        panicKeyButton.textContent = key || "Set key";
    }

    panicKeyButton?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        panicKeyCaptureActive = true;
        window.__fusionCapturingPanicKey = true;
        panicKeyButton.textContent = "Press a key…";
    });

    savePanicBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const rawUrl = panicUrlInput.value.trim();
        const normalizedUrl = normalizeExternalUrl(rawUrl);

        if (!normalizedUrl) {
            window.FusionNotify?.neutral?.("Enter a valid panic URL, such as example.com.");
            return;
        }

        panicUrlInput.value = normalizedUrl;
        writeSetting(PANIC_URL_KEY, normalizedUrl);
        window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Panic key settings saved.");
    });

    resetPanicBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        writeSetting(PANIC_KEY, "");
        writeSetting(PANIC_URL_KEY, "");
        panicUrlInput.value = "";
        syncPanicKeyButton();
        window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Panic key reset.");
    });

    syncPanicKeyButton();

    /* ---------------------------------------------------
       DATA & PRIVACY
    --------------------------------------------------- */

    const favoritesCountEl = container.querySelector("#settings-favorites-count");
    const clearFavoritesBtn = container.querySelector("#settings-clear-favorites");
    const clearAllBtn = container.querySelector("#settings-clear-all");

    function syncFavoritesUI() {
        const count = countFavorites();

        favoritesCountEl.textContent = count === 0
            ? "You haven't favorited any games yet."
            : `You have ${count} favorited game${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`;

        clearFavoritesBtn.disabled = count === 0;
    }

    clearFavoritesBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        try {
            localStorage.removeItem(FAVORITES_KEY);
        } catch (error) {
            // Storage unavailable — nothing to clear.
        }

        syncFavoritesUI();
        window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Favorite games cleared.");
    });

    clearAllBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const keys = getFusionLocalStorageKeys().filter(key => !PRESERVED_KEYS.has(key));

        window.FusionNotify?.notice?.({
            title: "Clear all local data?",
            message: "This removes everything FUSION has stored in this browser, including your favorite games. Your account (if signed in) is not affected. This can't be undone.",
            buttonText: "Clear data",
            cancelText: "Cancel",
            onConfirm: () => {
                try {
                    keys.forEach(key => localStorage.removeItem(key));
                } catch (error) {
                    // Storage unavailable.
                }

                syncFavoritesUI();
                window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Local FUSION data cleared.");
            }
        });
    });

    syncFavoritesUI();

    /* ---------------------------------------------------
       ACCOUNT
    --------------------------------------------------- */

    const accountInfoEl = container.querySelector("#settings-account-info");
    const accountActionsEl = container.querySelector("#settings-account-actions");

    function initials(name) {
        return String(name || "?")
            .trim()
            .charAt(0)
            .toUpperCase();
    }

    function renderAccount(user) {
        if (user) {
            const displayName =
                user.username ||
                user.fullName ||
                user.primaryEmailAddress?.emailAddress ||
                "FUSION user";

            const email = user.primaryEmailAddress?.emailAddress || "";
            const avatarUrl = user.imageUrl || "";

            accountInfoEl.innerHTML = `
                <div class="fusion-settings-account">
                    ${
                        avatarUrl
                            ? `<img class="fusion-settings-avatar" src="${avatarUrl}" alt="">`
                            : `<div class="fusion-settings-avatar-fallback">${initials(displayName)}</div>`
                    }
                    <div>
                        <p class="fusion-settings-account-name">${displayName}</p>
                        ${email ? `<p class="fusion-settings-account-email">${email}</p>` : ""}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            accountActionsEl.innerHTML = `
                <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn" data-page="profile">Manage account</button>
                <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn fusion-settings-btn-danger" id="settings-sign-out">Sign out</button>
            `;

            accountActionsEl.querySelector('[data-page="profile"]')
                ?.addEventListener("click", () => window.FusionNavigate?.("profile"));

            accountActionsEl.querySelector("#settings-sign-out")
                ?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
                    await window.FusionAuth?.signOut();
                    window.FusionNotify?.neutral?.("You've been signed out.");
                });

        } else {
            accountInfoEl.innerHTML = `
                <h2>Not signed in</h2>
                <p>Sign in to sync your profile and appear on leaderboards.</p>
            `;

            accountActionsEl.innerHTML = `
                <button type="button" class="fusion-settings-btn fusion-settings-btn-primary" data-page="login">Sign in</button>
            `;

            accountActionsEl.querySelector('[data-page="login"]')
                ?.addEventListener("click", () => window.FusionNavigate?.("login"));
        }
    }

    let unsubscribeAuth = null;

    (async () => {
        const user = await window.FusionAuth?.getUser?.();
        renderAccount(user || null);

        unsubscribeAuth = window.FusionAuth?.onChange?.(updatedUser => {
            renderAccount(updatedUser || null);
        });
    })();
}
;return { render };

});
//# sourceURL=fusion-bundle/assets/pages/settings.js
</script>
<script>
__fusionDefine("assets/pages/submit_scores.js", async function () { "use strict";
// assets/pages/submit_scores.js
//
// FUSION Submit Score page
// Uses the exact static form field structure from form 262560673098061.
// The form is submitted directly to static form through a hidden iframe,
// matching the same submission approach used by report.js.
//

const { getGameDataUrl } = (await __fusionImport("../env.js", "assets/pages"));
const { games: gameData } = await __fusionImport(await getGameDataUrl(), "assets/pages");

const JOTFORM_ID = "262560673098061";


const ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES = new Set([
    "image/jpeg",
    "image/png",
    "image/gif",
    "image/webp"
]);

const MAX_FILE_SIZE =
    10854 * 1024;

function render(container) {
    container.innerHTML = `
        <style>
            .submit-score-page {
                width: 100%;
                min-height: 100%;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;

            .submit-score-heading {
                min-width: 0;

            .submit-score-title {
                margin: 0;
                color: #fff;
                font-size: 25px;
                font-weight: 700;
                line-height: 1.15;
                letter-spacing: -.025em;
            }

            .submit-score-subtitle {
                margin: 5px 0 0;

            }

            .submit-score-card {
                width: 100%;

                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.075);

                box-shadow:
                    0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
            }

            .submit-score-form {
                display: flex;

                gap: 22px;

            .submit-score-field {
                display: flex;

            .submit-score-label {
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);

            .submit-score-label span {

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.34);

            }

            .submit-score-input,
            .submit-score-select {
                width: 100%;
                height: 46px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);

            .submit-score-input::placeholder {

            .submit-score-input:hover,

            .submit-score-input:focus,

            .submit-score-select {

            .submit-score-file:hover {

            .submit-score-file input {

                color: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
                font-size: 12px;

            }

            .submit-score-file-subtitle {
                color: rgba(255,255,255,.30);

                font-weight: 500;
            }

            .submit-score-files {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 7px;
                margin-top: 1px;
            }

            .submit-score-file-item {
                min-height: 34px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding: 7px 10px;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.065);

                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 9px;
            }

            .submit-score-file-item-name {
                flex: 1;

            .submit-score-file-item-size {

            .submit-score-file-item-remove {
                width: 22px;

                    background .14s ease,

            .submit-score-file-item-remove:hover {

            }

            .submit-score-file-item-remove svg {
                width: 13px;

            .submit-score-help {
                margin: -7px 0 0;

            }

            .submit-score-submit {

            .submit-score-footer-link {

            }

            .submit-score-footer-link:hover {

            }

            .submit-score-footer-separator {
                width: 3px;

                border-radius: 50%;
                background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);

            .submit-score-frame {

                border: 0;

                .submit-score-page {

                .submit-score-card {

                .submit-score-title {

        </style>

        <div class="submit-score-page">

            <main class="submit-score-content">

                <header class="submit-score-header">

                    <button
                        class="submit-score-back"
                        type="button"
                        data-submit-score-back
                        aria-label="Back to leaderboard"
                    >
                        <svg
                            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                            fill="none"
                            stroke="currentColor"
                            stroke-width="2"
                            stroke-linecap="round"
                            stroke-linejoin="round"
                        >
                            <path d="M19 12H5"></path>
                            <path d="M12 19l-7-7 7-7"></path>
                        </svg>
                    </button>

                    <div class="submit-score-heading">

                        <h1 class="submit-score-title">
                            Submit Your Score
                        </h1>

                        <p class="submit-score-subtitle">
                            Send your high score to the FUSION leaderboard.
                        </p>

                    </div>

                </header>

                <section class="submit-score-card">

                    <form
                        class="submit-score-form"
                        id="fusion-submit-score-form"
                        method="post"
                        enctype="multipart/form-data"
                        autocomplete="on"
                    >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            id="submitScoreJWTContainer"
                            value=""
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            id="submitScoreCardinalOrderNumber"
                            value=""
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="jsExecutionTracker"
                            value="build-date-1789361694424"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="buildDate"
                            value="1789361694424"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="uploadServerUrl"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="eventObserver"
                            value="1"
                        >

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="website"
                            value=""
                        >

                        <div class="submit-score-field">

                            <label
                                class="submit-score-label"
                                for="submit-score-game"
                            >
                                Game
                                <span>Required</span>
                            </label>

                            <select
                                class="submit-score-select"
                                id="submit-score-game"
                                name="q3_game"
                                required
                            >
                                <option value="">
                                    Select a game
                                </option>
                            </select>

                        </div>

                        <div class="submit-score-field">

                            <label
                                class="submit-score-label"
                                for="submit-score-value"
                            >
                                Score
                                <span>Required</span>
                            </label>

                            <input
                                class="submit-score-input"
                                id="submit-score-value"
                                name="q4_score"
                                type="text"
                                placeholder="Enter your score"
                                required
                            >

                        </div>

                        <div class="submit-score-field">

                            <label
                                class="submit-score-label"
                                for="submit-score-proof"
                            >
                                Proof of Score
                                <span>Required</span>
                            </label>

                            <label
                                class="submit-score-file"
                                data-submit-score-upload
                            >

                                <input
                                    type="file"
                                    id="submit-score-proof"
                                    name="q5_proofOf[]"
                                    multiple
                                    required
                                    data-imagevalidate="yes"
                                    accept=".jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp"
                                >

                                <div class="submit-score-file-content">

                                    <svg
                                        class="submit-score-file-icon"
                                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                        fill="none"
                                        stroke="currentColor"
                                        stroke-width="1.7"
                                        stroke-linecap="round"
                                        stroke-linejoin="round"
                                    >
                                        <path d="M4 5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8l6 6v10a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"></path>
                                        <path d="M14 3v6h6"></path>
                                        <circle cx="9" cy="13" r="1.5"></circle>
                                        <path d="m4 18 4.5-4 3.5 3 2.5-2 5.5 4"></path>
                                    </svg>

                                    <span class="submit-score-file-title">
                                        Click to upload proof
                                    </span>

                                    <span class="submit-score-file-subtitle">
                                        JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP only
                                    </span>

                                </div>

                            </label>

                            <div
                                class="submit-score-files"
                                data-submit-score-files
                            ></div>

                            <p class="submit-score-help">
                                Upload at least one image. SVG files are not supported. Maximum 10.6 MB per file.
                            </p>

                        </div>

                        <button
                            class="submit-score-submit"
                            type="submit"
                            id="submit-score-button"
                        >

                            <svg
                                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                fill="none"
                                stroke="currentColor"
                                stroke-width="2"
                                stroke-linecap="round"
                                stroke-linejoin="round"
                            >
                                <path d="M22 2L11 13"></path>
                                <path d="M22 2l-7-3"></path>
                                <path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"></path>
                            </svg>

                            <span>

                            </span>

                        </button>

                        <p class="submit-score-note">

                        </p>

                    </form>

                </section>

            </main>

            <footer class="submit-score-footer">

                <div class="submit-score-footer-brand">

                    >

                </div>

                <div class="submit-score-footer-info">

                    <p class="submit-score-footer-text">
                        © ${new Date().getFullYear()} FUSION · Games for everyone.
                    </p>

                    <span

                        aria-hidden="true"
                    ></span>

                    <nav
                        class="submit-score-footer-links"

                    >

                            class="submit-score-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="terms"
                        >
                            Terms
                        </a>

                        <a
                            class="submit-score-footer-link"
                            href="#"
                            data-footer-link="privacy"
                        >
                            Privacy
                        </a>

                    </nav>

                </div>

            </footer>

            

        </div>
    `;

    const form =
        container.querySelector(
            "#fusion-submit-score-form"
        );

    const gameSelect =
        container.querySelector(
            "#submit-score-game"
        );

    const fileInput =
        container.querySelector(
            "#submit-score-proof"
        );

    const fileDrop =
        container.querySelector(
            "[data-submit-score-upload]"
        );

    const filesContainer =
        container.querySelector(
            "[data-submit-score-files]"
        );

    const submitButton =
        container.querySelector(
            "#submit-score-button"
        );

    const backButton =
        container.querySelector(
            "[data-submit-score-back]"
        );

    let selectedFiles = [];

    let submitting = false;

    /*
     * Populate the game selector from the same
     * game_data.js used throughout FUSION.
     */
    if (Array.isArray(gameData)) {
        gameData.forEach((game) => {

            if (
                !game ||
                !game.name
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const option =
                document.createElement(
                    "option"
                );

            option.value =
                game.name;

            option.textContent =
                game.name;

            gameSelect.appendChild(
                option
            );
        });
    }

    /*
     * Keep the actual file input synchronized
     * with selectedFiles.
     */
    function updateInputFiles() {

        if (
            !fileInput ||
            typeof DataTransfer ===
                "undefined"
        ) {
            return;
        }

        const transfer =
            new DataTransfer();

        selectedFiles.forEach(
            (file) => {
                transfer.items.add(
                    file
                );
            }
        );

        fileInput.files =
            transfer.files;
    }

    function formatFileSize(bytes) {

        if (!bytes) {
            return "0 KB";
        }

        if (
            bytes <
            1024 * 1024
        ) {
            return (
                Math.round(
                    bytes / 1024
                ) +
                " KB"
            );
        }

        return (
            (
                bytes /
                (1024 * 1024)
            ).toFixed(1) +
            " MB"
        );
    }

    function renderFiles() {

        if (!filesContainer) {
            return;
        }

        filesContainer.innerHTML =
            "";

        selectedFiles.forEach(
            (file, index) => {

                const item =
                    document.createElement(
                        "div"
                    );

                item.className =
                    "submit-score-file-item";

                item.innerHTML = `
                    <svg
                        width="14"
                        height="14"
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        fill="none"
                        stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.36)"
                        stroke-width="1.8"
                        stroke-linecap="round"
                        stroke-linejoin="round"
                    >
                        <path d="M4 5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8l6 6v10a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"></path>
                        <path d="M14 3v6h6"></path>
                        <circle cx="9" cy="13" r="1.5"></circle>
                        <path d="m4 18 4.5-4 3.5 3 2.5-2 5.5 4"></path>
                    </svg>

                    <span
                        class="submit-score-file-item-name"
                    ></span>

                    <span
                        class="submit-score-file-item-size"
                    >
                        ${formatFileSize(file.size)}
                    </span>

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="submit-score-file-item-remove"
                        data-file-index="${index}"
                        aria-label="Remove file"
                    >
                        <svg
                            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                            fill="none"
                            stroke="currentColor"
                            stroke-width="2"
                            stroke-linecap="round"
                            stroke-linejoin="round"
                        >
                            <path d="M18 6L6 18"></path>
                            <path d="M6 6l12 12"></path>
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                `;

                item.querySelector(
                    ".submit-score-file-item-name"
                ).textContent =
                    file.name;

                filesContainer.appendChild(
                    item
                );
            }
        );

        filesContainer
            .querySelectorAll(
                "[data-file-index]"
            )
            .forEach(
                (button) => {

                    button.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        () => {

                            const index =
                                Number(
                                    button
                                        .dataset
                                        .fileIndex
                                );

                            selectedFiles =
                                selectedFiles.filter(
                                    (_, i) =>
                                        i !==
                                        index
                                );

                            updateInputFiles();
                            renderFiles();

                        }
                    );

                }
            );
    }

    /*
     * Validate the file itself.
     *
     * Only JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP are accepted.
     * SVG is intentionally excluded.
     */
    function isAllowedImage(file) {

        if (
            !file ||
            !ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES.has(
                file.type
            )
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    function addFiles(fileList) {

        if (!fileList) {
            return;
        }

        const incoming =
            Array.from(fileList);

        for (
            const file of incoming
        ) {

            /*
             * Reject anything that isn't one
             * of our allowed image MIME types.
             */
            if (
                !isAllowedImage(
                    file
                )
            ) {

                if (
                    window.FusionNotify &&
                    typeof window
                        .FusionNotify.error ===
                        "function"
                ) {
                    window.FusionNotify.error(
                        `${file.name} is not a supported image file. Only JPG, PNG, GIF and WebP files are allowed.`
                    );
                }

                continue;
            }

            /*
             * Keep the static form 10,854 KB
             * maximum file size.
             */
            if (
                file.size >
                MAX_FILE_SIZE
            ) {

                if (
                    window.FusionNotify &&
                    typeof window
                        .FusionNotify.error ===
                        "function"
                ) {
                    window.FusionNotify.error(
                        `${file.name} is larger than the 10.6 MB limit.`
                    );
                }

                continue;
            }

            const duplicate =
                selectedFiles.some(
                    (existing) =>
                        existing.name ===
                            file.name &&
                        existing.size ===
                            file.size &&
                        existing.lastModified ===
                            file.lastModified
                );

            if (
                !duplicate
            ) {
                selectedFiles.push(
                    file
                );
            }
        }

        updateInputFiles();
        renderFiles();

        /*
         * Reset the input so selecting
         * the same file again still fires
         * the change event.
         */
        fileInput.value = "";
    }

    /*
     * Normal file picker.
     */
    fileInput?.addEventListener(
        "change",
        () => {

            addFiles(
                fileInput.files
            );

        }
    );

    /*
     * Drag and drop support.
     */
    fileDrop?.addEventListener(
        "dragover",
        (event) => {

            event.preventDefault();

            fileDrop.classList.add(
                "dragging"
            );

        }
    );

    fileDrop?.addEventListener(
        "dragleave",
        () => {

            fileDrop.classList.remove(
                "dragging"
            );

        }
    );

    fileDrop?.addEventListener(
        "drop",
        (event) => {

            event.preventDefault();

            fileDrop.classList.remove(
                "dragging"
            );

            addFiles(
                event.dataTransfer.files
            );

        }
    );

    /*
     * Back to leaderboard.
     */
    backButton?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {

            if (
                typeof window.FusionNavigate ===
                "function"
            ) {

                window.FusionNavigate(
                    "leaderboard"
                );

            } else {

                window.location.hash =
                    "leaderboard";

            }

        }
    );

    /*
     * Footer navigation.
     */
    container
        .querySelectorAll(
            "[data-footer-link]"
        )
        .forEach(
            (link) => {

                link.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    (event) => {

                        event.preventDefault();

                        const page =
                            link.dataset
                                .footerLink;

                        if (
                            typeof window.FusionNavigate ===
                            "function"
                        ) {

                            window.FusionNavigate(
                                page
                            );

                        } else {

                            window.location.hash =
                                page;

                        }

                    }
                );

            }
        );

    form?.addEventListener("submit", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!form.checkValidity()) return;
        if (selectedFiles.length === 0) {
            window.FusionNotify?.error?.("Please upload proof of your score before saving it.");
            return;
        }
        const invalidFile = selectedFiles.find(file => !isAllowedImage(file) || file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE);
        if (invalidFile) {
            window.FusionNotify?.error?.("One or more proof files are invalid. Please use JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP images under the allowed size.");
            return;
        }
        submitting = true;
        submitButton.disabled = true;
        const buttonText = submitButton.querySelector("span");
        if (buttonText) buttonText.textContent = "Saving...";
        const loadingNotification = window.FusionNotify?.loading?.("Saving your score locally...");
        try {
            const key = "fusion:local:score-submissions";
            const submissions = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
            submissions.push({ gameId: gameSelect?.value || "", score: scoreInput?.value || "", fileNames: selectedFiles.map(file => file.name), createdAt: Date.now() });
            localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(submissions));
        } catch (error) { console.warn("[FUSION] Couldn't save local score submission:", error); }
        setTimeout(() => {
            loadingNotification?.close?.();
            submitting = false; submitButton.disabled = false;
            if (buttonText) buttonText.textContent = "Submit Score";
            window.FusionNotify?.success?.("Score submission saved in this browser. There is no server submission in static mode.");
            form.reset(); selectedFiles = []; updateInputFiles(); renderFiles();
        }, 700);
    });

}
;return { render };

});

</script>

        // Support the existing FUSION page navigation system.
        const navButton = document.querySelector(
            `[data-page="${page}"], [data-nav="${page}"], #nav-${page}`

            navButton.click();
            return;
        }

        // Fallback for projects using a hash-based page system.
        window.location.hash = page;
    };

        link.addEventListener("click", (event) => {

            const page = link.dataset.footerLink;
            if (page) navigate(page);
        });
    });

        link.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();

            if (page) navigate(page);
        });
    });

const CDN_BASE = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fusion-webv3/large-games@main";

// Safety stop so a misbehaving CDN (one that never returns 404) can't loop forever.
const MAX_VERSION = 500;

const versionUrl = (name, n) => `${CDN_BASE}/${name}_v${n}.js`;

  } catch {
    // Network error: treat as "not found" so we fall back to the newest version we already confirmed.
    return false;

// Returns { version, url }, or null if not even v1 exists (latestOnce then falls back to the old file).
// The last known-good version is remembered in localStorage, so on later visits the climb starts
// there (after re-checking it still exists) instead of from v1.
async function findLatest(name) {
